tei:titleStmt.tei:title: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi/them byang bzhu
o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi/them byang bzhu

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi/ them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab mo'i gter/ /bdun cu'i smin byed bcu phrag lnga zung gyi/ /phyogs bzhi rgyun bzang gcig tu drangs 'di ko /ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil la med thabs med/ /de la o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes ltar/ smin byed dbang gi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa byed pa la/ thog mar dbang thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba/ 1)zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po'i sta dngos sbrags ma/ 2)rigs brgya rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi dbang chog ga)zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi ting 'dzin don dbang*/ 4)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dbang chen ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i dbang chen bcas/ yan lag bsam pa lhun 'grub ma le'u bcu gsum dang chos skyong srog gtad bcas bcu bzhi so sor phral ba smin byed rgyas pa'i lugs la/ 5)o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med kyi bde chen zhing dbang*/ 6)o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang*/ 7)o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang*/ 8)bzhi pa o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mo dang bcas pa'i dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang*/ 9)lnga pa o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang*/ 10)drug pa o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dbang*/ 11)bdun pa o rgyan sman lha'i dbang*/ 12)brgyad pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi dbang*/ 13)dgu pa o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon dbang*/ 14)bcu pa o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad dbang*/ 15)bcu gcig pa o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i dbang*/ 16)bcu gnyis pa o rgyan yi dam lha'i dbang*/

17)bcu gsum pa o rgyan dpa' po ging gi dbang*/ 18)bcu bzhi pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom chos skyong srog gnyad bcas so sor phral ba bcas dbang sna bcu bzhi dang*/ 19)bsdus pa bum dbang ye shes drwa ba gtso bsdus kyi skor/ 20)gsang dbang bde stong drug 'dren/ 21)bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i dbang chog dngos grub kun 'byung g.yang gtad dang bcas pa/ 22)ma lha bu rdzi'i bka' gtad/ ༈ bla ma drag po'i skor la/ 23)padma khrag 'thung gi dbang mchog rdo rje spyi blugs/ 24)padma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las/ snying po'i gtor dbang bskur ba'i tshul ye shes snying po/ 25)'chi med yang gsang bcu dril gyi dbang mchog rdo rje snying po'i cod pan/ 26)bla ma drag po bdud 'dul kī la ya'i dbang chen sta dngos sbrags ma/ 27)bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar/ 28)dbang drag padma yang gsang snying po las: dbang chog gnam lcags go khrag la ldeb/ ༈ yi dam gyi skor la/ 29)thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi sta dngos sbrags ma/ 30)thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang 'bring*/ ༈ yi dam zhi khro spyi'i skor sgos dbang gi zhi khro na raka dong sprugs gong song nas/ 31)yi dam sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong sta gon dang dngos gzhi/ ༈ yi dam bye brag gi skor la/ 32)'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi dbang chog 33)dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi dbang chog 34)phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang*/ 35)dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po nā ga raksha'i dbang chog ye shes me 'bar mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa phrin las me 'bar/ 36)yang phur gtum po nā ga raksha'i sgos dbang*/

37)bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang chen sta dngos sbrags ma/ 38)yang phur gyi gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang 'bring*/ ༈ mkha' 'gro'i skor la/ 39)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ 40)mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa/ 43)thugs rdor byabs khrus rgyud don rnam dag 44)mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang chog 45)bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi dbang chog ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong bklag par rnam grol/ 46)byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun bklag chog tu bkod pa byad kyi sprin nag gzhom pa'i rdo rje'i 'thor rlung*/ ༈ chos spyod gi skor la/ 47)bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ legs ldan mgon po'i dbang bskur bsdus pa/ 48)dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong gi dbang bskur dregs pa'i srog thig dmar po/ 49)tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las dbang chen utpal la'i phreng ba/ 50)tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon dbang 'bring 'ja' tshon phreng ba/ 51)tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud tshe dbang*/ 52)tshe dbang bsdus pa rdo rje'i go khrag bcas bzhugs pa lags so/ /slar smras pa/ gnam lcags zab gter kai la sha yi spor/ /las 'ong bcu phrag lnga zung smin byid chab/ /phyogs kyi grangs ldan kha 'bab rgyun bzang por/ /ye shes mtha' yas rgya mtsho bskrun 'di rmad/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/

/rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ //

༄༅/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sku gsum ston pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin mtsho rgyal yum/ /grub brnyes yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen rje/ /dbyer med rtsa gsum gling pas bdag skyongs shig /gang gi zab gter nam mkha'i nor bu yi/ /phrin las chu lha'i phag la nyer phyogs shing*/ /smin sgrol lam bzang stor la ma bzod nas/ /dam pa'i lugs bzhin 'khod la rjes gnang stsol/ / da'ang gangs can phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam sprul/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter smin byed dbang gi chu bo ma lus pa/ phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen zhe dbang gi rim pa yongs rdzogs phyogs gcig tu dgod pa ni/ lugs 'di nyid kyi smin grol yongs rdzogs dkyus gcig tu 'bog par byed pa'i thabs/ skabs bstun gyi phyag len zhib rgyas su bshad par bya ba la/ thog mar rang nyid dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa dang*/ ring lugs 'di nyid kyi rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub sogs rim gnyis la myong ba thon cing rdo rje slob dpon gyi de nyid bcu la mkhas pa tshad ldan zhig dgos pa yin la/ tha ma'ang bka' phur thugs gsum gang rung gi sgo nas bsnyen tshad 'byor zhing rim gnyis kyi gnad khrol te dbang bzhi'i go don rtogs pa zhig gal che'o/ /de ltar dbang khrid ma tshugs pa'i snga rol du nyams chag sbyang ba dang*/ lha bsang rgyal brngan dang*/ mchod sbyin sogs rgyab dpung bskyed pa'i cho ga rnams sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub las gsungs pa ltar bya dgos la/ dmigs bsal gyi dbang bskur mgo tshugs nas mjug ma bsgril gyi bar/

chog grwa zur 'dzugs kyis rang lugs rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan dang*/ yang phur 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung*/ rig 'dzin srog sgrub dang rgyun gsol 'bring po phrin las mkha' khyab rgya mtsho sogs ma chag par bya ba snga 'gyur dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin zhib cha thon par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bca' bsham gyi rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor bsham bkod sa chog sta gon gyi bar bla ma zhi drag gi khog dbub bzhin byas la/ rgyun 'jog thugs sgrub/ yang phur/ gsang ba ye shes/ sogs rtsa gsum mchod gtor rgyas spros can rgyun 'jog chad brtan bskul gsum/ gsol kha rgyas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin dbang bskur dngos gzhi gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor brje len dang*/ mchod gtor/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma/ tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs spyi chos dang*/ bye brag dkyil 'khor so so'i bca' bsham zur bkod bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir mchod pa sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad mdun stegs la zhi drag gi mchod pa tshogs kyi yo byad spyi 'gros dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ rgyan gyi bye brag phyi yol dar gyi lda ldi bcas yid du 'ong bar bya'o/ /de nas dus tshes 'phrod sbyor bzang por dbu tshugs te/ nyin dang por tshogs kyi 'khor lo grub nas dngos gzhi smin byed kyi rim pa bstar chags su bkod pa dbang tshan nga gnyis las/ dbang bskur thams cad kyi thog mar nyams chag sbyong zhing rgyud smin par bya ba la/ thog mar zhi khro na raka dong sprugs dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol gyi sta gon dang*/ gsang chen rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur smin grol gyi sgo 'byed par byas te 'di nas mtha' ma rdzogs bar du/ mtshams ma chad par gsham gsal bzhin lag len thebs par bya ba ni spyi'i ching dam pa yin no/

/da ni bye brag dbang bskur dngos la 'jug pa dbang tshan nga gnyis dkyus bzhin du bkod pa la/ thog mar bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po'i sta gon ni/ bkam̐' bab yongs rdzogs dpal chen sgrub bka' brgyam̐d/ /yi dam yongs 'dus zhim̐ khrom̐ rab 'byams dang*/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rdor sems la/ /'dud de dbam̐ng chen bltas chom̐g 'di na 'god/ de la bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur bltas chog tu bkod pa la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ thog mar sta gon gyi rim pa ni/ shin tu spros bcas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang chen mo zhes pa ni/ sgrub chen dang sbrags pa ste/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs sta gon byas la/ nyin grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol te/ nyin bcu'i nang rdzogs par byed pa yin mod/ de 'dra'i phyag srol deng sang byed mkhan dkon zhing lag len theb par dka' bas/ 'dir dbang rkyang gi khongs su sgrub khog gi nang la bshad pa'i sta gon sogs/ sgrub dbang gis dgos pa'ang tshang bar mdzad pa'i gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa yin la/ de la'ang*/ sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgrub gnas rnying pa'am ras bris lta bur ma byas kyang chog mod/ mdo tsam spros par mos na/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum la chu gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ bum gter bcud ldan/ dung phor du 'o ma dang rtsi sman sbyar ba/ bdag bskyed gong gtor sman raka nyer spyod bsham pa'i mdun/ dung chu/ dpung skud/ ku sha/ so shing*/

bcas sta gon la dgos pa'i dngos po rnams 'du bya/ rdo rje slob dpon kyi mdun du g.yon nas brtsam ste/ bum pa/ ḍā ru/ nas bzed yungs thun/ g.yab dar/ rdor dril/ gdab phur/ nang mchod/ bsang chu 'thor byed kyi ku sha sogs dgod/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu bkod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gying : dbyings phyug yum 'khyud gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gzi brjid gar dgur ldan pa gtso bo'i gnas: lnga dang yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas rnams: me dpung klong bzhugs dpal rngam brjid par gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya tsam bzlas/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag rgya gram sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i skur gyur/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams shing*/ de'i steng du gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med pas rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal chen che mchog he ru ka'i skur gyur/

oṃ badzra ma hā kro ti padma kro ti? rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya maṇḍa la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/ /de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan sogs bkram pa'i stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng*/ maṇḍa lar dri'i thig le'i dbus su/ tshom bu lha grangs ltar bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag tu phyed par bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma/ mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod rnams g.yas su bskor bar bsham/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu dgram/ de nas zhi ba'i las byang thos grol bla med las/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug dag pa'i snod mchog tu: rang byung? sogs las byang mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar gtong la thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs: dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris nas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang : sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis se gol gsum byas la/ lha rnams bar snang du 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ /skabs 'dir rgyun khyer ram bsdu na zhi ba rdo rje dbyings dang*/ rol rtsal khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bcas skad cig krong gis bskyed la/ sgrub gzhi rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal

gdab la/ thog mar dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes se gol gtog /de nas dzap bskul ba ni/ spos rol snyan dbyangs dang ldan pas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ ye rdzogs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor nas/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas su/ /ma chags skyon bral bde stong pad zla'i steng*/ /ma bcos ka dag kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /ma skyes rang shar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha/ /rol rtsal 'bar ba khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas/ /sku ni mi g.yo zang thal phyi nang bral/ /gsung ni mi 'gags 'dzab dbyangs rgyun chad med/ /thugs rje'i klong yangs 'gags med shugs 'byung gis/ /ye shes sku lnga'i 'od zer lcags kyu 'gyed/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che la bying ba rnams/ /rang byung chos dbyings bde chen zhing du drongs/ /bdag gis rtse gcig thugs dam bskul ba'i mthus/ /mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub reg gyur cig / bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag nyid kun tu bzang po'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rnam snang gi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing kha dang*/ dung khang du che mchog he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ zhi khro so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/ bdag dang mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ gnyis ka'i thugs srog dang sngags phreng las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char babs pa ltar byung*/

bdag mdun rten rdzas la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud sbyangs/ thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsams la/ dmigs pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang sbyar te bzla/ kun bzang yab yum gyi bsnyen pa ni: om̐ sa manta bha dra muṃ hri swā hā: rigs lnga la: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sems dpa' yab yum dang thub pa la: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa aṣṭa kro ta muṃ mu ne ye swā hā: che mchog khro bo rnams la: om̐ badzra shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri tāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sogs ci nus dang gtso bo spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: zhes pa'i rtsa bsnyen 'di gtso bor bzung la bzla bar bya'o// ༈ gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa lha grangs sam rnam bum dang las bum tsam 'du bya/ drag sngags yungs thun gyis brab/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug la bgegs bskrad/ khrus kyis sbyang*/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la nang bcud mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa dgod/ mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlab/ gzung thag la 'jus te/

phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ /zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas rtsa sngags ji ltar rigs par bzla/ de nas las bum la dmigs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du: padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ de nas mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas rigs me dor nas bdag dbang blang ba dang*/ gsol kha bshags skong tshogs mchod sogs spyi ltar bya'o// ༈ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dya swā hā/ gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas te/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/

de'i ched du smin byed dbang gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal gdab ste gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ 'dir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i blo'i bye brag dang mthun par sems can gyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa sogs mdor bsdu na/ theg pa rim pa dgu'am gnyis te mtshan nyid mdo'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa ste sngags kyi sgo gnyis su 'du ba las/ da lam skabs su bab pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten 'di na kun mkhyen dang*/ /u dumbā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang nas re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'byon dka' ba ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho rnams nas rgya cher bsngags pa bzhin/ da lan dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal/ dam pa'i chos dang 'phrad/ de'ang gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa dang 'phrad de shin tu skal ba bzang po'i skabs 'dir/ o rgyan gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos khrom gter dang gsang gter sogs ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas/ gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ gu ru'i gnas chen sbas yul padma bkod bal phu yar 'brog gi mtsho nas/ gdan drangs pa'i zhi khro na raka dong sprugs zhes snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus/ skabs bab kyi zab chos khyad par can yin te/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: yang snying kun gyi gdams pa gcig dril las: zhi khro'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal yi ge'i brda ru thob:

sangs rgyas ye shes mi brjed yid la zungs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga yi dus: mi rnams blo sems bdud dang rkyen gyis g.yeng : de yi shugs las rnam smin rang sar 'khor: sdig spyod rnams la bstod pa'i rgyan bzang 'dogs: chos bzhin spyod par dma' 'bebs zhan por mthong : dam tshig can la 'dun pa'i sems ldan dman: mos gus sa bon zhe sdang me yis bsreg: thar pa'i 'ju thag chags sdang spu gris gcod: tshe rabs rten mkhar nyon mongs thog gis bshig: dge med sdig can las kyis sems can rnams: rigs drug mnar med na raka 'dam du tshud: de phyir dong nas sprugs pa'i gdams ngag mchog: skong bshags cho ga zab mo 'di nyid gces: 'di nyid mthong thos dran pa'i sems can rnams: sdig can ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa ste: kun gyi nang nas zhi khro 'di nyid gtso: 'brel tshad sangs rgyas 'thob par lung yang bstan: 'di nyid ye nas rang la gnas pa'i phyir: ngo sprod tsam gyis rang rig ngo shes te: snang srid thams cad buddha'i zhing du 'char: nam yang dran pas mi brjed gzungs thob ste: sangs rgyas zhing du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur: de bas zab pa'i mthar thug man ngag 'di: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: bdud rigs dam nyams lag tu ma shor rgya: srog bdag ki kang gza' bdud rā hu las: zab chos 'di yi bya ra lhang lhang gyis: sbas yul yar 'brog g.yu mtshoṛ atsha rgya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ da lam zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin no/ /de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ de ring gi skabs sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing*/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/

sngon 'gro yo byad gsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de ring gi skabs su lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul gzhug / de nas thun mong gi maṇḍal spyi dang khyad par gyi maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hoḥ bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dpal yon gyis: rab tu brgyan pa rig pa'i tshom bu 'di: kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ i daṃ gu ru maṇḍal kaṃ nirya ta ya mi: de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: zhes dang*/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yis gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams yang dag skal bar ldan: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje yi: dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar bla na med: gdung ba'i yid kyis 'dun pa bskyed: om̐ badzra tsitta ashtsa tt+ya hoḥ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/

'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: gdod nas rang byung ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings: bya rtsol bral ba zang thal shar ba'i lha: kun tu rol pa cho 'phrul zhi khro'i dbyings: ma 'gags klong yangs shugs kyis bdag skyabs mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pas smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bsam brjod bral ba blo bral ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma nyid: bdag med gzugs brnyan chu zla'i snang tshul bzhin: ye nas gshis lugs de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ hoḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag skyabs mchi: 'gro ba'i don phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: mos pa'i snying khar rtag tu bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi spyan snga ru/ phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi dang bsres pa'i dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: 'thung zhing bsrungs pas dngos grub brnyes: ma bsrung nyams na dmyal bar ltung : de bas ma 'da' sa ma ya: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ na ra kan i dante swā hā: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor bcug /de nas slob ma rnams kyis dbang chen dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du log 'dren bgegs tshogs bsrung ba'i phyir: sngags kyi rgya chings gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su ṣa dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan brgyad bzlas shing srung skud la bstim/ de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings la phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam chod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lngar mtshon pas kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba 'di nyid bcings pas/ phyi ltar rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing*/ nang ltar na ma dag pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs/ gsang ba ltar na dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo dbye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsten par bya ba dang : sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir: ye shes lnga yi gur khang gis: rten 'brel legs par sngags rgyas gdab: om̐ om̐ om̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: des snying po mi 'gyur bar brtan pa dang lus yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du brtan pa'i phyir om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥbris pa'i mos pa mdzod/

/ ces gnas lngar rin chen lnga dang dri'i thig le gdab la/ hūm̐: rten 'brel chen po rgyu yi mchog: rang byung lnga ldan pho brang du: phung po byin rlabs ston pa yi: sku lnga 'bras bu ye shes sgoms: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ hya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shuddho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dngos grub kyi ltas mi 'khrugs shing dag byed mchog tu dge bar byed pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ oṃ badzra ṇi tri dhi sha ke du swā hā/ pra ni ston cig / ces ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ khyed rang rnams do nub legs nyes kyi ltas mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas te seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo gtad de rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ /hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba rig 'dzin gyis: rtswa mchog 'di la gdan byas te: rten 'brel mngon 'byung brtag pa yis: kun kyang 'grub pas rdzas 'di zungs: om̐ sarba tri ṇa u ta dha ra swā hā:

de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: dkyil 'khor rigs lnga tshang ba zhig gi steng du skyer pa'i shing la mgo bo me tog rtsa ba phur bur bgyis pa'i so shing smon lam dang bcas nas dor te: da ni khyed rang rnams dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i slad du dri bzang po'i shing mgo mjug ma log pa sor brgyad pa'i rtse la me tog gi cod pan dang bcas pa/ rdo rje thal mos zungs la/ bdag la rigs dang mthun pa'i dngos grub kyi skal ba gang yod bstan du gsol snyam pa'i mos pas tshigs bcad 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas 'dor bar zhu/ hūm̐: 'byung lnga dbang po'i so shing la: las 'phro ci mchis me tog brgyan: de ring rten 'brel 'byung gyur tshogs: bden tshig don bzhin rtags la phob: om̐ mu la danta sa ma ye swā hā: zhes bden tshig dang bcas par dor bas/ dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub shar du zhi ba: lhor rgyas pa: nub tu dbang : byang du drag po: mtshams bzhir thun mong gi dngos grub phran tshegs re thob pa'i ltas yin: gal te dal gyi phyi rol du lhungs na ngan pas lan gsum du bskyar: ma phog na shin tu ngan pas dbang gi snod du mi rung ba'i ltas yin pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa dang dge ba rlabs chen bya: ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung bas: lhag par tshogs brgya sātstsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos so: / de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rang gi spyi bor nyi zla seng khri'i steng : bcom ldan rdor sems shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdog: rdo dril bsnol thabs snyems ma yum dang sbyor: rdo rje'i skyil krung longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgya g.yas g.yon 'khor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus ltem gyis gang :

tshe rabs bag chags kun dag 'od lus bsgom: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la yaḥ sogs? badzri bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rgyud ltar bya: dmigs pa ni: nub mor rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' gsal gdab cing : byol song bzhis khri btegs par bsam: mgo bo sngas khar btegs pa'i tshe: spyi bo zla ba la hūm̐: rkang mthil nyi ma dang raṃ bcas bsgom: rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas raṃ las me 'bar bas lus kun khyab: hūm̐ yig zhu nas me chen mched: phung po sgyu lus bag chags dang bcas pa tshig ste: snang stong 'ja' ltar gsal bar bsgom: de'i ngang la bzang ngan gyi 'phro mi mthud de nyal: rmi lam bzang rtags byung na las dang ldan zhing 'phro bzang ba'i brda: rmi lam ngan na las 'phro med pa'am: chos skyong gis 'khu ba yin pas: tshogs brgya dang skong bshags la legs par 'bungs dgos/ rmi lam bzang po'i ltas dang ngan pa'i ltas gang byung yang re dogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i lam 'khyer la slob pa gal che/ de dag gis zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar/ smin byed sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub pa lags pas dge ba gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo bas rgyas gdab par zhu/ bsod nams 'di? de dag gis sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub zin te dngos gzhi ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ / slob ma rnams grol/ dge bsngo shis brjod bya zhing rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug go /bka' brgyad zhi khro'i sta gon gyi le tshan no// // ༈ rigs brgya rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi dbang chog skabs 'dir bya ba 'brel chags pas 'dir 'dzud par bya'o/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma rdom̐ rje sem̐ms/

/dbyer med tham̐r pa'i lam̐m ston sku lnga'im̐ bdag /bka' drin sum ldanam̐ de la gus btud nas/ dbam̐ng bskuram̐ rigam̐s brgya'im̐ gtsugam̐ toram̐ 'di na spro/ / gnyis pa rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi dbang bskur rigs brgya'i gtsug tor bskur ba la/ thog mar rang nyid dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rang don bsnyen sgrub las gsum sngon du song nas/ gcig tu bstan 'gro'i don ched du gzhan phan gyi blos gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas sgrub gnas yid dang mthun par/ dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas mchod rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med par gzhung bzhin du 'du bya la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs sogs song nas/ gzhung gi gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar btang ste dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtog bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla/ de nas rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ gzung thag la 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ /zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas bum sgrub ched rtsa sngags sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ de nas las bum la dmigs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon gyis phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa:

khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs dang thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ ༈ rig me dor ba ni/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badzra sa ma ya swā/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/

zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bsngo smon mdor bsdus tsam byas nas dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya rnams gral du 'khod pa dang las bum chus khrus byas la/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams sogs kyi mthar las sngags dang*/ yig brgya'i mthar/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i tshogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang la/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dya swā hā/ gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/

rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas sgra dag la gsal ba'i sgo nas/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan nas don thugs nyams su bzhes te/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam pas/ sems bskyed rgya chen por gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de'ang 'o skol gyi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya'i bsam pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ skal ba'i khyad par dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa thams cad kyang bsdu na theg pa rim dgu'am/ de'ang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ste/ kun byed rgyal po las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ /'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pas bden gnyis la bzang ngan blang dor du blta ba las/ 'dir kun rdzob tu'ang chos rnams la mi gnyis pa'i bsam spyod dang ldan pas 'bras bu'i ngo bo snang stong zung 'jug gi chos skur rtogs par byas la/ ting nge 'dzin gyis goms par byed pa'i phyir 'bras bu lam byed kyis khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de ltar yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/

thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni/ /rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob tu yang dbyer med de/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /zhes dang*/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po las/ /'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la'ang gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis/ 'dir gsar ma las spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag /phyag bzhes kyi gtsug lag khang*/ zhu chen paṇḍi ta/ sgyur byed lo tsā/ zhu rten me tog /bsgyur bya'i chos kyi khyad par te/ che ba drug gis 'phags pa ni gsang sngags rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ phyi thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa kṛ yog sde gsum dang*/ nang pa thabs rgyud kyi theg pa bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen rnam pa gsum ste drug tu dbye ba'i rang skad thun mong ma yin pa las nang rgyud/ de'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las/ 'dir lha'i ngo bo rigs thams cad kyi khyab byed dang brgyud pa'i babs so'i dbang gis de gnyis ka'i rtsa bar gyur pa yin/ spyir snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa la bka' gter gyi babs so gnyis su bzhugs pa las/ 'dir bka' ma las/ bka' bab lung bstan/ smon lam dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ste/ khyad par gyi brgyud pa gsum dang*/ gtso bo brgyud thag nye zhing*/ gter yig gi dpe dpang mnga' bas khungs btsun pa dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang 'tshams par mngon du snang ba'i phyir zab lam nub pa med pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin/ de la'ang phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gter kha chen po lngar grags pa las 'di ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i chos sde ste/ gter gnas dang 'don pa'i dus rtags rten 'brel sogs ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa'am karma las 'brel rtsal la sngags srung e ka dzā ṭis mngon sum du phul ba'i chos skor yin te/

de'ang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag yin pas rgyud dang rig sngags kyi sbyor ba mtha' dag rtsa ba 'di las 'phros shing*/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i lha sngags med par ma zad rnam pa tsam du'ang rnam 'phrul bkod pa'i yon tan tshad med pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo chen po las/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan gang gis thos pa des rgyal ba mang po la sngon du bya ba byas pa yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams nyid du nges par 'byung ba yin no/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis brlab pa yin no/ /theg pa chen por nges par 'byung ba dag yin no/ /mngon par shes pa dag dang ldan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi sras su nges pa dag yin no/ /lhag mthong gi mig dang ldan pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde rgya mtshor mgrin gcig tu bsngags pas bsgrub bya'i lha khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ ngag tu brjod par bya ba'i sngags tshig la rdor sems yi ge brgya pa las dgos pa dang phan yon che ba med de/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ gsang sngags rgyal po bla med pa/ /lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /sdig pa ma lus zad byed cing*/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par gsungs/ /zhes sogs bka' dang bstan bcos las kun tu mtha' yas pa 'byung zhing*/ lugs 'di'i yang snying yig drug kyang yig brgya'i thog mtha' bsdus pa yin pas ches zab la rgyu mtshan de dag gis sngags kyi cho ga yi ge brgya pa dang mi 'brel ba ni ma mchis pas sgrub thabs kyi sngags khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ de la'ang dam pa rigs brgya/ zhi ba zhe gnyis/ de nyid rigs lnga/ gsang chen rigs gcig sogs su sgrub pa'i tshul rgya cher 'byung ba las/ de'ang rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying por/ mkha' dkyil dwang ma'i dbyings nyi zla/ /ye shes rgyal po stangs dpyal bsgom/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun/

/ma lus pa ni bsgom par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa rgyud kyi khungs kyis zin cing lha gcig bsgoms pas dkyil 'khor thams cad bsgom par 'gyur ba yin par ma zad/ 'di'i bskyed rim gyi cha rnams ma hā/ rdzogs rim thun mong ba rnams rgyud lung gnyis ka ltar ston cing*/ khyad par du thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim a ti yo ga ltar ston pas bskyed rdzogs gsum dril gyi man ngag shin tu zab cing 'dril ba 'o ma'i nang gi rtsi mar lta bu 'di nyid/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi ti ka rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol zhes mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la bgo skal du gdams pa'i zab chos tshig nyung zhing don gsal ba/ mkhas blun bar ma'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gis khyer bde zhing phan thogs pa/ grol ba bzhi ldan de nyid kyi cha lag rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la'ang slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis thog mar dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi: dkyil 'khor smin pa'i dbang mchog dag: dam ldan bu la gnang ba stsol: phyin chad bskyed rdzogs rgyud la gnas: de nas dris lan gdab pa dang chabs cig tu dam tshig rdo rje'i mna' chu sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ ho/ khyed rnams skal ldan dam tshig can/ /las can bu la dbang mchog sbyin/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu/ /dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs 'thob/ /

zhes bdud rtsi blud/ dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas rdo rje'i bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a mṛ ta sa ma ya i dante na ra kan/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar lha dang bla ma dbyer med par bcom ldan 'das/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku lnga rigs 'dus zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid chen por bzhugs pa'i/ ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dgongs klong zab gsal nyag gcig tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed dman pa rnams theg chen byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang*/ spang blang gi chos thams cad blo bral stong gsal mnyam yangs chen por sdom zhing ye bsrungs chen por gzhol bar bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun gyis bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes de dag gis rgyud sbyong ba rnams legs par grub ste/ dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum legs par sdoms la/ sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ badzra a mṛ t swa bhā w khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa stong par sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las 'og min mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i gdan pad zla'i gdan la/ rang nyid bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ yum dbyings phyug ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ yab yum sku la 'od lnga'i drwa bas mdzes pa'i klong du 'ja' tshon las grub pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong shig shig mer mer du bkra ba la/ rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams sogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad mkha' la sprin gtibs pa ltar lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ de ltar yongs su gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams 'og min mngon par dga' ba nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs rtsa gsum rab 'byams spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rnam dag chos sku g.yo med spros bral las: sna tshogs longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: gnyis bsdus sprul pa 'gro don yid snang phyir: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du gshegs su gsol: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥ oṃ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa dzñā na a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang bar badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/

arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas/ rin po che'i bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ hūm̐: chos sku bum pa'i lto ba ru: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyi brlabs pa yin no/ / de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni bhandha thogs la/ bhandha bde ba chen po'i pho brang du bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i dkar dmar gyi/ byang sems bhandhar 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par mos la/ hūm̐: thabs shes bhandha mtshan ldan 'di: bdud rtsi'i sngags phreng gsung dbyangs rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi mgrin par bskur: bzlas brjod sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi myangs pas rtsa thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ des gsung gi dbang thob cing ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug sgra skad thams cad grags stong 'gag med bcom ldan 'das/ dpal rdo rje sems pa'i gsung mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /de nas sngags kyi rjes gnang gi ched du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ba zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod pa'i/ brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung gi ngo bor dag pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: yig brgya brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin par 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar byin gyis rlobs/ / lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag pas/ snying kha'i sngags phreng rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig / shes rab ye shes ni/ bde stong dbyer med mtshon byed me long sindhū ra'i thig le snying gar byugs pas gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i shes rab ma snyems ma'i ngo bor pang du 'khod par bsams la/ hūm̐/ 'di bsten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi lam/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyas par shog /karma mu dra dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/ /zhes 'du shes gsum ldan gyis rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba brtan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atmā kau3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/

thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs su lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad bde ba chen po/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag nas rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes zab gsal ka dag gi ngo bo/ me long g.ya' bral lta bu rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa dang bcas te cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de'i don gsal stong rang bzhin gyis ma grub par/ rtsal snang 'gag med du 'char ba'i shel rdo 'di nyid kyi mtshon dpe bstan pa la gsan 'tshal/ hūm̐: shel rdo chos dbyings dkyil 'khor te: bde stong yan lag ngo sprod rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi snying gar bskur: yongs rdzogs ka dag dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyis bsags pa'i bag chags kyi dri ma dag /lam khregs chod thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang gsum yongs rdzogs 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor snod rin chen gzhal yas khang du/ gtor ma rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'/ rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ sgo gsum bya byed dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ dbang bzhi cig car du thob/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las rab 'byams kyis gzhan don sgrub pa la dbang*/ snang grags rig gsum yi dam lha'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las/

mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor los byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐: gnyis med rmad byung yon tan rdzogs: kun 'dus gtor ma phrin las dbang : skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs bskur: las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de dag gis dbang bzhi'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pa la/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas shis par brjod pa'i glu dbyangs sgrogs shing me tog manda ra ba'i char phab pas dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: chos sku 'gro 'dul longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul thabs mkhas der ston pa: skal ldan bu la smin byas nas: 'gro 'dul re skong bkra shis shog: de nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ /rdom̐ rjem̐'i ye shes rgyud la 'jug pa'i thabs/ /rgyal sras semam̐s dpam̐' rnams kyi phyag srol rmad/ /gsaṃng sngaṃgs spyi dang mthun par bsdebs 'di yang*/ /bstanaṃ pa 'dziṃn skyong spel ba'i btsas su smon/ gnyis pa rdor sems 'khor 'das rang grol gyi dbang gi le'u tshan no// // ༈ zhim̐ khraum̐'i rol gar dmam̐ pam̐'i 'khor lo bsgyur/ /rim̐gs brgyam̐'i khyab bdag bla ma la btud nas/ /dbam̐ng chem̐n 'gro ba kun grol dngom̐s gzhim̐'i khrigs/

/bde gshegs snying po smin pa'i gsos su spel/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba'i/ sta gon sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba bsham bkod la/ mdun stegs khebs ldan gyi khar/ zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa'am/ ma 'byor na lha grangs tshom bur bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa/ gsang thod/ me long*/ shel rdo sogs dbang bzhi brtsegs thabs su dgod/ mdun rgyab gang bder/ kun bzang zhi ba'i gtor ma la gdan gor mo sum brtsegs pad 'dab bcu drug mar sbub/ de steng pad 'dab brgyad yar gzed pa'i steng*/ zhi gtor pad 'dab bzhis mtshan pa bzhag /mdun du rmad byung gtor ma'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka /chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos srung gtor ma/ byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsam te chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham byas la/ gzhan yang gang bder mig dar/ me tog /dam chu/ ming yig /phur pa/ gser thur/ dor ra/ phyag shing*/ sngon gtor bcas sngon 'gro'i yo byad ma tshang pa med par 'du bya/ de nas lha tsaka la/ kun bzang yab yum/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sems dpa' yab yum brgyad/ thub pa rigs drug /sgo ba bzhi/ dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum/ sgo ma bzhi/ che mchog he ru ka /dbyings phyug ma/ khrag 'thung yab yum lnga/ kau rī ma brgyad/ siṃ ha ma brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ sgo ma bzhi/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ prog zhu/ cod pan/ stod g.yogs/ ga shal/ rus rgyan/ snyan rgyan sogs gdu bu rnams/ smad dkris/ gtor ma/ gzung thag rdo rje/ gser gyi 'khor lo/ dung dkar/ rdo rje rgya gram/ dril bu/ hom gzar blugs/ pad phreng ngam sngags byang*/ shel gyi mchod rten/ sgrub gtor/ kun bzang yab yum/ rdo rje/ bhandha/ me long ngam 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim/

rig ma/ shel rdo me long*/ sgro mdangs thig le tshom bu/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ sogs ma tshang ba med par gzhung bzhin 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sgrub pa dang bskur ba gnyis las/ thog mar sgrub pa la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs sogs song nas/ zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga bla med snying po skyabs sems nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed mchod bstod kyi bar btang ste dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes se gol gtog pas gsal gdab la bdag mdun dbyer med du dmigs nas dzap bskul dang bsnyen dmigs mthar bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum sgrub pa ni/ om̐ bhrūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐: ho paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa: de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang phyi nang zang thal mtha' dbus kyi tshad dang bral bar: lto ba che zhing zlum pa: mchu 'phyang zhing g.yel ba: zhabs zhum la mdzes pa: kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing dang sgro mdangs me long rdo rje gzung gi thag pa dung dmar bdud rtsi dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la: chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing ka: zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i pang du yum kun tu bzang mo dang gnyis med du 'khril ba: 'khor du rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa: phyi'i sgo srung bdud rtsi 'khyil ba hūm̐ mdzad dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang ldan pa: dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs:

om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing lus gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las kun bzang gis dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ ye shes pa 'od du zhu ste dam tshig gi bum lha dang dbyer med par gyur: sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te gzhal yas khang bum nang gi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas thugs kar sngags phreng 'khor zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te snod bcud thams cad zhi ba yab yum gyi sngags sgra dang bcas pas gang : spro bsdu yis las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub par gyur:

ces bum pa bskyed cing spyi dril sngags rnams bzla/ de nas las bum la dmigs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon gyis phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ rjes su dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying dang*/ de nas mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu'i mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas thun mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa lhun grub dbyings klong nas: zhi ba yab yum lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang rten 'brel dam tshig nyams pa bshags: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang : sna tshogs phrin las lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi:

zhes thun gtor 'bul/ bdag 'jug gi ched du rig pa'i me tog dor ba ni/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badzra sa ma ya swā/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ /gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ / zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ bka' srung mgon po dang dregs dpung sogs spyi dang bye brag gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bskur ba la/ sta gon sngon du song bas slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig ma rig nyon mongs bdud: snang ba bdag bzung bgegs kyi tshogs: gang shar 'dzin med gtor ma longs: bdag med chos sku'i klong du dengs: ci ste dgag sgrub 'gong srid na: bdag nyid 'od gsal snying po yis: ye shes lnga yi rtsal chen 'gyed: kun brtags phung por thug 'phrad gtor: gnyug mar ro gcig gdams ngag 'debs: tha mal shes pa'i zhen pa bcom: de bas a 'thas phyir dengs shig: om̐ sarba e haṃ swa bhā dharma dhā tu arbhe badzra dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyon mongs shes sgrib u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: bzang ngan lta ba ma rig tshogs: ye nas nyid med gshis lugs gcig: nga bdag re dogs las rlung kun: dbyings rig lta bas mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ slob dpon shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ sgo ba chen po dgongs su gsol: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: snod ldan bdag cag 'jug pa'i slad: lta ba rang rig 'char sgo phyes: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal ba 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams las kyi pho nya'i rigs: snod ngan ma rungs 'joms byed cing : ma dag srid 'khrul rab tu 'thar: de bas khyed rnams snod ldan nam: zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing rigs dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ nged rnams dam tshig las 'phro can: mos gus dag 'dun snod dang ldan: de phyir sgo skyong che rnams kyis: shes rab rang gsal sgo phyes 'tshal: mi 'da' rdo rje'i bkar gnas so: zhes zhus pas phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pa la nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces pas sgo dbye la nang du spro ba dang bcas 'jug pa la phyir 'brang gi bgegs rdo rje ging chen rnams kyis bskrad pa'i las mdzad par mos mdzod/ sgo drung du ging dkar nag gis rdo thun thogs te/ rngam stabs ha ha dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te phyir 'brang gi 'byung po bskrad/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan 'jug nas smin grol la: gnod pa'i log 'dren gang yin pa: phyung brdeg thun gyis tshar chod cig: om̐ kro ta kro ti hūm̐ hūm̐ ghṛ wa ging ka ra ya gnod byed 'byung po 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs tshogs raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas ging chen bco brgyad kyis thun brdeg cing dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bgegs 'joms: gang phyir dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'dir 'jug pa rnams/

bgegs bskrad pa dang dam tshig ma blang gi bar gdong gsar mi 'jug: de nas yol ba'i phyi nas las kyi slob dpon la zhu ba ni: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir: dpa' bo chen po'i bka' stsal 'tshal: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/ hoḥ 'di ni ka dag ye shes dbyings: bde gshegs zhi khro'i pho brang ste: khyed rnams snod mchog ldan lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ gsang sngags rlabs chen dkyil 'khor la: mos pa'i bdag cag cis mi dad: skal ldan bdag la gnang ba stsol: phyin chad dam tshig srog ltar bzung : de nas ye shes lnga'i dar thag ring po'i sne mor slob ma rnams kyis bzung ste/ slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i lam la khrid de nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ e ma nga ni bde gshegs he ru kaḥ bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan 'jug phyir ye shes lam du shog: ma dag the tshom mchis rnams phyir dengs shig: om̐ ma ma ru tra shag pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces rig pa ye shes kyi lam du khridapar mos de gral du 'khod par/ sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i gdong g.yogs re bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsakṣu bhandha ma na wā ra hūm̐/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas/ phyag rten du u dum wā ra la sogs pa mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig:

om̐ puṣpe siddhi hūm̐: 'o/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i mched lcam rnams gson cig /de'ang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa la dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di la ma brten par thabs gzhan gyis bsgrub mi nus shing*/ lus rten 'di'ang rnyed par dka' zhing*/ 'jig par sla/ dam pa'i chos dang 'phrad pa ni de bas kyang dka' zhing*/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba ni u dumbā ra'i me tog ltar ches rnyed par dka' ba yin la/ da res nges pa'i theg pa gsang chen bla na med pa 'di lta bu'i sgor zhugs su yod pa ni/ skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin pas 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams la tshad dang mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can gyi khams kyang de dang 'dra/ de thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med la thams cad kyang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med par sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras sha stag la 'khor mo yug tu spyod cing thar pa'i dus med pa la/ mi bzod pa'i byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ de rnams bdag kho nas 'khor ba dang ngan song las bsgral te/ thar pa bla na med pa khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya snyam du/ thugs bskyed la rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis gsan 'tshal/ gsan bya'i chos gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i rang skad theg dgu'i rtse rgyal yo ga rnam pa gsum du grags pa las/ 'dir rgyud lung man ngag gsum ka'i dgongs bcud gcig tu dril ba rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen rnam pa gsum gyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams chag skong zhing rtog sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ sems can thams cad ngan song gi sdug bsngal las drangs nas bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi skal ba can du byed pa'i thabs mchog rmad du byung ba/ rnal 'byor spyi khrus na raka dong sprugs mtshams med lnga sbyong gi dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/

de'ang 'gyod tshangs kyi rgyal po 'di nyid ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngon 'dod khams kyi gnas 'di na bram ze dung gi phreng ba can zhes bya ba rig pa'i gnas lngar byang ba zhig la slob ma rgyal po'i bu zhig yod pa des slob sbyong rnams mthar phyin pa na/ da ni nga'i gong na rig par smra ba slob dpon 'di tsam du zad pas/ 'di nyid gong du mi gtong snyam nas slob dpon la mi mtshams pa'i las rngam po ches tho brtsams shing*/ slob dpon gyis kyang rang gi slob ma rgyal po'i phru gu des phrag dog gis sbyor ba byas par shes te/ zhe sdang gis dmod bor bas las des gnyis ka ngan song du ltung nas sdug bsngal drag pos nyam thag par gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis de nyid 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ kun tu bzang po'i byin rlabs las dpal rdo rje sems dpar sprul nas de la 'gyod tshangs kyi bshags pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bstan pas sngon gyi bag chags dang rnam smin dran te 'gyod pa drag po skyes pa la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi byin rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po mngon par sprul nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ bram ze dang rgyal bu de'i byang chub kyi myu gu sngo skam du gyur pa slar yang gsos nas kun gzhi byang chub kyi sems dang 'phrad de 'bad pas rig 'dzin gyi sa la rim gyis gnas par gyur to/ /chos tshul zab mo de nyid mi'i yul du byung ba'i tshul ni/ thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad na/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/ ri ma la ya'i rtser rigs can drwa ma lnga la chos 'khor bskor ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ rgyal po dzaḥl rmi ltas bdun mngon du snang ba las/ dngos su tant+ra sde bco brgyad dang kalpa dum bu'i rgyud sogs kyi glegs bam char du babs/ des ku ku rā dza sogs la bshad cing rim par brgyud pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas dga' rab rdo rje la a ti yo ga'i skor rnams gnang*/ des shrī singha la brgyud/ snga phyi thams cad sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po la bka' babs/ de nyid gdong dmar bod kyi mgon du byon nas gsang chen theg pa'i chos 'khor dpag tu med pa bskor nas/ bod yul la sku dngos kyis 'dul ba'i mdzad pa mthar phyin du nye ba'i skabs shig /mnga' bdag yab sras dang*/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs kyis gser g.yu'i maṇḍal phul nas khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin dus skabs ma mchis shing*/ sngon chad kyang theg pa phyi nang gi chos kyi sgron me dpag tu med pa thugs la btags mod kyang*/ da rung yang bdag cag rje blon grogs 'bangs rnams dang ma 'ongs snyigs dus 'gro ba rnams kyi don du theg pa phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyi 'gag don gcig tu dril nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i chos/ yun ring por dka' spyad snying rus kyi 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par/ thos pa tsam gyis grol ba'i chos zab cing nyung la don 'dus pa zhig bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon chen pos/ skal ldan rje 'bangs rnams la/ so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i zhi khro'i bskyed rdzogs mang du bstan cing phal cher ma 'ongs pa'i don du zab mo'i gter du sbas pa las/ khyad par du gyur pa 'di nyid ni/ gzhung las/ e maḥ rgya gar mkhas pa padma 'byung gnas ngas: yang zab bcud mchog snying gi thig le las: na raka dong sprugs zhi khro'i gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed brda yis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang smon lam thob: khyad par lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mtha' med 'khor ba'i sems can las ngan rigs: mi dge'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zad mtha' med:

rigs drug gang yang duḥkha'i rang bzhin nyid: mi bzod srid pa'i me 'obs dong chen du: lhung ste yun ring mnar med myong ba rnams: mthong thos dran rig thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis: bzod glags med par snying rje'i rtsal phyung bas: brtse chen rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'dren pa'i thabs: na raka dong sprugs cho ga 'di kho na: cho ga'i gsal 'debs tshig tsam thos pas grol: dkyil 'khor ngo sprod rgyud tsam mthong bas grol: bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs don tsam bsgoms pas grol: gzungs sngags snying po lus la btags pas grol: byin rlabs bdud rtsi ro bcud myong tsam grol: theg chen lta ba'i dgongs pa gtad tsam grol: 'khor 'das chos sku rang bzhin ye nas grol: 'di ni thog ma'i kun bzang dgongs bzhed de: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lam nyid rten 'brel gnad: sdig can btsan thabs mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i chos: zhi khro 'dus pa'i cho ga 'di yin pas: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: khyad par sdig can rnams la 'di nyid zab: yang mtha' long med skye 'chi dbang gyur tshe: nges don gshis lugs rtogs pa'i slob dpon gyis: 'di yi cho ga dkyil 'khor cha tshang rnams: tshar gcig bsags pa'i bsod nams dge tshogs ni: rgya che nam mkha'i gting dpag gzhal dang mtshungs: rgya che'i theg pa gaṅgā'i bye ma yang : smos pa'i grangs ni brtsi bar tshad kyis rigs: 'di yi phan yon brjod par mi nus te: de phyir lnga brgya tha mar dmigs gtad nas: bcud kyi yang snying gdams zab sbas pa yin: 'di la 'brel tshad sangs rgyas 'thob pa ni: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pas lung yang bstan: de bas yang mtha' nyi shu'i bskal pa ru: lo tsā mchog gyur sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba rigs ldan o rgyan rtsa gsum gling : rig 'dzin thugs sras de la 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin chos thams cad kyi mdo 'gag dril nas/ zab chos zhi khro na raka dong sprugs zhes bya ba grol ba drug gi gzhan las khyad par 'phags shing*/

gang 'brel thams cad don chen dang ldan pa'i chos de lta bu zhig bdag la yod kyang*/ gdul bya blo chung ba theg dman gyi rigs skal med log lta dang the tshom can gyi blor mi shong nas slar skur pa 'debs pas ngan song du 'phen pas na/ khyed rnams kyis rlung phyogs tsam yang gzhan la ma bsgrag cig zhes gsungs te lo tsā ba sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skal bar gnang*/ ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba bsod nams dman pa rnams la dgongs te/ mtsho rgyal brda'i yig ger btab nas sbas yul padma bkod kyi/ byang sgo bal phu yar 'brog gi mtshor gter du sbas/ phyis dus la bab pa'i tshe lo tsā ba de nyid kyi skyes mtha'/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal lam/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos skor gyi gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan/ rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa/ rin po che ru bya'i mdog can sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ sgo dang po la rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang*/ zhi khro na raka dong sprugs phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu dang bcas pa bzhugs pa/ sgo bar pa la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ sgo 'og ma la dregs pa srog thig nag po'i man ngag lag len dang bcas pa 'di gcig pu glegs bam sa bcu'i grangs ldan dang*/ sku tshab padma mthong grol/ dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu/ a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ gu ru'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu/ las phur bdud dpung zil gnon/ mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi na bza' gos ber mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs khrom tshogs chen po'i dbus su ngo mtshar bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma dang bcas spyan drangs pa'i nang gses/ kun bzang zhi ba'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs zhes bya ba gsang ba las kyang ches gsang bar gyur pa ste/ gter gzhung las/ ma 'ongs mtha' yas 'gro 'dren phyir:
