yang zab gsang ba thig le'i chos: a ti kun bzang bla ma 'di: nges don gsang ba mkha' 'gro gcig brgyud ma: thugs rje mi zad 'byin pa'i gter chen po: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam zab 'di: ma 'ongs 'phrad pa'i skal ldan las can rnams: tshe 'dir 'ja' lus yi dam lha'i zhing du: mngon rdzogs thog ma'i mgon po de dang mnyam: 'di nyid nyams len sgrub brtson bgyis tsam gyis: sdig can shan pa las ngan yin gyur kyang : mtho ris gnas su bgrod par the tshom med: zhes dang*/ phyi rabs ma 'ongs sems can don: na raka dong sprugs gdams pa bzhag: thos grol gnad kyi gzer bu nyid: 'di yi gdams ngag thebs gyur na: skad cig sangs rgyas the tshom med: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ na raka dong sprugs kyi gdams ngag /kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi thig le/ ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i snying khrag /tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i lam zab/ sdig can btsan thabs su grol ba'i man ngag thos pa tsam gyis ngan song gi skye sgo gcod pa/ go ba tsam gyis bde chen gyi sa la gshegs pa/ don yid la byed pa rnams ni lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyi grol ba'i dpal la sbyor ba/ tha ma mtshan tsam thos pas kyang thar pa'i sa bon theb zhing rim gyi grol bar 'gyur ba'i zab chos bla na med pa 'di nyid/ steng na bla ma brgyud pa'i zam ma chad/ bar na byin rlabs kyi sprin phung la dam sel gyi rlung gis ma gtor/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya ma zhig 'brel tshad don ldan khyad par du 'phags pa kun bzang zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ sta gon gyi chos rnams grub la dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/

de la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub ste/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes thun mong gi maṇḍal spyi dang khyad par gyi maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang ba zhu/ hoḥ rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: 'khor dang bcas la bdag lus kyi: dbang po'i maṇḍal 'bul lags na: bdag cag 'jug smin gnang ba stsol: om̐ badzra bhi dho bi shwa maṇḍa la bhrūm̐: de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas/ bka' yi gnang ba sbyin pa ni 'di la gsan pa'i khyab par gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams yang dag skal par ldan: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje yi: dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar bla na med: gdung ba'i yid kyis 'dun pa bskyed: om̐ badzra tsitta ashtsa tt+ya hoḥ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/

'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: gdod nas rang byung ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings: bya rtsol bral ba zang thal shar ba'i lha: kun tu rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i dbyings: ma 'gags klong yangs shugs kyis bdag skyabs mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pas smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bsam brjod bral ba blo bral ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma nyid: bdag med gzugs brnyan chu zla'i snang tshul bzhin: ye nas gshis lugs de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ hoḥ chos dbyings lhun grub dag pa'i zhing : kun bzang zhi khro gshegs su gsol: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol khyod la don phyag 'tshal: 'gags med shar grol dbang pos mchod: zang thal kun rig khyod la bstod: dgag sgrub gnyis 'dzin mthol lo bshags: khregs chod lta ba'i chos 'khor bskor: lhun grub bde stong dge ba bsngo: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/
/rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /

dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni bla med byang chub chu: myong zhing dkyil 'khor srog ltar zungs: nyams na mnar med duḥkha myong : dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya khaṃ i dante na ra kan: de ltar khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag kyang snying gi dkyil du babs pas gal te dam tshig las 'gal na rakṣa kro ta zhes snying khrag 'thung zhing nyams thag par 'gyur la/ bsrungs na ye shes sems dpar gyur te snying khar byin gyis brlab cing 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus kun ster bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas me tog dor ra'am/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya ste/ de nas dar tshon gang rung gi me tog gam tsam pa ka'i me tog srin mdzub bar 'dzin la/ sgo skyong rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bden tshig brjod pa'i mos pa dang bcas langs te thal mo sbyar bzhin 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ che ba'i mchog dag 'gro ba'i mgon: bla med dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i gtso: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bdag la dgongs: bdag ni tshe rabs lha btsal lo: zhes brjod pa dang*/ phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phyes la rigs kyi lha gang yin pa dang sprad par mdzod cig ces gsol ba 'debs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ shar phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: zhi zhing byams pa'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badzra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ lho phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: rgyas shing snying rje'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ ratna pra we sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ nub phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: dbang dang dga' ba'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ padma pra we sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: btang snyoms drag po'i sgo phyes la:

tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ karma pra we sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ pho brang dkyil 'khor chen po yi: dbus su 'khod pa'i lha yi tshogs: bdag gi tshe rabs sgrub pa yi: yi dam gang yin de dang sprod: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhā ra ā li kā li ye swā hā: zhes brjod pa dang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la khyed rang rnams kyis sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid/ ngo bo gcig la gtso 'khor du snang bar/ bzang ngan rang rgyud pa med kyang rang gi tshe rabs sngar nas las 'phro'i bag chags bzhag pa'i lha nyid la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i mos pa gyis la/ tshig 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas ltos med du 'dor bar zhu/ ming yod na 'dogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bab pa'i ming shar du babs na zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po'i lha nas dras la gsang ming gdags/ slar yang me tog de nyid dbang rtags cod pan gyi tshul gyis spyi bor bcings pas/ lha so so'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub thob song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: sna lnga'i cod pan spyi bor brgyan: deng nas lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid: yang dag mchog reg 'dzin par gyis: oṃ gu ru bhi dho dhe wa dhā ra ni: u ta ra badzra tsitta hūm̐: zhes pas spyi bor dgod/ bla mas/ khyed ma 'ongs pa'i dus ming gang yin gsung rtsar: slob mas/ hoḥ sangs rgyas padma'i snying po ye shes gsal byed bya ba'o/ /zhes sogs rigs kyi ming gang yin pa smros shig / de nas phur pa lag tu gtad de: hoḥ bla med snying po'i gsang phur 'di: yang dag dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i phyir: phrin las lnga yi rten du 'chang : deng nas srog ltar sgrub brtson bzung : oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya a nu ta ra maṇḍal la bhandha hūm̐: de nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐: tshe rabs las sad smon lam ldan: deng 'dir zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi: yi dam lha dang skal ba mnyam:

nam yang de dag la gnas shog: oṃ puṣpe su pra tiṣṭha badzra satwaṃ: de nas 'jug pa'i bya ba rnams song nas/ dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so/ oṃ swa bhā wshuddho3 haṃ/ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes zang thal rgya yan lhun grub tu gnas pa: de'i rang dbyings kyi dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma a las zla ba ste: gdan sum brtsegs spel ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig mthing ga nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa: de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spros: tshur 'dus pas rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo: bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing 'od baiḍūrya'i mdangs dang ldan pa: zhal rab tu 'dzum la thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs pa: dbu'i gtsug tor mtho zhing nor bu ltar 'phags pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis mnyam par bzhag cing : zhabs bde stong skyil mo krung gis 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa: de'i pang du dbyings phyug kun tu bzang mo sku mdog dkar gsal shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdangs bzang ltar cher 'bar zhing mdzes 'dzum chags pa: phyag gnyis kyis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing : zhabs gnyis kyis zung 'jug sked la 'khril ba: mkha' gsang ye shes kyi phyag rgyas bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs bskul ba'o: chos sku kun tu bzang po'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'bar ba khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs:

mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor dag pa rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs: gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs: ba spu'i bu ga rnams su sprul pa dang nyid sprul/ zhi ba dang khro bo nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrigs pa: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams gsal 'tsher mdzes pa: khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams sgeg bzhad dgyes la rngam pa: de ltar bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i klong du ye shes gar dgu rol pa'i cho 'phrul dang bcas te gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swāḥ gsang bar hāḥ ste sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas rol mo bya zhing spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen zhing : rang snang ma 'gags rtsal bcu'i pho brang nas: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i klong yangs shugs kyis gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir dbang bskur stsol la byin chen phob: om̐ dharma sa manta bha dra dzñā na a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/

zhes de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de/ ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med rang byung gdan la bzhugs: om̐ḥ gnyis med sprul sku la phyag 'tshal: hrīḥ phyi nang yid spyod mchod pa 'bul: hoḥ lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa bshags: trāṃḥ chos 'khor bskor zhing dbang bskur stsol: de nas slob ma rnams kyis mig dbye ba'i ched gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ sa mkhan chen po 'gro ba'i mgon: bdag gi rab rib mun pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir gtso bos bsal bar stsol: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig / slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la: hoḥ nga ni ye shes sman pa'i rgyal: khyod kyi ma rig ling thog tshogs: shes rab lta ba'i thur mas bsal: phyin chad zang thal la gnas shog: om̐ badzra tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong ba'i mthong ba bstan pa dang*/ don ngo sprod par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bla med gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'di: ya mtshan che ba'i pho brang ste: mjal bas spro zhing thugs drin bstsal: 'di don ngo sprod gnang ba stsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du/

slob dpon gyis/ de ltar glo bur gyi sgrib pa bsal nas rnam dag ye shes kyi mig thob pas bla med yang dag ye shes kyi rol pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod dang ldan: ye nas rang byung lta ba'i klong : rang gsal ngo mtshar cher bstan no: om̐ dzñā na maṇḍa la shū n+ya ta ātma ko3 haṃ: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid mchog rig: dam chos ye shes lnga ru myong : snying po dwangs ma'i srog ltar bsrung : dge dang smon 'dun mi 'bral gnas: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams snod ldan ya mtshan can: sngon dbang bag chags sad pa'i bu: bdag gis ngo sprod dal du 'jug: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs smin par bskur: om̐ ma hā a nu bhā wa ye swā hā: de nas slob ma bde chen gyi lam la 'khrid pa ni: slob dpon gyis phyag shing thogs la/ hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i pho brang chen po 'di: thog mar rlung lnga'i steng du chags pa ni: phung po lnga po gnas su dag pa'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram rab tu brtan pa ni: ting 'dzin dbyings la 'gul bskyod med pa'i brda: bhrūm̐ yig gnas gyur zhing rang byung shugs las grub pa ni: chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin la gdangs rtsal ma 'gags pa'i brda: gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa ni: tshad med bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i brda: rin po che'i rtsig pa sna lnga ni: ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda: 'dod snam dmar po lha mos brgyan pa ni: tshogs drug sgyu mar rtogs pa'i brda: pha gu ser la drwa ba dkar ba ni: nyon mongs pa dag nas ma rig pa'i bdud bzhi bcom pa'i brda: shar bu bskyod cing mda' yab dkar ba ni: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: 'phan dar 'phyang zhing g.yer kha'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i sgra grags stong yin pa'i brda:

ka ba brgyad dang ka zhu ldan pa ni: rnam par thar pa brgyad dang thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i brda: gdung ma bcu drug bres pa ni: stong nyid snying rje bcu drug dang ldan pa'i brda: mu men gyi dral lcam btags pa ni: rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa'i brda: thog steng thams cad brdal khyab tu phub pa ni: rim dgu'i lta ba ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: rta babs rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa ni: byang chub kyi lam bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i brda: ri dwags kyis chos sgra nyan pa ni: kun tu snang ba'i chos thams cad brdar bstan pa'i brda: mthongs skar nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa ni: dbang po'i sgo dgu shar grol yin pa'i brda: chos 'khor bcu gsum la gdugs tog gis mdzes pa ni: rdo rje theg chen sa mchog rgyun gyi rtse mo yin pa'i brda: thog steng 'phan dang gdugs kyis brgyan pa ni: sna tshogs ma 'gags shing sgyu ma'i gar dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa me ris bskor ba ni: phrin las bzhi'i mdzad pa so sor ston pa'i brda: gter bum chen po bzhi dang ldan pa ni: gnas lugs 'od gsal dbyings nas dgos 'dod ku 'byung ba'i brda: pho brang gi dbus su byol song bzhi dang nyi zla padma'i gdan spel nas brtsegs pa ni: srid pa'i rgya mtsho skems shing ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i brda: de'i steng du hūm̐ yig gnas gyur te thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun bzang wal gyis gsal ba ni: ka dag thig le chen por bya rtsol dang bral yang ye shes kyi rang rtsal ma 'gags pa'i brda: sku mdog mthing ga ru bzhugs pa ni: kun gzhi skye ba med pa'i brda: zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa ni: snang srid kun la thugs rje snyoms par gnas pa'i brda: spyan gnyis zim bus phyogs bcur gshis lugs kyis gzigs pa ni: dbyings rig thugs la mtha' dbus bral ba'i brda: spyi bor 'od dang ldan pa'i gtsug tor mtho ba ni:

mkha' dbyings zhing khams ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: snyan gshog rgyas la snyan lam yangs pa ni: grags stong gi sgra rnams sgra tshig gcig la rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag cing mtheb mos srin rtsa mnan pa ni: ka dag dgongs pa gdod nas lhun grub tu gnas shing srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor rtsol med du gzhom pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa ni: lta ba khregs chod gcig la sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i brda: kun tu bzang mo dkar gsal gyis pang du 'khyud pa ni: chos rnams ngo sprod kyi brdar drang don phyi'i theg pa thams cad lam pho nya bgrod pa'i them skas mtshon byed rnams thabs la brten dgos pa'i brda: rang bzhin gsal stong yin cing byed las gnyis su med par ston pa ni: kun gzhi rang shar yin pas shes rab yum la dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bzhi'i mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis kyis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa ni: rang rig 'od gsal lhan cig skyes dang ye nas 'khyud te 'bral blag med pa'i brda: yab yum gyi zhal sbyor nas rlung gi 'gro 'ong bsre ba ni: 'khor 'das gnyis med ro gcig tu ston pa'i brda: nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa ni: shes rab kyi ye shes ye nas bde stong dang ldan pa'i brda: mnyen cing lcug la 'jam pa ni: chags med bde ba chen por gnas shing khengs sems bral ba'i brda: zhabs gnyis kyis sked la mdud thabs su 'khril ba ni: phyag rgya drug gi 'khrul 'khor la skye med kyi gar thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda: bha ga rgyas shing nor bu'i tog gis bkag pa ni: gtum mo tsaṇḍa lī bde shas che zhing 'khrul 'khor bzhi'i rang rtsal gyis dga' ba mngon du byung ste ye shes chen po mi rtog pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i brda: yum gyi sku la 'od zer cher 'bar ba ni: lhun grub dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs pa'i brda:

kun tu bzang po'i spyi bo bde chen gyi pho brang klong du 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu bzhugs pa ni: spyi bo'i gnas su haṃ sprul sku'i zhing khams yin pas: bskyed rim rol pa'i khro tshogs sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa'i brda: mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum shar ba ni: gsang ba sgra skad grags stong gi ngo bo gnyis med dbyings rig brdas gar sgyur ba tsam yin pas: zung 'jug dag snang du gnas pa'i brda: thugs kar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni: dran rig kun gyi 'char sgo snying kha yin zhing kun gzhi la bde sdug dang bral ba'i phyir zhi bar mtshon pa'i brda: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga gsal ba ni: rlung lnga'i rang bzhin rnam shes la gnas shing thog mar srid par 'jug cing lte ba'i pho brang du chags: de'ang don la shes rab kyi rang rtsal chags med de tsaṇḍa līr gnas pa'i brda: gsang bar phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni: ye nas rang byung gi phur bu yin zhing : 'khor 'das kun gyi sgyu ma'i lam srid pa'i rdo rjer mtshon pa'i brda: 'khor yang phra men gyis bskor ba ni: mtshan mo rab rgyu 'tshogs pa'i dur khrod yin pas: las kyi ma mo gnas pa'i brda: sprul pa yang sprul zhi ba khro bo grangs med pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa ni: bskyed rim sgyu ma mkhan gyi khyad chos su mtshon pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha rnams zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan mnyen lcug 'khril ba ni: kun gzhi'i rig pa shes rab ma yi klong yin zhing : bu gsal stong 'dzin med kyi khye'u chung gzhon nu yon tan kun ldan gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i brda: khro bo'i lha rnams rngam gshe gtum la dpa' ba'i stobs rtsal shugs dang ldan pa ni: chos sku lhun grub rang byung bde chen rgyal pos 'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur nus shing : thugs rje'i rtsal dang nus shugs: byin rlabs kyi stobs: gzi byin gyi rngam:

zil gnon gyi gtum: kun 'dus kyi mthu chen po ste nyon mongs pa'i tshogs rnams bde stong rol pa'i he ru kas rab tu gshe ba'i brda: gdan yang byol song ni 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i brda: padma ni skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brda: nyi ma ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i brda: zla ba ni dri ma med pa'i brda: bam ro ni bdag 'dzin gyi ru tra bsgral ba'i brda: dbugs song zhing drod dang ma bral ba ni: chos thams cad dngos po dang mtshan nyid brjod bya mtha' las 'das pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od lug gu rgyud du gtibs pa ni: ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: khro bo'i tshogs rnams me 'od 'khrugs pa ni: shes bya'i bud shing gdos bcas bsregs pa'i brda: sngags rnams skye med kyi sgra sgrogs pa ni: rlung 'byung 'jug thams cad rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin pa'i brda: srog yig mi 'gul zhing sngags rnams 'khor ba ni: chos sku la g.yo 'gul med cing mtha' dbus dang bral yang : rang rtsal ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo kun tu rgyu zhing snyoms par mi sdod pa'i brda: sngags sgra ring ba dang thung ba ru dgod pa ni: ye shes rlung dang nyon mongs kyi rlung zung 'jug tu gnas pas 'phar bskyed che chung gi brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ru mchod pa sna tshogs bkram pa ni: rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs don gnyis zung 'jug tu rdzogs pa'i brda: drwa ba dang : ral gri phur bu: me long : mda' dar: nyi zla: 'phan gdugs: cod pan: stag sham: rus rgyan rnams kyis brgyan zhing rdo rje la sogs pa kun tshang ba ni: zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde kun gyi 'byung gnas yin zhing kun rtog brgyad bcu'am nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por sgyu ma tsam du ston pa'i brda: de la sogs pa rang gzhung chen po 'dir so sor ngo sprad na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud lung gnas kyang 'di nyid bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i ngo sprod ces bya ba yin pas:

deng phyin chad pho brang dgu ldan spel sgrub brtson gsum byed du rung ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/ nang rdo rje'i phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig kyang 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi dbang ni/ de la spyir dbang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi 'tshogs pa la brten nas go 'phang gi chos rgyud la 'jog pa ste/ dang po la'ang gnyis te de'ang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ni gdod nas rang chas su zhugs pa'i chos nyid de/ bye brag tu phung khams skye mched lhar gnas pa bum dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ ngag rlung yi ge dang bcas pa sngags su gnas pa gsang dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ khams kyi dwangs ma bde chen du 'dug pa sher dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ sems chos skur gnas pa bzhi pa'i mtshungs ldan te/ dbang mchog rgyal po'i rgyud las/ dbang mchog rang la med gyur na/ /bskur bas 'thob par ga la 'gyur/ /bra sran 'bras bu'i dbang bskur yang*/ /de la 'bras kyi dngos snang med/ /ces gsungs/ gnyis pa lhan cig byed rgyu ni/ slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas pa'i dbang rdzas khyad par can nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rkyen bzhi ni/ dad brtson brtul zhugs dang ldan pa'i slob bu rgyu'i rkyen/ slob ma'i rgyud smin nus pa'i mtshan nyid kun tshang gi slob dpon bdag po'i rkyen/ brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan zhing gzhung ltar cho ga'i yan lag tshang ba'i nus pa khyad par can dmigs pa'i rkyen/

snga ma snga mas go phyes nas/ phyi ma phyi mas 'byung zhing brda don 'phrod pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ de lta bu'i rgyu rkyen gyi chos drug 'tshogs pa la brten te go 'phang gi chos dbang gi ye shes rgyud la 'jog pa'i las kyi thar pa'i myu gu mngon du bskyed pa'am/ skye nges kyi nus rung du smin par byed pa'am/ nges tshig ni/ gtor blugs te/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'khrus pa'i cha nas gtor ba dang*/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi nus pa khyad par can 'jog pa'i cha nas blugs pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya bas/ /des na dbang zhes brjod par bya/ zhes dang*/ dbye ba ni/ spyir gang zag gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar te/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang*/ grol byed lam gyi dbang*/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste gsum du bzhag pa dang*/ rnam pa bye brag la/ ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la gsal bar byas/ /de la drug pa bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni dbang*/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyas bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ /bzhi pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes rgyud sde'i dbang gi babs so mi 'dra ba bzhir bzhag pa sogs mtha' yas kyang*/ gsang ba bla med kyi skabs 'dir/ snying po'i rgyud phyi mar/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /de ma thag pa'i bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dbang bzhir bzhag pa las/ de'ang lus kyi rtsa'i sgrib pa dag cing snang stong sku rdo rje lam khyer gyi bskyed rim dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i snod rung du byed pa dang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku'i go 'phang rgyud la 'jog byed bum dbang phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba dang*/ de bzhin ngag rlung gi sgrib pa dag cing*/

grags stong gsung rdo rje lam khyer gyi rlung sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pas bdag byin rlabs byed pa'i snod rung byed pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku'i go 'phang rgyud la 'jog byed gsang dbang nang lus dkyil lam/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba dang*/ yid thig le'i sgrib pa dag cing bde stong thugs rdo rje lam khyer gzhan lus pho nya sgom pa'i snod rung du byed pa dang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku'i go 'phang rgyud la 'jog byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba dang*/ cha snyoms shes bya'i sgrib pa dag cing rig stong ye shes rdo rje'i lam khyer/ ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang gi chos rgyud la 'jog byed tshig dbang don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba bzhir nges pa yin no/ /de ltar dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon kyang*/ gnas skabs grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo gdab pa'i snod du rung zhing*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid phrin las bzhi rdzogs kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud las/ gang zhig dbang bskur 'dzin pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sku la 'di yis reg /'di la skyes bu'i dbang thob na/ /rig pa'i sku la rang dbang thob/ /ces dang*/ snying gi me long gi rgyud las/ dbang rnams rab tu thob byas na/ /gsang sngags thams cad ma bsgrub 'grub/ /ces so/ /dbang tshul bzhin du ma thob par/ /ye shes kyi lha'i bsnyen sgrub lta ci/ rgyud tshig klog pa dang phrin las kyi tshig shar gyer ba la'ang mi dbang ste/ kṛ ya dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ /gang zhig rig sngags dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor la ni ma zhugs dang*/ /gang dag byang chub sems dang mi ldan pas/ /de yis gsang sngags bklag na phung bar 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ phyag chen thig le kha sbyor las/

dbang ma thob la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bar mar med bzhin/ /de bas dbang bskur dam pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas blang bar bya/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de'ang bla med kyi rgyud sder bum gsang sher ye tshig gi dbang bzhi grags che la/ bye brag tu yo ga gsum so so'i rang skad dang mthun par phan nus zab mo'i dbang gsum/ chu bo bzhi rdzogs kyi dbang bzhi/ spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med/ re re la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba du mar 'byung ba las/ 'di ni sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po las/ dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtogs na/ phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang*/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa sku 'bag gi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /

ces brda sbyar nas/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: sprul sku'i klong yangs bum pa zlum: yi dam sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang zhing nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇḍal 'bul: gnyis pa nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bar/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed cing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ 'og min gyi zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par du mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo yab yum las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nas rgyas pa ltar na skabs 'dir dam pa rigs brgya'i tsakli so sor phral te dbang bskur: dur khrod chas brgyad kyang so sor phral te bskur: zhes gsungs kyang kha phral ba'i bskur tshig dbang gzhung du ma gsal lo/ mchan/ 'bring po ltar na lha grangs tshom bur bskur ba ni: dang po kun bzang yab yum thogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po kun tu bzang : dbyings phyug shes rab pang du 'khril: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: bde gshegs thog ma'i sangs rgyas lngar: 'byung lnga'i gsang ye pang du 'khyud: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes lnga yi dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sems dpa' yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: 'phags mchog 'gro don byang sems brgyad: lam brgyad mthar phyin yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rnam thar brgyad ldan dbang thob shog: om̐ sarba sa twa mum̐ dā sha ṣa ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: thub pa rigs drug thogs la: hūm̐: bla med bcom ldan thub pa drug: sde snod rgya mtsho'i lung rigs 'dzin: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phar phyin drug ldan dbang thob shog: om̐ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne shākya mu na ye swā hā: sgo ba bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ba: thabs shes yab yum gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: theg pa rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra dha ra wa la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum bcu: bde stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sa bcu'i theg rtse'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bhi dho dha ra muṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: longs spyod 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma:

grags stong ngo bo gnyis med skus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grol bzhi dga' chen dbang thob shog: om̐ pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: he ru ka thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka'i: sku gsung thugs yon bla na med: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka ma ma siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum mchog thogs la: hūm̐: dbyings phyug chen mo bde chen yum: shes rab phar phyin kro ti mas: skal ldan khyod kyi pang du 'khyud: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bsgrub par gyis: oṃ kro ti bha ta ṇi gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum thogs la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po yab yum bcu: snang stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dug lnga rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ he ru ka kro ta kro ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: kau rī ma brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: kau rī ma mo chen mo brgyad: kun tu khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gnas brgyad rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ ma ma dhe wi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: siṃ ha ma brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: siṃ ha ma mo chen mo brgyad: rang bzhin klong las 'gyu ba'i ngang : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ ma tri ma ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: thugs rje'i dbang mo las byed mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed pa las bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na u ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mkha' 'gro sde lnga thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: zag med bskyed pa'i las byed mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: tsaṇḍa 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ḍākki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i sgo skyong mas:

skye gnas bzhi yi sgo gcad phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdzogs pa'i gnad bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma rā ga ho a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: bla med dpal chen he ru kaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las lhun grub dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra ku mā ra baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbang phyug nyer brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: las rnams kun gyi mtha' sdud mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: spro bsdu sbyang ba'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra shwa ri ma satwaṃ dza la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i dbang mo ches: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las bzhi mthar phyin dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra ratna padma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas zhi khro rigs brgya'i tho grangs tsam dbang khrid 'bring po'i skabs 'dir tshang ba yin: de ltar lha tshogs rnams gnas so sor thim pas/ dam pa rigs brgya'i sku'i rnam 'gyur gang dang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i rnam rol 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob pa yin no/ /de nas chas dbang bskur ba la zhi drag gnyis yod pa las/ dang po khyed rang rnams gdan gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la/ che rtags kyi mnga' gsol bas sku lnga ye shes lngar lhun gyis grub/ sa lam thogs med du bgrod cing gang 'dul longs spyod rdzogs pa'i phrin las 'dod rgu'i dpal la longs spyod/ don gnyis lhun grub khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang dam pa thob par mos shig / de nas zhi ba'i chas prog zhu thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: rin chen 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: de ring skal ldan spyi bor brgyan: lta ba ye grol dbang thob shog:

om̐ badzra ratna te si dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: cod pan thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub dbang rtags phyir: dar tshon lnga yi cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: sgom pa rgya yan dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra mu ku ṭa dha ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi yi dbang rtags phyir: sna tshogs spel ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi dpung par brgyan: spyod pa 'dzin med dbang thob shog: om̐ bhi dza ya arbha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ga shal thogs te: hūm̐: bde stong zag med dbang rtags phyir: drwa ba 'phrul gyi ga shal 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi stod du brgyan: om̐ ru pa kanthi ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gnyis pa phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du brgyan pas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur te/ dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rus rgyan thogs la: hūm̐: phar phyin drug gi dbang rtags phyir: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi chas su brgyan: grol ba bzhi yi dbang thob shog: om̐ go ro tsa ya ma li a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas snyan rgyan sogs gdub bu rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rten 'brel sna tshogs dbang rtags phyir: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan cha 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi gzugs su brgyan: sa lam rab rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das zil gnon dbang rtags phyir: bde chen bklubs pa'i ang rag 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkri: 'bras bu ka dag dbang thob shog: om̐ a tri wasatra pra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams la gsang sngags kyi dngos grub 'thob par bya ba'i phyir sgrub rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni/

sman raka gtor ma las bzhi'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyis lha rnams bsnyen cing sgrub pa sogs gsang sngags zab mo'i thabs la brten nas/ 'khor 'das thams cad 'dod yon zag med ye shes kyi rnam rol chen por longs spyod cing las bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa'i mthu thob par mos shig / de nas gtor ma gtad cing : hoḥ rgyu gcig 'bras bu gnyis rdzogs rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: don gnyis yang dag ldan pa'i ngang : dus mchod la sogs brtson par gyis: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra bha lingta ashtsa tya dha ra hūm̐: de nas rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang sbyin pa ni/ rgyal tshab 'os pa yin na khri la bzhag ste gzung thag gi rdo rje lag tu gtad/ 'og tu khri brtsegs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ dung dkar dang rdor dril blug gzar sogs phul bas theg pa rim dgu gang 'dul der ston gyi chos ston la/ 'gro ba'i don rgyun ma chad par gyis shig ces bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gzung thag rdo rje gtad cing : hoḥ deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod nyid: bla med zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor snying po 'di zungs shig: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: om̐ badzra maṇṭa tsakra sa ma ya tsitta garbha dha ra hūm̐: de nas gser gyi 'khor lo thogs la: hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: dbang bskur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: 'gro la thugs rjes smin par gyis: bla med yang dag don ston 'tshal: om̐ dharma tsakra hrīḥ.āḥhūm̐: de nas dung gtad de: hoḥ skye med grags stong chos kyi sgra: ches cher lha mi'i rang skad du: ston cing spel skyong spyod par gyis: kun la dbang bskur don ston shog: om̐ dharma ghaṇḍe shang kha āḥhūm̐: rdo rje rgya gram gtad de: hoḥ yang dag thabs mchog bde ba che: 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rab myos pa: ches cher spyod pa'i las sgyur ba: rdo rje dga' bas don ston stsol:

om̐ badzra pra mo ti ha ra ga dha ra hoḥ dril bu gtad de: hoḥ snyan ma brda skad rab bskyed pa: ches cher dbang mo'i las brtsam pa'i: mkha' yi padmo'i spun du snyeg: g.yo zhing g.yo ba khyab ston shog: om̐ pradzñā pra mo ti ri a sha su ra hūm̐: hom gzar blugs gtad de: hoḥ zla ba'i snod bzang nor bu'i rtse: mu kha tsaṇḍa mos byung ston: bskur bas las bzhi lhun gyis grub: kun kyang byed las dbang thob shog: om̐ a haṃ a hu ram̐ sa ma ya dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i glo bur rnam rtog gi dri ma gzhi la dag ste ye gzhi kun tu bzang po'i klong du sangs rgyas par gyur cig /de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ba zhal nas thon/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs nas thugs srog sa bon hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khod pas brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad gzhom med gsung gi ngo bor dag pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ / ces bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis bzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ om̐ dharma sa manta bha dra dzñā na hūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ

om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon chos sku kun tu bzang por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs ltar phog /gnyis 'dzin la pa'i sogs rtog tshogs dag /rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bor me long g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas bzhi cha sum bral gyi ngang la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ shel gyi mchod rten me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes snying po'i mdangs: rol rtsal shar ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: skal ldan snying khar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: buddha tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes snying khar bzhag /de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong bar thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: rmad byung bla med dam tshig rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub ngo bo nyid: skal ldan lte bar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: ratna ghu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa sku 'bag gi dbang bskur ba ni/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes skur gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/

sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po kun tu bzang : dbyings phyug shes rab pang du 'khril: skal ldan gsang bar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: karma gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: thabs mchog ngo bo bde zhing stong : bskyed rim sprul sku sgyu ma'i ngang : skal ldan lag g.yas rdo rje gtad: drang don bshad pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra dzñā na dharma tsakra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bhandha g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab ngo bo gsal zhing stong : ye rdzogs chos rnams mtha' bral ngang : skal ldan lag g.yon bhandha gtad: nges don bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma garbha bhandha dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long ngam 'ja' 'od gur khyim thogs la: hūm̐: sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba bzhi: 'ja' lus ye shes drwa ba'i gzugs: bskyed rim sku yi dbang bskur bas: 'ja' lus chos sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma shū n+ya ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ des snang zhing bdag med pa'i chos thams cad stong pa'i rang rtsal te/ mtshon byed kyi sgro btags pa tsam las don la bden par ma grub par ngo 'phrod nas gzugs su chags pa'i a 'thas grol te/

bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bu'i sprul bsgyur bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur bar brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas par ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim par bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rtsa gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul skur 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /gsang ba zab mo'i dbang gsum las/ / gsang dbang thun min sogs mos na zur du gsal: spyi tsam du/ gsang dbang gi ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo kun tu bzang po/ rang 'od kyi yum chos nyid kun tu bzang mo dang*/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang bde ba'i 'od zer gyis rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snyoms par zhugs/ bde ba chen po'i rgyun gtso bo yab yum gyi byang sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang 'dres pa mkha' gsang nas babs/ padma bhañdza'i snod du bskyil ba/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin par myong bas lus thams cad bde bas khyab/ snang gsum 'od gsal du thim/ rtsa thig rlung gsum ye shes su smin par mos mdzod/ de nas mgrin par bhandha thogs la/ hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung bhandha ru: sku lnga ye shes rdzas kyis bkang : skal ldan mgrin par bzhag pa yis:

zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: om̐ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi myong bas rtsa thams cad byang sems yi ge'i sprin ā li kā li'i rnam pas khengs/ 'ching byed kyi mdud pa bkrol/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs 'gags/ thig rlung 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ ngag rlung tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog dang ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ rdzogs rim a nu la brten pa'i steng sgo rnam grol gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sgra skad 'byin 'jug sngags su dag pas 'bras bu gsung rdo rje'i longs skur 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /gnyis pa sher dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'am/ yum kun tu bzang mo las rnam par 'phrul pa'i thabs mchog dpa' bo'am/ shes rab ma gzugs dang lang tsho ldan zhing rigs kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa zhig byung*/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bar/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon nam g.yas pas pho mo'i khyad par/ khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas sam g.yon du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dpang du bkod de gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: zab lam brda yi mkha' dbyings su: dgyes pa'i gsang ba sngags sde mo: khyer cig bde stong dga' bzhir rol: pho nya zung 'jug dbang thob shog: om̐ gu hya mu ṭa ha sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar yab yum 'du shes gsum gyis snyom par zhugs pas/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i 'phro 'du kun bde chen gyi dbyings su nub te/ yas bab kyi dga' ba nyams su myong*/

slar dmar cha dang bcas pa'i rlung 'pho med gyen du drangs pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lhan skyes bde stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtog tshogs tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa sbyangs shing yid sgrib dag /rdzogs rim a nu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam nas lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde sdug gang byung lhan skyes kyi ye shes su dag te/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos skur 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /de nas dbang thams cad kyi mthar thug bskur bya bskur byed las 'das pa tshig dbang rin po che/ brda dang byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis ngo sprod pa yin pas khyed rang tshos sgo gsum rang babs su klod la/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i da lta'i sems skad cig ma'i steng du rtsol sgrub bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i ngang 'bol le shig ge zhog mdzod/ de nas shel rdo me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag bde chen 'dus ma byas: kun gzhi gsal stong 'dzin med ngang : ye grol lta ba'i mchog de yi: ngo sprod dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ badzra dzñā na swa bhā dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: hoḥ des gsal stong rig pa g.ya' bral rjen ne ba: sus kyang ma bcos gang du'ang mi gnas med du mi rung smra ba'i kha las 'das pa ci bzhin pa'i ngo bo khyab brdal lhun grub 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po can de'i ngo sprod thob ste: deng phyin chad rdzogs rim 'od gsal dri med la gnas pa'i skal ldan du byas so: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ rjes 'brel du mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur ba ni: sgro mdangs thig le tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: ngo bo gsal la rang bzhin stong : rnam pa byed las dbyibs su 'das: bdag med thig le stong pa yi: ngo sprod dbang bskur stsal du gsol:

om̐ ā li kā li dha ra haṃ ga ga garbha satwaṃ: hoḥ des tshig dbang gi ye shes gsal 'debs: ma bsgoms gnas lugs rang shar: brdal khyab chos sku'i mtshan nyid: gnas lugs rig pa'i 'du tshan: gcig shes lta ba'i mthar thug: 'khor 'das nyag gcig kun tu brjod med kyi shes pa rtag chad ris su ma chad cing bya rtsol gdod nas bral te lhun grub 'dus ma byas gang de'i ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad ma bsgom ma yengs ma 'byams ma bkug ma lta ma spyod/ bya byed spang blang gi zhags pa phyal bar slod la shar grol 'bad med du byos shig: de ltar rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob nas: ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag: de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang mngon du bya ba'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ de ltar zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur rtsa ba dang yan lag gis brgyan pa legs par grub ste/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i don du bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad thogs la: om̐: dge bar gyur cig bden pa'i tshig: gang zhig bkra shis dpal 'bar ba: deng 'dir stsol te rab gnas shing : kun nas kun tu 'byung bar shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ shrī ye swā hā: zhes gtad cing mnga' gsol/ de ltar nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs bzhin par/ me tog gi char dbab pa'i dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs dus kun tu yongs su khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bkra shis brjod/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po thob pa yin pas/ de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa ni dam tshig yin te/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags srog ni dam tshig ste/ khyad par smin byed dbang dang ni/ /grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa la/ /bla ma mchog bsten 'grub gyur zhing*/ /de yi rtsa ba dam tshig srungs/ /zhes dang*/ gzhung las/ hoḥ de ltar bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka ste nyid zhi rol ba'i cho 'phrul gyi rang rtsal zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen legs par thob pa yin pas: gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sba bar 'os pa rnams gnas khang gi phyi rol du yang mi tshor bar bya: sku'i dam tshig yi dam lha'i bskyed rim dang mi 'bral: gsung gi dam tshig bzlas brjod bsnyen pa la rab tu brtson: thugs kyi dam tshig rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs dran shes dang bag yod kyis rgyun du gnas par bya: yon tan gyi dam tshig sbyang spel spro bsdu la sogs gegs sel bogs 'don gyi nyams len bya zhing rgyun du dben pa'i gnas su 'grim par bya: phrin las kyi dam tshig nya stong dus drug la sogs su 'os pa'i mchod tshogs skong bshags rgyun du ma chag par bya: gsang ba'i dam tshig ni: dbang rtags kyi mtshan gzhan du mi bstan: dkyil 'khor gyi lha'ang gsang dbang bde stong ye shes gud du sbas te: tha mal gyi lam log lta can la zur yang mi bshad: tshogs gtor dang dam rdzas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen thams cad dbul po dang bya khyis mi mthong bar bya: sgrub pa'i tshe gzhan la gdong mi bstan: lha 'di bsgrub ces tshad mi bor: bsnyen sgrub la dum bu mi bgo: sgrub pa kun gyi mjug tshang la mtha' dril bar bya: rjes bsngo smon khyad 'phags kyis mtshams sbyar: khyad par gyi dam tshig ni: dbang lung khrid gsum zhus te dam rdzas lce ru myang bas:

rdo rje slob dpon de sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed: skyon mtshang gang ltar 'dug kyang 'bar sha mi skur: sras dang brgyud 'dzin la'ang dam tshig bsrung : dam tshig dus gcig bsgoms pa'i rdo rje mched lcam kun la dag snang sbyang : tha na srog la bab kyang chos spang gi las mi bya: dbang khrid zhu ba'i tshe rin po che sna tshogs kyi maṇḍal dbul: bla ma mnyes pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dgram: yi dam dgyes pa'i tshogs mchod rgyas par dgod: mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma gtsang bar bsham: rnam pa kun tu dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral bar bya'o: gzhan yang dge rtsa rgya che bar khas len bgyid: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dzin cing gsang ba'i dam tshig la gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ / sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /nam̐ ram̐ka rgyun gcod 'khor ba dom̐ng sprugam̐ dbam̐ng*/ /grol drug gsaṃng sngaṃgs zab khyad ngo mtshar rmad/ /bstaṃn 'gro'i don chen 'dziṃn bzod lhag bsam can/ /mchis na tshul 'di 'dzin skyong spel la rems/ /de dag gi zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur bltas chogs su bkod pa'o/
/gnyis pa kun bzang zhi ba'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs kyi dbang gi le tshan no// //

༈ ram̐ng rig gzhi yi bla ma kunam̐ tu bzam̐ng*/ /ram̐ng rtsal ma 'gag yi dam zhim̐ dang khrom̐/ /ram̐ng gnas rtsa gsum lha la gus btud nas/ /ram̐ng grol ting 'dzin dom̐n dbam̐ng 'di na spro/ / gsum pa bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ kun bzang zhi khro'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar bum pa/ shel gyi phreng ba/ shel rdo/ rigs brgya'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs sam gtso bo kun bzang yab yum/ cod pan/ rigs lnga/ stod g.yogs/ ga shal/ rin po che'i phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ snyan rgyan/ smad dkris/ rdo rje/ dril bu bcas dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bya/ dngos gzhi kun bzang zhi ba'i gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub kyi mthar bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang chen por bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bkra lam mer gsal bar gyur/ / ces rtsa sngags kyis rnam bum dang las bum bsgrub pa dang mchod cing dkyil 'khor lha la bstod pa ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ hūm̐: rdo rje chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rdo rje thabs mchog bde stong pa: rdo rje'i skyil krung zung 'jug dang : rdo rje rgyal po thog ma'i mgon: phyag 'tshal kun bzang yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che: rdo rje mi bskyod gsum dang ldan: rdo rje phyag rgya bsnol thabs can: phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'chang chen la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen padma las: rdo rje kha dog rang bzhin can: rdo rje rang rtags rgyan ldan pa: phyag 'tshal rigs lnga yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje bya grub shes pa brgyad: rdo rje mi g.yo rnam pa can: rdo rje phyag mtshan 'khrul 'khor sgyur: phyag 'tshal sems dpa' yab yum brgyad la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje bde ba dgyes pa'i yab: rdo rje gsang ba las 'dzin ma: rdo rje brda sgyur brda 'chang ba: phyag 'tshal rigs lnga yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje theg pa bla na med: rdo rje ston pas phung po bcom:

rdo rje phar phyin drug 'chang ba: phyag 'tshal thub pa rigs drug la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje zhi byed bzhad gshe khro: rdo rje gyad 'gros sa gsum gnon: rdo rje tshad med grub pa bzhi: phyag 'tshal sgo ba yab yum brgyad la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje drwa ba sgyu 'phrul can: rdo rje kun gzhi snying po 'chang : rdo rje las byung 'dod nas 'dul: phyag 'tshal zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o: phyag 'tshal zhes bstod cing bum pa 'od du zhu nas tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar spyi dang mtshungs/ thog mar ji ltar bltams p sogs kyis khrus bstsal/ bgegs la gtor ma bsngo zhing mtshams bcad pa nas lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du song nas/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed dbang gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal gdab ste gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ 'dir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i blo'i bye brag dang mthun par sems can gyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa sogs mdor bsdu na/ theg pa rim pa dgu'am gnyis te mtshan nyid mdo'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa ste sngags kyi sgo gnyis su 'du ba las/ da lam skabs su bab pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten 'di na kun mkhyen dang*/ /u dumbā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang nas re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'byon dka' ba ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho rnams nas rgya cher bsngags pa bzhin/ da lan dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal/

dam pa'i chos dang 'phrad/ de'ang gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa dang 'phrad de shin tu skal ba bzang po'i skabs 'dir/ o rgyan gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos padma sbas tshal gyi mgul mtsho 'khor rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo ba ru/ klu bdud nā ga raksha'i lag nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i kun bzang zhi khro'i chos sde yin te/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ yang zab gsang ba thig le'i chos: a ti kun bzang bla ma 'di: nges don gsang ba mkha' 'gro gcig brgyud ma: thugs rje mi zad 'byin pa'i gter chen po: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam zab 'di: ma 'ongs 'phrad pa'i skal ldan las can rnams: tshe 'dir 'ja' lus yi dam lha'i zhing du: mngon rdzogs thog ma'i mgon po de dang mnyam: 'di nyid nyams len sgrub brtson bgyis tsam gyis: sdig can shan pa las ngan yin gyur kyang : mtho ris gnas su bgrod par the tshom med: ces gsungs pa bzhin byin rlabs dang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa de ldan gyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la'ang slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis thog mar dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol: de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bkra lam gyis gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don thugs bzhag bzhin tshig gis rjes zlos kyang mdzod/

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas? chen por bsngo/ de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ / lan gsum/ dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni bla med byang chub chu: myang zhing dkyil 'khor srog ltar zungs: nyams na mnar med duḥkha myong : dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya khaṃ i dante na ra kan: de ltar khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pas dam tshig las 'gal na las kyi srin por 'gyur la/ bsrungs na ye shes sems dpar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum legs par bsdams la sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ badzra a mṛ t swa bhā w khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs par stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og min chos kyi dbyings rgya khyon bkod pa las 'das pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ de dbus rang nyid chos sku kun tu bzang : sku mdog mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: dbyings phyug dkar mo bde stong sku la 'khril: ye shes lnga ldan rol rtsal rigs brgya'i sprin/ yongs grub spro bsdu'i bdag nyid chen por gsal/ /de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas rol mo bya zhing spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen gyis: rang snang ma 'gags rtsal bcu'i pho brang nas: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i klong yangs shugs kyis gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir dbang bskur stsol la byin chen phob: om̐ dharma sa manta bha dra dzñā na a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu kun bzang yab yum bde stong gi sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor ltem gyis gang bar bsams la/ de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: zung 'jug bla med bdud rtsi yi: rgyu mchog spyi bo'i gtsug nas babs: 'ja' lus bum dbang thob par shog: om̐ badzra dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des sku bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bur 'ja' lus snang stong gi sprul sgyur bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor ltem gyis gang bar bsam: de nas shel gyi phreng ba thogs la/ hūm̐: grags stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: shes rab gsang ba zung 'jug nyid: gnyis med zung 'jug dkyil 'khor mchog: gsang ba shes rab dbang thob shog: om̐ sambha pra dzñā wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des gsung rdzogs rim sgyu ma lta bu grags stong bzlas pa la dbang zhing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob pa la dbang bar byas so/

/de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor ltem gyis gang bar bsam: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: gsal stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: rgyu 'byung ka dag rang bzhin ngang : dbyings rig ma bcos bla med kyi: mngon sum rig pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ swa bhā bo dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des rdzogs rim gyi de kho na nyid 'od gsal rig stong chos kyi sku rang byung gi rig pa ma bcos zang thal rjen ne ba bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku 'thob pa la dbang bar byas so/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kun ltem gyis gang bar bsam: lhun grub rtsal dbang gi ngo sprod pa ni/ de nas slob dpon chos sku kun tu bzang por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs ltar phog /gnyis 'dzin la pa'i sogs rtog tshogs dag /rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bor me long g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas bzhi cha sum bral gyi ngang la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ hoḥ snang zhing stong pa chos sku'i ngo bo: grags shing stong pa chos sku'i rang rtsal: gsal zhing stong pa chos sku'i nges tshig: dran cing ma 'gags stong pa chos sku'i ngang : shes rig kun khyab chos sku'i gnas lugs: lhun grub kun khyab chos sku'i 'bras bu'o: de yang ngo bo stong pa chos sku: rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku: thugs rje 'gags med sprul sku'o: 'od gsal dag pa chos sku: sgyu ma rmi lam longs sku: sna tshogs rang gsal sprul sku: de'ang nges par bsal bzhag dang bral ba mngon sum gyi tshig dbang thob pa yin no: rigs brgya'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs sam gtso bo kun bzang yab yum gyi sku thogs la/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du rang shar bas longs spyod rdzogs sku rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang po/

gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing dbang bskur bas/ rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po kun tu bzang : dbyings phyug shes rab pang du 'khril: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams ye shes lha'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa la/ rgya rtags kyis mnga' gsol zhing rdo rje slob dpon gyis gnyer du gtad par mos mdzod/ cod pan thogs la 'di skad do/ hūm̐: cod pan ye shes lnga ldan 'di: bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dbang rtags zungs: kun bzang mi bskyod spyi bor bsgom: rang byung rigs kyi bdag por shog: om̐ sa manta bha tra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: longs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i mchog: ye shes rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: dug lnga ma spangs dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: stong nyid bla med snying po can: mtshan dpes rab brgyan mdzes pa'i mchog: lha rdzas na bzas stod la g.yogs: gsang mtshan brda yi dbang thob shog: om̐ dhe wa bhu dza ya arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ga shal gyis brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: gsang sngags bla med theg chen gyi: shes rab rang bzhin 'khril ba yi: ga sha'i phreng bas g.yon du brgyan: dpe byad 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ba me arba ma li arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rin po che phyag gdub zhabs gdub snyan rgyan rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rnam thar brgyad kyi sgo 'byed cing : shes brgyad ngo bo gnas su dag: rang byung rin chen bdun gyis brgyan:

rgyud sde'i rtags rgyan dbang thob shog: om̐ ratna bi shwa arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: rim dgu bla med theg pa'i mchog: dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ste: yang dag mngon gsal rdzas kyi mchog: rgyan klub brda yi dbang thob shog: om̐ kuṇḍa li arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje g.yas su gtad la: hūm̐: thabs mchog bde ba chen po'i rdzas: rang byung sna tshogs rdo rje 'di: phyag rgya 'khrul 'khor g.yas su zungs: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra bhi shwa badzra ka ra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dril bu g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab stong pa chen po'i rdzas: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i sgra che ba: phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor g.yon du zungs: zab gsang sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ shabda ba me dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de dag gis ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pas gtang rag tu maṇḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams?

rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ /slar smras pa/ kunam̐ bzam̐ng rang zhal ston mdzad de las drin/ /srid dang zhim̐ bam̐'i khams 'dir su zhig che/ /smim̐n grom̐l gsaṃng sngaṃgs zab gnad mang bstanaṃ kyang*/ /snying po'i snying po de las ci zhig 'dziṃn/ /gsum pa kun bzang zhi khro'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zhes zhi khro'i dbang bskur bsdus pa'i le tshan no// // ༈ smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i sgrub skor zhi drag thams cad kyi rtsa ba thugs sgrub kyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ ༈ bzhi pa thog mar bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dbang chen ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong ltar/ thog mar sta gon bya/ dngos gzhi'i dbang chen ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong gyi khongs su/ le tshan bcu gsum phyogs bsdus kyi dbang 'bring po'i lugs ltar mthar chags su bskur/ thugs sgrub dbang 'bring gyi le tshan no// // de nas rtsa ba bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos rje 'bangs grogs rnams la gdams pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang bskur ba las/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams lnga dang*/ smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams lnga/ phrin las bye brag gi zhal gdams bzhi bcas bcu bzhi bzhugs pa las/ /lnga pa snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po bde gshegs rigs lnga'i bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang mthar chags su bskur/ drug pa 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal po la brten pa'i dbang bskur dang*/ bdun pa cir snang tshogs drug rang grol o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa thod phreng sde lnga'i dbang bskur/ brgyad pa 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor/ o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang*/

dgu pa nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bcas stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i le tshan zhal gdams lnga grub nas/ smad las gang 'dul der ston dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams lnga dang 'brel ba ste/ bcu pa sems can 'dod chags las byung ba'i mu ge dang dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung sel o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dbang*/ bcu gcig pa dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i dbang*/ bcu gnyis pa pha rol bdud bzhi'i rgol ba gzhom pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi dbang*/ bcu gsum pa bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang*/ bcu bzhi pa phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad dbang bcas/ smad las gang 'dul der ston dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs las dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ dbang sdud zil gnon sogs phrin las bar pa'i le tshan lnga'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ de nas phrin las bye brag ni/ dus ngan snyigs mar sbas yul dben rir snyegs pa/ las can zab gter 'don pa/ sbas yul gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs la mkho ba'i cha lag /le tshan bcu gcig dang bcu gsum bar gyi gzhung tshang bar 'byung ba las/ bco lnga pa lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyi/ phrin las sgrub pa o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i dbang*/ bcu drug pa gnas yul 'grims pa'i bar du gcod pa mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba o rgyan yi dam lha'i dbang*/ bcu bdun pa ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel dus las mi g.yel ba/ o rgyan dpa' bo ging gi dbang ste/ bsam lhun le tshan bcu gsum gyi dbang gi le tshan no// // bco brgyad pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom chos skyong srog gtad ni/ 'dir ram yang na chos skyong srog gtad gsham gsal gyi skabs gang mtshams su sbyar ba yin la/

'di ni thun mong du bskur bya min pa shes par bya'o/ /gong gsal thugs sgrub dbang chog zur gsal ltar bskur ba ste lnga pa nas bco brgyad kyi bar dbang chen gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bcu dgu pa bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ dbang chog bsdus pa ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba srid zhi kun khyab bcas chog khrigs zur gsal ltar bskur ro/ /thugs sgrub dbang bsdus kyi le tshan no/ /nyi shu pa khyad par gyi dbang gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo'i zab lam ye shes drwa ba tshig dbang dang bcas pa gud sbas ltar bskur/ de dag ni thugs sgrub dbang bskur rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi le tshan no// // ༈ gu ru pam̐dmam̐ yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ /dbang sdud rgyam̐l pom̐'i skur bzhengs gang de yi/ /smim̐n byem̐d dngos grub kun 'byung chom̐g khrim̐gs 'di/ /skal bzang 'phral yun phan bde'i btsas su dgod/ nyer gcig pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po las/ dbang chog dngos grub kun 'byung khrigs chags su bsdeb pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba bca' bsham ni/ mdun stegs dmar po khebs ldan gyi thog tu dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dmar po bhandha me long bcas dang*/ gtor ma'i gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs khar rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng dpal gtor rtse thon dpung gshog zlum 'khyil nor bus mtshan pa dang*/ g.yang gtad bya na g.yang gtor rnam rgyal khang bzang ltar bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyis bskor ba/ lha tsaka kyi skor la/ bum tsaka /padma rgyal po yab yum/ manda ra ba/ mtsho rgyal/ mgyogs ma bzhi/ me long*/ sku tsaka /g.yang gtad la mkho ba'i chas/ g.yang rdzas/ g.yang bum/ ja chang*/ longs spyod sna tshogs kyi phrom/ rgyan gos sna tshogs/ rin chen sna tshogs/ 'bru sna tshogs/ g.yag lug ra gsum/ 'khor lo/ g.yung drung*/

dam tshig rdo rje/ dgos pa'i yo byad rnams dang*/ sngon gtor chad brtan bskul gsum gter srung zhi drag gsol kha sogs bsham pa'i mdun du nyer spyod sna bdun la sogs bsham bkod spyi mthun bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsam ste brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ dbang sdud zhags pa'i las byang chog khrigs bzhin gtong la bstod pa'i mjug tu dzap khang dbye/ bsnyen sgrub ci nus mthar bum pa sgrub rjes dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod grub pa dang bum lha 'od zhu bya/ de nas rang gzhung gi gsol kha rgyas bsdus dang tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas slob ma mdun du bos te khrus bstsal ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du gu ru padma rgyal po o rgyan nor lha'i lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig

/gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /de nas las gzhung gi srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: thod phreng drag po khro rgyal gyis: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rnams: mtshams bcad khro bo'i gur gyur nas: 'jigs med rdo rje bhrūm̐ du gyur: oṃ āḥbadzra rakṣa tsakra bhrūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ slob dpon zhwa chos bcas/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbang bskur zab mo gsan te tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang*/ de'ang rgyud las/ nyan pa po rnams dma' ba'i sa la 'dug /zhwa thod skra lo la sogs mdun du phab/ /mig gi dbang pos chos smra'i zhal la blta/ /rna ba'i dbang pos ma yengs gsung la nyan/ /yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ bka' phur gshin gsum sogs mang du mchis pa'i nang gses nor sgrub padma rgyal po zhes bya ba thugs sgrub bder 'dus kyi cha lag /man ngag bcu gsum gyi nang tshan o rgyan nor lha sgrub pa'i las tshogs te/ de nyid las/ ma 'ongs sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i: 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: dgos 'dod lhun grub nor lha'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bkra shis 'khor ba'i rdzas rnams bsags nas su:
