rang nyid gnod sbyin dbang phyug chas su bgyid: nga nyid padma rgyal po sgeg pa'i gzugs: mkha' 'gro dbang sdud 'bum bcas bskyed par bya: dngos grub nor 'gugs zhal gdams gnyis pa'o: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ o rgyan nor lha dbyer med kyi las tshogs gud du bzhag pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po zhes/ nor sgrub dang dbang sdud sogs kyi gdams ngag khyad par can de phyis su thugs sgrub kyi cha lag tu bzhag pa yin no/ /de'ang dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas de nyid/ dus re zhig gi tshe rgya gar gyi dur khrod chen po dga' ba'i tshal du snang srid dbang sdud padma rgyal po'i skur bzhengs nas/ srid pa gsum na mngon par mtho ba'i 'jig rten gyi mes po'am/ khams gsum gyi bdag por rlom pa'i srid pa'i lha chen dbang phyug chen po ma hā de wa 'khor dang bcas pa rang dbang dang bral bar dbang du bsdus pas/ ci bgyis pa'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs nas ma hā de wa'i rlung zhags sogs gdams pa thun min du ma phul/ man ngag nor bu zhags pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa gsar du mdzad nas de nyid du re zhig mi snang bar rgya yis btab bo/ /de nas bod du ji ltar dar na sngar bod du ban chos la nor sgrub phywa spel gyi las tshogs de tsam med la phyi mo bon thams cad mtha' ru spyugs pas: bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can ma dga' bas 'byung ba thams cad 'khrugs te bod kyi bsod nams dang sa bcud rnams lo gsum du nyams: bsam yas sogs lha sde mi sde'i khang khyim phal cher la 'gong po mngon rgyug tu gyur: yul gyi sa dang mi'i mdog nyams: sems can phal cher mu ge'i 'jigs pas gzir: de'i tshe rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon la gser g.yu rin po che'i maṇḍal dpag tu med pa phul nas zhus pa: kyaiḥ slob dpon rin po che lags:

sangs rgyas dbang po dus gsum mkhyen cing dus med rdzogs pa'i bla ma dam pa nyid phebs pa'i skabs su: bod 'bangs dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di ci ltar lags: 'di la phan pa'i thabs bsod nams dang ldan pa'i man ngag stsal du gsol: zhes zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas: kyaiḥ rgyal po chen po legs par gsan 'tshal: spyir sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa rin po che dar ba la: sems can gyi phra mo'i legs nyes la ma ltos par: spobs pa dang brtul zhugs gtong phod rnams che dgos pa yin: sems can dbul ba rnams sngon gyi sbyin shugs chung zhing 'phral du lha 'dre gdug pa can bon la dgyes pa rnams kyi cho 'phrul dang nag phyogs kyi kha 'dzin pa yin: 'di la phan pa'i gnad rgyal pos dbu mdzad de 'bangs rnams kyis sbyin pa rgya che ba thongs: bsod nams sa bcud kyi bum gter sbos: 'phral phug kun tu bsod nams dang dbang thang gi rgyas thebs par 'dod na: kho bo dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du gnas pa'i tshe padma rgyal po'i ngo bor gyur nas lha dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa dbang du bsdus te: man ngag nor bu zhags pa'i gdams pa rnams mkha' 'gro'i brda'i yi ger btab nas da lta klu'i rgyal po zla skyong la bcol nas rgyas bsdams pa yod de: rgyal pos zhus pa shin tu legs pas de dag 'byin par byas na phan pa yin: zhes bka' yis gnang ngo : yang de'i tshe kho mo mtsho rgyal rdzu 'phrul gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi lam la zhugs te gdams pa'i man ngag khyad par can bcu gsum gdan drangs nas: rje gu ru'i phyag tu phul: gu rus rgyal pos dbu mdzad rje 'bangs grogs lnga la gnang : mtsho rgyal gyis slar brda'i yi ger btab pa'o: yang de'i dus na: rje ma hā gu rus dbu mdzad pa'i grogs dang bcas te mchims phu'i dben tshal du sgrub pa zhag bdun nas me tog dang myu gu shing 'bras snams dgun dus su 'khrungs:

mkha' nas 'brug ldir: nyi zla zung gcig tu shar ba sogs ltas bzang po byung : bod mi thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob te yul thams cad bkra shis shing lo legs pa byung : bsam yas kyi bsgrub bya thams cad 'grub pa'i tshe gu ru padma rgyal po'i sgrub skor nor bdag dzam nag sgrub pa'i rten bcas: dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling du gter sbas: gter bdag rgyal po mdung dmar can la bcol lo: sgrub pa'i las rim cha bdun mdo khams rong bzhi la sbas: gter bdag klu'i dge bsnyen la bcol: gzhan dang sgrub skor mang zhig mon kha'i phyogs su sbas: dbang phyug rlung zhags kyi skor rnams ra sa 'phrul snang gi byang phyogs su sbas so: gter srung phal cher yaksha bhya tri mu kha li la bcol: sa ma ya: e maḥ snying thig gud du sbas pa'i ti la ka: nam mkha'i mdzod la nor bu spungs pa'i dpyid: ma 'ongs pre ta'i 'ching grol 'dod 'jo'i gnyen: sngo bsangs dbang mo'i rgyan bzhin mdzes pa'i tog: gang zhig gtib po'i g.yan rnams g.yel ba'i phyir: 'dod rgu grangs med 'bum las 'bum 'khyil ltar: thabs shes dwangs pas 'khril zhing dkri ba'i tshogs: rtog ges mi rtogs 'dod rgu gud du sbos: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams la 'phrad par shog: snying thig yid bzhin dbang gi 'khor lo 'di: nā ga aṣṭi ma ṇi pā las srungs: sa ma ya: zhes gtad rgya bcas sba bar mdzad pa las chu mo rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lo'i hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga nyin khrom sum brgyas mtha' bskor dang bcas/ mdo smad rong gi gnas mdo dge bsnyen mtsho nag nas/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes par mdzad pa'i zab chos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba ste/ 'di'i phan yon yang*/ gzhung las/ e ma hoḥ 'dod rgu'i dbyings phyug rin chen gter mdzod las: mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor lo 'di phyug pas:

sna tshogs srid dang de srid skye 'gro yi: dpal la rab tu 'jo ba'i rmad byung ba'i: gzung 'dzin lha mo snyan pa'i ba dan phreng : yid kyi lang tsho dbus mtha'i gzhal yas 'das: dpag ka'i khyon ltar yongs 'gengs 'dod 'byung can: gling 'di'am ni srid pa'i dpung rtse ru: nam mkha'i nor bu bgrang yas tshar bsgrigs bzhin: 'di 'dra gzhan la ma grags khyad par 'phags: 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i gter chos mang lags kyang : bcud bsdus mar gyi snying po 'di 'dra dkon: bod khams sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: tshig nyung don 'brel yang zab gcig bsdus mchog: ces gsungs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur thob na smos ci dgos te: phrin las tshar gcig btang ba'i bsod nams kyang : bgrangs pas mi long zhing brjod kyis mi nus so: zhes pas phan yon de ldan gyi o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i zab chos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur zab mo bgyi bar byed pa la/ thog mar slob dpon dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams/ legs par grub nas da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos/ phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: dpal zhing sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan bdag cag 'jug par stsol:

de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yis gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag cag yang dag dam tshig can: srog dang snying gi dwangs ltar bsgrub: gtso bos bdag la gnang ba stsol:

dam chu la slob dpon gyis nang mchod bdud rtsi bsres pa thogs la/ hūm̐: khyed rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: las can bu la dbang mchog sbyin: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs dngos sgrub sna tshogs thob: a mṛ ta sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig: ces bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: zhes lan gsum/ dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad theg chen byang chub mchog la 'god par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: o rgyan nor lha'i lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs bsags par bya ba'i slad du yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:

phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ / lan gsum/ de nas snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ye shes btsan thabs su 'bebs pa la/ rang gnas kyi ye shes snying las bslangs te rim pas dbang rten gyi rten gzhi so thub tu sgrub pa la/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad drang por bsrang*/ ngag srog rtsol kha sbyor du 'ching*/ yid tshogs drug gi yul la ma g.yeng bar dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho? khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar rin chen sna tshogs spungs pa'i khrir: sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ dmar po'i rnam par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las slob ma rnams gu ru padma dbang sdud rgyal po dmar la snum pa'i mdangs ldan sgeg cing sbom la gsus khyim che ba: zhal gsum khro 'dzum mdzes la dbu skra nor bus brgyan pa phyag drug g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu 'dzin pa: g.yon gsum gyis bhandha ne'u le padma bsnams shing zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum phyed skyil du bzhugs pa: g.yas su lha lcam dmar mos ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa:

g.yon du mtsho rgyal dkar mos rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pa: mdun du klu mo nor skyong mas nor bu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa: phyi rol dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor bar gsal thob/ de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/ rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru dbang sdud padma rgyal po rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ 'ja' zer thig le phyag mtshan yig 'bru'i rnam par kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: padma rgyal po dbang sdud rtsal: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: nor bdag 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di?stsol: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ satwaṃ bha ya ra ra ra rā tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ āḥdzhaiṃ: de ltar byin phebs pa'i rtags su sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ /de nas byin dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ tiṣṭha badzra: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ de nas don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan smin par mdzod: lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul: mi 'da' dam tshig bsrung lags so: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de'ang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur bas dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa yin la/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas/ mthar tshig don ngo sprad de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: longs spyod gter bum gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi nor bdag yab yum skus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mnga' thang chos kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/

lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /thog mar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par/ rin po che'i rgyan du ma dang bcas gar stabs shig shig byon te khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ thugs sgrub o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i lha tshom ltar cung zad spros pa ni/ padma rgyal po yab yum thogs te: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang sdud 'dod rgu'i dpal yon can: sku mdog dmar snum dbang maur zung 'jug 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki nī ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: manda ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: tshe la dbang zhing mchog gi rig 'dzin gter: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi rjes chags can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i 'ja' lus stsal du gsol: om̐ ā yur ḍākki nī ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rig las rdo rje'i brda skad sgrog: zhi 'dzum mdzes pa skye 'gro'i snang ba 'gugs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dod yon longs spyod gter la dbang sgyur shog: om̐ dzñā na ḍākki nī su khaṃ dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: shar phyogs la sogs lha yi dpal 'byor sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der stsol cig: om̐ badzra ku le a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: lho phyogs la sogs mi yi mnga' thang sdud:

deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob par shog: om̐ ku le shaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nub phyogs padma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: nub phyogs la sogs klu yi longs spyod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bang mdzod 'dod rgu dbang du 'du bar shog: om̐ ku le hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang phyogs karma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: byang phyogs la sogs gnod sbyin tshe bsod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dang dpal 'byor stsol: om̐ ku po ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bhandha thogs la: hūm̐: bhandha lhun grub gsang ba'i dbyings: dbang sdud nor lha'i bdud rtsi mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bsod nams longs spyod dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab kyi ngo sprod pa ni/ sems kyi chos nyid thig ler nyag gcig mtshon pa'i thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza siddhi sa ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun siddhi dzaḥ de nyid brtan pa'i ched du sngags phreng gi dbang bskur bar mos/ sngags phreng thogs la: hūm̐: bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i gzungs ba sngags: spro bsdu zer gyi phreng ba yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las bzhi'i phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra me la dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /yang me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sindhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes rol pa'i rtsal: snang stong ngo bo nyid kyi skus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bde chen 'bras bu mngon gyur cig: oṃ badzra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas bas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /de nas thugs 'od gsal ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/

sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ zhes mnyam par bzhag bcug /deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhandhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos mdzod/ gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐: dngos grub sna tshogs legs 'byung ba: dbang sdud yab yum yon tan mdzod: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu ru ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myang ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru padma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/

de nas sku tsaka thogs la: hūm̐: phyi nang yongs rdzogs 'khor lo bskor: dbang sdud yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag pa gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol med pa 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ / de dag gi mtha' rten du g.yang gtad bya bar mos na 'dir bya dgos pas de la'ang spros pa bya na thog mar lan chags glud gtor bsngo zhing bse rag bkar yas bya ba la/ dang po byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na maḥ sarba ta thā g khaṃ swā hā/ de nas 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas: phyogs mtshams 'gugs bsgral mtshon 'phros pas: tshe bsod longs spyod mnga' thang la: gnod byed yi dwags bgegs rigs kun: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa kā la gnod byed mā ra ya khug dza dzaḥ sgab 'dre bse rag bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag padma he ru kaḥ nyon cig bse rag dbul sri ltogs 'gong tshogs: dbus kyi ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir: spyi mthun chos nor longs spyod spel ba la: rang rang las kyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i: dbul sri mi la bse rag zhes bya ba:

gang gi rgyu ni ser sna'i rang gzugs te: rkyen ni rgyu mthun yi dwags yid kyi lus: sna tshogs gzugs su brdzu zhing dpal g.yang rku: snod bcud rten 'brel legs tshogs spel ba la: byur dang mi kha god kha gang stong sogs: rnam kun bar chad sna tshogs sgab 'dre ldang : ltogs 'gong dbul sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs kun: tshwa ram sgog g.yer la sogs mi kha'i rdzas: rang rang yid mthun yas stags 'di longs la: lan chags bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis: myur du mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song : bsgo ba'i bka' las 'da' na lus ngag yid: yi dam drag tu khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ye shes lnga'i srung 'khor brtan par bsgom: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin nas: phywa g.yang dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: g.yang rdzas rnams kun gyi lag tu bzhag cing : sgrub pa po'i phyag tu lcags kyu dang ne'u le mda' dar thogs la: bdag mdun rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid can 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams su khyab/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang longs spyod thams cad bkra shis rdzas rtags 'ja' zer thig le la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum dang mdun bskyed kyi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas 'dod rgu'i dngos grub yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mda' dar g.yab cing spos bsregs rol mo dbyangs dang bcas 'di skad do/ hūm̐: steng phyogs dag pa ye shes 'phrul gyi dbyings: klong lnga sna tshogs rgyas pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba sangs rgyas byang sems kyi: byin rlabs rgya mtshos sgrub rgyud smin mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: ka dag rtsal snang cho rol longs sku'i mkha':

zer thag thod rgal gshis lugs khregs chod g.yang : gnas lugs tshogs gnyis mngon sum smin mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: kun bzang mkha' la 'dod rgur shar ba'i lha: bskyed rim snang gzugs yi dam dngos grub mchog: snang ngor 'dod rgur 'byung zhing spel mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: mthu stobs myur 'byin mkha' la lam lam 'gro: dbyings kyi ḍākki rten 'brel 'khor los mdzes: gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin brda bzhi'i grogs mdzad ma: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: longs spyod mnga' bdag mi dbang 'khor los sgyur: legs par rgyas mdzad mi dbang gter gyi bdag: dgos 'dod dpal 'byor klong du gter mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: dam tshig las la rgyud bskul sha khrag rngam: dregs sde pho nyas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: mngon spyod las bzhi thogs med sgrub mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: las 'phro can la zab gter dngos su bstan: skal ldan chos bdag legs lam mngon mtho ba: shog ser rnam lnga'i brda bzhi ston mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: de ltar g.yang 'gugs sngon du song nas g.yang dang dngos grub gtad cing dbang bskur ba ni/ g.yang rdzas rnams o rgyan nor lha'i skur gsal ba la gzhan yang ye shes dang las la grub pa'i rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs te dbang bskur bas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stan thog 'di nyid la thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ g.yang bum mam g.yang gtor thogs la: hūm̐: dngos grub rmad byung gtor mar g.yang zhag 'khyil: bden gnyis zung 'jug spel ba'i bcud ldan pa: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs:

bkra shis g.yang gtad dngos grub dga' bas longs: yid la bsam pa'i don kun skad cig la: thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar lag tu gtad pa la brten nas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu bzhin du zad pa med pa'i yid bzhin rin po che'i gter la dbang thob cing 'gro ba'i rgud pa sel/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gis 'byor/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par gyur c-ig / de nas ja chang thogs la/ hūm̐: dkar dmar bde chen dbu ma'i rgyun 'byung mchog: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yang chang blud/ de nas longs spyod sna tshogs kyi phrom thogs la: hūm̐: zla rgyas zla phrom g.yang gi rten: bsod nams longs spyod 'dod rgu'i gter: dkar gsum mngar dang shing 'bras 'bru: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: bang mdzod dkor cha'i dbang thob shog: oṃ puṇye dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zas sna la rol du bcug /de nas rgyan gos sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: 'jam legs sna lnga mdzes pa yi: yid 'ong mdzes rgyan sna tshogs 'di: 'jam dkar gos bkrag legs pa'i mchog: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog: oṃ badzra bhi me gha sme sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lag tu gtad/ de nas rin chen sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen sna lnga yid 'ong mdzod: gser g.yu mu tig la sogs pa'i: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rdzas mchog 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: zad med gter gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra swa ra ser ran a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lag tu gtad/ de nas 'bru sna'i tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: 'bru bcud sna tshogs til gyi gang bu'i gter:

de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yag lug ra gsum g.yang rten thogs la: hūm̐: g.yag lug ra sogs 'dod 'jo'i rma g.yang mchog: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar bza' btung dang rgyan gos 'bru nor sogs gtad pa la brten nas stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ rgyal srid nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod la mnga' brnyes/ 'bras bu mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa zag med kyi yon tan gyi dpal la spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / de nas 'khor lo gtad la: hoḥ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang : snyan grags mnga' thang stobs ldan pa'i: sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtad: che btsan dpal gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ swa na tsakra ma hā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar 'khor lo gtad pa la brten nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang 'byor/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas srid zhir snyan pa'i grags pa ldir/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi sogs zag pa med pa'i yon tan gyi mnga' thang stobs 'byor ldan/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang 'dul gdul bya'i kha lo chos la bsgyur te/ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i che btsan dpal gyi dbang thob cing*/ 'chi med padma rgyal po dang gnyis su med pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rten 'brel snying po'i sngags brjod cing me tog 'thor la g.yang rdzas rnams mdzod phug tu sba'o/ /de nas mtha' rten du rgya yis gdab pa mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung dang mi shigs pa'i rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ g.yung drung thogs la: hūm̐: g.yang rten mi 'gyur g.yung drung dbyings kyi mkha':

klong lnga'i gter khyim srub cing srid spel ba: de ring skal ldan bdag gi g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dam tshig rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: mi 'gyur dbyings kyi rdo rje'i rgyas gdab bo: kun nas glo ba padma'i mkha' ru sdud: bsrub cing srid pa'i rig pa rol pa'i rtsal: kun nas kun tu bzung zhing rgyas btab bo: hūm̐: g.yang phywa 'od skor kyi li li: srid phywa dpal 'byor me re re: rten phywa 'dod rgu chi li li: snyan phywa 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: byin rlabs snyan grags 'byor rgyas shog: phywa khu g.yang khu ye hu ye g.yang sdud do: de ltar dbang zab mo thob pa la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dbang lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bye brag tu'ang bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru padma rgyal po zil gnon rtsal dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ shis pa brjod pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs shing me tog manda ra'i char chen po phab pas shin tu bkra shis par byas pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam mchog /zil gnon padma rgyal po dbang sdud rtsal/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho klu mo gter gyi bdag /phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog /de ltar dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ de dag? lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag tu dmigs nas maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/

khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung nas ni/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las kyi mtha' mi btsan pas/ rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de dag gis bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i dbang chog dngos grub kun 'byung khrigs chags su bsdebs pa dge /slar smras pa/ 'dod rgu mchog rtsol pam̐dmam̐ rgyam̐l pom̐'i drin/ /yid bzhin dbam̐ng rgyal thob chom̐g ma ṇi ka /'di yang gsaṃng sngaṃgs zab mo'i khyad chos tai/ /bstaṃn pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dziṃn pa'i grogs su mdzes/ /zhes nyer gcig pa gu ru padma rgyal po'i dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ mam̐ lham̐ dbang phyug rgyal sogs srid pa ru/ /'go ba'i lha lnga khyad par bum̐ rdzim̐ mas/ /sri'u gso dang rgyud 'dzin spel ba'i thabs/ /rjem̐s gnam̐ng cho ga'i khrigs bsdebs 'di na spro/ nyer gnyis pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i cha lag ma lha bu rdzi'i rjes gnang bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ padma rgyal po'i bdag bskyed bca' sgrub gong ltar la dmigs bsal yar gzhi dkar po'i steng du 'go ba'i lha lnga la/ zhi gtor zlum po dkar ser dmar ljang lnga pad 'dab bzhi bzhis bskor ba rgyan gyis spras pa bsham/

bum pa/ bhandha/ 'khor lo/ sngags phreng*/ ma lha dbang phyug rgyal mo/ pha lha ge mdzod/ ma lha g.ya' spang*/ phyugs lha rnam rgyal/ bu rdzi bsod nams tshe 'dzin/ mda' mo rgod sgro ma mtshal ldan la dar sna lnga dang rin po ches brgyan pa bcas dang*/ sku glud la sbyin bdag mo'am rigs rgyud byis pa bcas sgrub bya dmigs bsal yod na khrus bgyis shing dri khus sbrus pa'i bag zan la/ dri za'i rgyal po rta mgo can/ de'i 'khor du ngar mi gzig /glang*/ ra/ sbrul/ shwa ba/ glang chen/ sri la/ byi la/ sre mong*/ phag /rmigs bu/ bya gag /spre'u bcas kyi mgo can gyis bskor/ de'i phyi rol du changs bu mar me ting lo sha dum bcas kyis bskor ba sogs 'du bya/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar padma rgyal po'i gzhung bsrang la bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod bar song nas mdun bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang du ni: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin dpag yas 'khrigs: ma lha g.yang gi dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas: 'dod rgu yid 'ong phun tshogs spyod gyur cig: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda ā hūm̐:

de nas dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las: mdun rten bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang chen po mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ zhes pas yig 'bru rnams yongs su gyur pa las: dbus su rnam par snang mdzad: shar du rdo rje tshe bdag: lho ru ratna tshe bdag: nub tu padma tshe bdag: byang du karma tshe bdag ste rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang ldan pa: de'i mtshams su ye shes rlung gi lha mo dang rang mdog gi rgyan ldan phyag na ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa: rigs lnga yab yum gyi lha tshogs thams cad snang la rang bzhin dang bral bar gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ pañtsa ku la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda'i bar brjod: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rigs kyi gtso bo rnam snang mdzad: ye shes bzhi sbyor phrin las lnga: tshe bcud bsod nams 'dzin la sogs: dbang lnga bsgrub phyir bdag bstod do: bdag mdun bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī ā: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza sarba puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brgya'am nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub bya/ sham bu 'di kha bsgyur bgyis nas srung skud dkar po mdud pa gsum bor te ma lha'i rten du bsams la sngags bzlas/ oṃ aṣṭi ye dhe ma dha ri ta puṇye sarba ra ga wi tra kyaid kyaid de ye swā hā:

zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin brlabs nas srung skud mda' dar gyi mgul du 'chang*/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bcas bya/ tshogs 'khor sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /slob ma g.yung drung tshom bu'i steng du bzhag la khrus bya/ de nas glud gtor chu gtsang gis bran la 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen drag po thod phreng khro rgyal gyi: rang bzhin thugs las spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bcu khyab par skar ltar 'khrugs: deng 'dir bsod nams sgrub la mi dbang ba'i: 'byung po skal med gdon chen bgegs kyi tshogs: yas stags glud kyi gzugs byang 'di la mchis: oṃ badzra ṭākki dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po tri yaṃ a karṣa ya dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la: hūm̐: nyon cig phyogs skyong gdon gyi tshogs: byis pa'i bgegs chen bco lnga dang : 'byung po yi dwags tshogs rnams kun: mthun 'jug mchod sbyin 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: drag pos dmod pa'i rig sngags mtshon: nyungs dkar khro bo thun gyi rdzas: tshwa tshwa'i sgong bu 'gril ba yis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams: gzhom zhing bshig par gdon mi za: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: rdo rje'i bka' las 'da' ma byed: myur ba nyid du bskrad kyis byol: oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis bskrad pas 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rang rang gi gnas su song bar bsam: de nas srung zhing mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: ral gri 'khor lo srung ba'i gur khang ni: mi shigs rim dgu 'khrigs pas mtshams bcad nas: nam yang bgegs kyi 'gyu ba mi dmigs shing : bsod nams dpal 'byor brtan pa'i bhrūm̐ du gyur: oṃ bhrūm̐ sarba tsakra dzñā na badzra ye swā hā: zhes mtshams gcod/ de nas lo rgyus brjod pa ni/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/

de'i ched du dbang bskur zab mo gsan te/ de don tshul bzhin du nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang bcas pas gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i cha lag ma lha bu rdzi ma'i sgo nas phywa spel dang sri'u gso ba sogs srid kyi mtsho mo nyams pa slar 'phel bar byed pa'i las tshogs te/ de nyid las/ e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus nas: srid skyed 'dod rgu'i bang mdzod gdams pa bkod: ma 'ongs sems can pre ta'i duḥkha dang : rmugs 'dre mi la sogs pa'i 'gong po'i rigs: bsod nams dman zhing 'byung po phra mo rnams: mkha' la rgyu dang yul la chags pa yis: mi 'dod sna tshogs sdang ba'i rkyen byed pas: de dag skyabs dang bskrad nas mtha' ru bsring : 'go ba'i lha lnga rab tu gnas pa'i phyir: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po zhes nor sgrub dang dbang sdud sogs kyi gdams ngag khyad par can de nyid las 'phros pa'i ma lha bu rdzi'i rjes gnang sgrub pa la/ thog mar slob dpon dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas slob dpon gyi 'dri ba'i tshig la gsan par zhu/ kyaiḥ rigs ldan tshogs rnams legs par nyon: sngon 'byung srid pa'i ma lha 'di: de ring khyod la rten btsugs phyir: tshe dang dpal gyi dbang bskur bas: dngos grub len phyir spro 'am ci: zhes dris pa'i lan du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ e maḥ rigs 'dus byin rlabs rtsa ba'i mchog: rje lngas dam tshig stsal ba'i ngang : g.ya' spang rten la gus pas mos:

dam pas bdag la gnang ba stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐: khyed rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: las can bu la dbang mchog sbyin: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam srung dngos sgrub sna tshogs thob: a mṛ ta sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig: ces bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyis dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: zhes lan gsum/ dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ rdo rje slob dpon? de nas dmigs pa 'bog pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta ā yu pa smra ra na sa ma ya ti la thā swā hā: hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis srid pa'i ma lha dbang phyug rgyal mo sku mdog dkar la bag dro zhing snum pa'i nyams chags pa: dar dkar lhab lhub tu gsol zhing phyag na mda' dar dang bhi dza pu ra bsnams pa: dpral bar lhan cig skyes pa'i lha mo dkar mos rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pa: mgrin par lus kyi lha mos padma dang g.yung drung 'dzin pa: snying gar srog gi lha mo mthing gas rdo rje dang bhandha 'dzin pa: lte bar srid pa'i lha mo ser mos nor bu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa: gsang ba rgyud 'dzin lha mo ljang mos rlung gi zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa:

phrag pa g.yas su srid pa'i pha lha rdo rje ge mdzod gyis: zla ba dang dung dkar 'dzin pa: phrag pa g.yon du srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang skyes mos nyi ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa: pus mgo g.yas su phyugs lha rnam rgyal gyis rin po che'i gzhong pa dang 'bras snyi 'dzin pa: pus mgo g.yon du bu rdzi'i bsod nams tshe 'dzin mas mda' dar dang tshe'i gwa'u 'dzin pa ste thams cad rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan zhing rang mdog gi na bza' gsol ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: ma lha srid pa'i rgyal mo 'go ba'i lha lngas bskor bar spyan drangs: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rigs kyi yum chen lngas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa thogs te mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur/ de nas bum pa thogs la/ āḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang rtags sbyin pas sku'i lha mo gzi brjid ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis: de ring sku yi dbang bskur bas: lhan skyes ma lhar bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ pra mo ti badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhandha thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang rtags sbyin pas: gsung gi lha mo dbang sdud kulle ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig:

hūm̐: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyis: de ring gsung gi dbang bskur bas: gsung gi ma lhar bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ rā ga badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'khor lo thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang rtags sbyin pas: thugs kyi lha mo srid pa sa le ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis: de ring thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: srog gi ma lhar bdag gyur cig: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ su khaṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: de ring skal ldan khyod la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang rtags sbyin pas yon tan lha mo kun 'byung gi 'dod rgyal ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis: de ring yon tan dbang bskur bas: srid 'dzin ma lhar bdag gyur cig: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ tsarya badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags phreng thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la don yod grub pa'i dbang rtags sbyin pas phrin las kyi lha mo tshe 'dzin ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan don yod grub pa yis: de ring phrin las dbang bskur bas: rgyud 'dzin ma lha bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ mu tra badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dbang bskur nas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ a be sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas 'go ba'i lha ma lha 'khor bcas spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ: lha yi dbang phyug srid kyi rje: srog skyabs 'go ba'i dpung gnyen pa: de ring ma lha'i rten 'dzugs phyir: thogs med dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs:

badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs shing sa ma ya tiṣṭha badzra gyis dam tshig bsre/ de nas lus kyi 'go ba'i lhas dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gnas so sor thim pas bsod nams dang dbang thang nyams pa thams cad sos/ phywa 'phel/ g.yang gi sa gzhi brtan/ srid kyi mtsho mo rgyas pa'i dbang dam pa thob par mos mdzod/ spyi bor srid kyi ma lha dbang phyug rgyal mo thogs la: hūm̐: srid gsum gling bzhi'i bdag mo che: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ i shwa ra dhe ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phrag pa g.yas su srid kyi pha lha ge mdzod kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i pha lha chen po yis: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ lo ki dhi wa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phrag pa g.yon du srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang gi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang gis: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ dhe wi dha ra ya ni a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pus mgo g.yas su phyugs lha rnam rgyal gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: phyugs lha gang ba rnam rgyal gyi: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ puṇye sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pus mgo g.yon du bu rdzi bsod nams tshe 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rgyud 'dzin chen mo bu rdzi yis: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ badzra dzi wandza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bsgrub bya dmigs bsal ba yod tshe g.yung drung gi gdan steng du bzhag la phye mar ram 'brang rgyas dkar po'i srung btsugs shing brgyan pa ni:

hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi rgyud 'dzin ma: srid lha skyes lha srung du 'dzugs: lus lha srog lha srung du 'dzugs: srid 'dzin rgyud 'dzin srung du 'dzugs: pha lha ma lha srung du 'dzugs: phyug lha bu rdzi srung du 'dzugs: srid kyi phywa g.yang gnas gyur cig: oṃ sarba su khaṃ pra mo ti puṇye tiṣṭha ye swā hā: zhes srung 'dzugs/ de nas sngar sngags kyis brlabs zin pa'i srung skud sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i tshe dar dkar mo'i gzhi: 'jam legs ra bzhi'i spu las grub: ye shes sna lngar bsgrims pa las: rdo rje rgya chings mdud pa ldan: 'dod rgu'i zar bu chen po 'phyangs: ma lha 'khor ba'i srung du 'dzugs: srid kyi phywa g.yang gnas gyur cig: oṃ badzra tsakra tiṣṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes srung skud mgul du 'dogs/ de nas ma lha rten 'dzugs pa la mda' mo rgod sgro ma mtshal ldan dang dar sna lngar rin po ches brgyan pa thogs la/ hūm̐: phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs gang nas byung : ye thog srid pa dang po la: gling bzhi ri rab zom shed na: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i gnas: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin pho brang nas: g.yang zhag srid pa'i rol mtsho 'khyil: de dag lha klu 'tshogs pas bsrubs: spyod pas sgo nga lnga ru grub: de yi nang nas brdol pa la: srid pa 'go ba'i lha lnga byung : lha klu rnams kyis rten btsugs bzhin: lha ni tshangs pa dbang phyug dang : 'phrog byed bcas pas 'jig rten la: dbang bzhi kha lor bsgyur ba byung : klu ni gtsug na rin chen dang : dga' byed 'jog po la sogs gnas: mi zad 'dod rgu'i pho brang gyur: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: srid kyi mtsho mo'i gzhi tshugs shig: hūm̐: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi yi: btsun mo lha lcam bde chen la: 'go ba'i lha rnams rten btsugs pas:

rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub thob: phywa yi ma lha bu rdzi brtan: rgya gar yul gling kha lo sgyur: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: srid kyi mtsho mo'i gzhi tshugs shig: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: ḍākki dzi wan dza ya la: 'go ba'i lha rnams rten btsugs bzhin: bod 'bangs lo legs sa bcud smin: phywa yi ma lha bu rdzi brtan: chos 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: srid kyi mtsho mo'i gzhi tshugs shig: hūm̐: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : de ring rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la: g.yang gi mtsho mo 'khyil ba 'di: 'go ba'i lha la rten btsugs shing : ma lha bu rdzi mnga' gsol phyir: srid kyi rten 'dzugs 'di ltar 'dzugs: hūm̐: rin chen tshe yi mda' mo 'di: rgyu rkyen rten 'brel phun sum tshogs: cang stong dkar mo zhi ba'i mda': me long ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas spyan mas byin gyis rlobs: ma lha rdo rje'i tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: snyug ma ser po rgyas pa'i mda': mnyam nyid ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: mā ma kī yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha rin chen tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: mtshal brgyan dmar po dbang gi mda': sor rtogs ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: gos dkar mo yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha padma'i rten 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: lcags mde'u sngon po drag po'i mda': bya grub ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: dam tshig sgrol mas byin gyis rlobs: ma lha las kyi tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: rgod sgro thams cad lhun grub mda': chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir:

dbyings phyug ma yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha g.yung drung rten 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: le brgan dar tshon sna lnga yis: ma lha tshe dang dpal skyobs shig: bkra shis rin chen sna lnga yis: phyugs dang srid kyi g.yang spel cig: hūm̐: mda' mo rdo rje'i srog mkhar 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: srid kyi ma lha bu rdzis skyobs: skyob pa lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: tshe dang srid kyi bu rdzis skyongs: srog gi lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: g.yang spel rgyud srung 'khor ba dang : 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang : ma lha dbang bskur bdag gyur cig: oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: āḥbhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: oṃ u ta rā ga tsarya dha ra ā yurdzñā na hūm̐:

zhes mda' dar gyis dbang bskur zhing rten du 'dzugs/ byis pa sogs yin na mda' dar tshe yi rten du 'dzugs padma rgyal po'i sku 'khor btags: ma lha bu rdzi ma'i gzhung rkyang ni bud med kyis zhu bar bshad mod kyang : 'di 'go ba'i lha dang sbrags pa yin pas skyes pa rnams kyis zhu yang rung : bag ma gtong len skabs yin na phar 'gro ma lha 'di bskyur nas g.yang 'gugs bya: tshur yong yin na g.yang 'gugs dang ma lha bya: byis pa sri che na khyim gyi phywa g.yang nyams pa tshe dang dpal nyams par byung na 'di shin tu gtso che: de dag gi sgo nas ma lha bu rdzi'i rjes gnang gi cho ga legs par grub pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis brjod me tog 'thor rjes chog bsdu ba dngos grub len pa rnams padma rgyal po sogs gang rigs bya rung ngo*/ /srid pa'i mam̐ lham̐ la sogs 'go ba'i lhas/ /bum̐ rdzim̐ srid spel rjem̐s gnam̐ng gsaṃng sngaṃgs kyi/ /thabs mkhas phrin las bstanaṃ 'dziṃn gdung skyong dang*/ /'gro ba'i tshe srog skyobs pa'i gtsigs su bzung*/ /de dag ni nyer gnyis pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i cha lag ma lha bu rdzi'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no// // ༈ nyer gsum pa bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi smin dbang rgyas pa las byang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs ltar bsgrubs la skyid grong thugs mchog rdo rje'i chog khrigs dbang chog rdo rje spyi blugs ltar mthar chags su bskur bas grub bo/ /de dag ni padma khrag 'thung gi dbang chen gyi le tshan no// // ༈ nyer bzhi pa padma khrag 'thung gi gtor dbang kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i chog khrigs bzhin sgrub bskur dkyus ltar bya ba'am dbang chen gyi mtha' rten du bskur yang rung ngo*/ /padma khrag 'thung gi dbang bsdus kyi le tshan no// // ༈ nyer lnga pa bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung rgyas pa'i las tshogs tshe dbang kong smyon gyi chog khrigs bzhin dkyus ltar bskur ram dbang chen gyi mtha' rten byas kyang 'thus so/

/padma khrag 'thung tshe dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ bdud 'dul dram̐g pom̐ stobs ldan kīm̐ lam̐ yam̐'i/ /sminam̐ byem̐d pha lam rdo rje glog gi phreng*/ /dregs pa'i srog gi ti ka zab rgya can/ /gab dang dkrug med chu babs 'gros su dgod/ / ces nyer drug pa che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'di ni spros bcas dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig smin byed dbang chog chu 'bab kyi lugs su 'god pa la'ang*/ shin tu spros bcas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang ni/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs sta gon byas la/ bsnyen grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol te nyin bcu'i nang rdzogs par byed pa yin mod/ 'dir dbang rkyang gi khongs su sgrub khog gi nang bshad pa'i sta gon dang sgrub dbang rnams kyis 'thus par mdzad pa'i gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang*/ sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgrub gnas rnying pa'am ras bris lta bur ma byas kyang chog mod/ mdo tsam spros par mos na/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum chu gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ bsang chu 'thor byed ku sha sogs 'du bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsam ste las bum/ ḍā ru/ nas bzed/ yungs bzed/ g.yab dar/ rdor dril gdab phur nang mchod rnams dgod/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu bkod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: e las rang byung gzhal yas khang : gnam lcags las grub mtshan nyid rdzogs:

de dbus chos 'byung baṃ gyi steng : rang rig padma he ru kaḥ hya ghṛ wa dmar nag gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: sma ra dbu skra me 'od 'khrugs: rta skad hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes bgegs dpung 'joms: g.yon pa'i phur pas tshe bdud bsgral: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham brjid: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: drag sngags hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: rang byung ye shes lnga ru gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐: om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces bsdu ldang bya/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mthing nag phur bu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams shing*/ de'i steng gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/

zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog gu ru drag po'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badzra bha ra hi kro ti kā li badzra kī li kī la ya badzra ratna padma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī hya ghṛ wa badzra pā ṇi ḍākki ha ri ni sa yaksha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/

/de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha dang bum pa sta gon chabs cig tu bshad na/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan sogs bkram pa'i mdun stegs khebs ldan steng*/ maṇḍa lar dri'i thig le dbus dang*/ tshom bu lha grangs ltar bsnyen sgrub sngags kho na'i mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag phyed par bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma/ mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/ de nas bum pa rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la yungs dkar gyis brab/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang dri bzang bum rdzas so lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu gtsang phyed ka khengs par blugs/ rnam bum la mgul chings dmar nag dang*/ las bum la mgul chings ljang gu sgron/ kha rgyan gzung thag dang bcas pa 'du bya la tshom bu'i steng du rkang gsum thog dgod/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu dgram/ hūm̐: rang byung rlung me thod sgyed steng : sogs mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar gtong la bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa khyug tsam byas la rnam bum dang las bum sgrub te mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ spros med kyi skabs/ sgrub gzhi rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i lha tshogs dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal gdab la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod dang yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spos dang thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu so sor smin: de ldog phyir na rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis:

bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes pas nongs par bshags shing*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba ni/ dril spos dang bcas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs: khyed rnams mchod dang slob ma la: phan phyir dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma drag po che mchog kī la ya bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/

rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu khro bo'i gur: me dpung rab 'bar bgegs mtshams gcod: rdo rwa me ri phyi nang gur: mi shigs sra brtan rwa bas bskor: oṃ badzra tsakra raṃ khaḍga rakṣa rakṣa ham̐'u phaṭḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas te/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal gdab ste gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ 'dir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ gdul bya mtha' yas pas blo'i bye brag dang mthun par sems can gyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa sogs mdor bsdu na/ theg pa rim pa dgu'am gnyis te mtshan nyid mdo'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgo gnyis su 'du b.las/ da lam skabs su bab pa/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten 'di na kun mkhyen dang*/ /u dumbā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang nas re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'byon dka' ba ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho rnams nas rgya cher bsngags pa bzhin/ da lan dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal/

dam pa'i chos dang 'phrad/ de'ang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang 'phrad pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang po'i skabs 'dir/ slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi tshe sngon gyi bsags 'bras bzang po dus su smin pa yin pas/ dga' spro tshad med pa'i ngang nas bla ma che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar/ smin byed dbang gi sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i don du zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal phul gzhug /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul rgya mtshos bskor te sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i drung du byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ 'das dang ma byon dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: sgo gsum bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir: mi 'bral rtse gcig skyabs su mchi: de nas mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du smon 'jug bla na med pa'i sems mchog dam pa bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ srid zhi'i ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i mchog reg cing : nyon mongs chu srin las bsgral phyir: mtha' bral de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud dbang gi snod rung du bya ba'i phyir du phyag 'tshal ba sogs bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'i skabs don so so'i tshig don yid la bya bzhin par 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: bla ma thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dpa' bo rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no: chags bral padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: chos dbyings ro gcig ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis med 'khrul snang rang grol mchod pa 'bul: re dogs sdug bsngal skye med klong du bshags:

gdod ma'i chos sku'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: 'od gsal chos kyi sku la rjes yi rang : 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin bral bar chos 'khor bskor: dmigs med khyab brdal dge ba yongs su bsngo: kun kyang kun bzang klong du grol bar shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

dam chu slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi bsres pa thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs mchog thun rtsol med 'grub: nyams na snying khrag dbang po bcas: gshin rje'i sdig pas za bar 'gyur: oṃ ya mānta ka pā paṃ du sa ma ya na ra kan: rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra karma du pā la nan sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor/ de ni khyed rang rnams tshe rabs sngon gyi lhag pa'i lha gang yin dang dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su rang gi tshe rabs kyi las 'phro yod pa'i phyogs su phog par shog snyam pas sngags 'di rjes zlos dang bcas 'dor bar zhu/ oṃ badzra ha sa ha: zhes bden tshig dang bcas pas dor bas/ dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang drag po/ mtshams bzhir thun mong gi dngos grub phran tsheg re thob pa'i ltas yin/ gal te dal gyi phyi rol du lhung na ngan pas lan gsum du bskyal/ ma phog na ngan pas dbang gi snod du mi rung ba'i ltas yin pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa dang dge ba rlabs chen bya/ ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung bas/ lhag par tshogs brgya sātstsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis gang mang byin rlabs bya: pho'i lag g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du 'dogs: oṃ badzra he ru ka kro ta kro ti ma ma tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐ hūm̐: de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings la phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gcod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lngar mtshon pa'i kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba/

'di nyid bcings pas phyi ltar na rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing nang ltar na ma dag pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs/ gsang ba ltar na dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dam tshig 'khor lo'i rgya chings la: mi shigs rdo rje'i rgyas gdab ste: drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pas: dkyil 'khor dbang mchog brtan gyur cig: oṃ badzra tsakra tig shu sa ma ye: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ hya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shuddho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur: dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sngon du chu bo nai rañdza na'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad cing rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas te seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log nas mgo dkyil 'khor phyogs su gtad la rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ /hūm̐: sngon tshe rig 'dzin 'phags mchog gis: spros bral rtswa mchog gdan byas pas: byang chub rdo rje'i go 'phang grub: rtswa stan rten 'brel rmi lam thogs:

oṃ badzra ku sha lo ka pra ti dza hoḥ de nas cod pan 'dogs pa ni: cod pan gyis spyi bor brgyan pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags mtshon pa yin/ hoḥ rdzu 'phrul ye shes lnga dang ldan: dam tshig dbang gi cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor 'dogs: las rab dbang chen thob par shog: oṃ badzra shi ra si andza sa ma ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phur pa dang lnga ldan gyi me tog gtad de: pho'i gong g.yas dang mo'i gong g.yon du 'dogs: hūm̐: dam tshig srog gi gsang phur la: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dar tshon brgyan: mi shigs rdo rje'i yi ger btab: de ring skal ldan khyod kyis 'chongs: oṃ badzra kī la ya ant+ra ḍākki nī maṃ rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rang gi spyi gtsug zla gdan dbus: bcom ldan rdor sems dung mdog sku: rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: rnal 'byor dmar mo gri thod 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i na bza' bklubs: snang stong ma 'gags lam gyis gsal: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las: 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' ni: rang 'dra'i dbang lhas bskor bar byon: spyi bor zhu nas snying khar thim: thugs kar hrīḥyig dkar po'i mthar: sngags phreng 'od zer drwa ba can: g.yas g.yon bskor nas sdig sgrib dag: chu shel dwangs ma'i sgong ltar gyur: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas la skong bshags sogs la 'bad pas bar chad sel zhing dbang gi snod rung du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ rmi lam bzang po'i ltas dang ngan ltas gang byung yang re dogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i lam 'khyer la slob pa gal che/ de dag gis che mchog drag po kī la ya'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar smin byed sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub pa yin no/

/de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di? de dag gis sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub zin te dngos gzhi ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ / sta gon gyi le tshan no// // ༈ kī la ya'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa las dngos gzhi la bsham bkod dang sgrub pa bskur ba gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ yid mthun gyi gnas su stegs bu rgya khyon ji ltar rigs pa la rdul tshon ras bris 'bru tshom sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i dbus su/ mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis gtams pa'i steng du bhandha mtshan ldan bzang po bdud rtsis bkang ba dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa/ steng me long dang man shel 'jog /gtso gtor dbus su gdan gru bzhi bang rim gsum gyi khar/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng du rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng du dpal gyi gtor ma brjid chags pad 'dab bzhis spras pa mtshams bzhir mtheb skyu bzhi ril bu bzhis bskor ba/ gzhan yang bzlog gtor/ bka' srung ma gza' dam gsum/ chad brtan bskul gsum sngon gtor bcas bshams la mchod pas bskor/ dmigs bsal dregs pa'i srog gtad bya na gzhung gsal ltar bya/ 'dir lha dbang gi skor go bsgrigs bya sla ba'i ched/ sku tsaka gi go rim ni/ bum tsaka kī la khro rgyal/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ dregs pa khrag 'thung nag po/ bya khyung*/ khyung chen rigs lnga/ 'jam dpal gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ khro mo/ yaksha me dbal/ badzra kī la ya/ ratna kī la ya/ padma kī la ya/ karma kī la ya/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ khro bcu/ sku'i ging chen/ gsung gi ging chen/ thugs kyi ging chen/ yon tan gyi ging chen/ phrin las gyi ging chen/ shar gyi sgo ma/ lho'i sgo ma/ nub kyi sgo ma/ byang gi sgo ma/ dur khrod chas brgyad/ raksha'i phreng ba/

dkyil 'khor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ thun ru dang thun rdzas/ rakta/ mgo phreng*/ g.yang gzhi/ rdo rje/ phur bu/ hom gzar/ rig tsaka gzung thag dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan chas/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun/ ༈ de nas dregs pa'i srog dbang ni/ lha yi dregs pa/ srog yig /de bzhin du gshin rje/ ma mo/ bdud/ btsan/ gnod sbyin/ klu/ sogs sde brgyad dang dge bsnyen bzhi/ sogs tshags tshud par gang bder dgod/ 'og tu nya bo las phur btab pa 'jog /byang shar du las bum/ mdun du sgrub gtor dang sman raka /rgyab tu zor gtor ji ltar bab par chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi mchod gtor khor yug tu phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor tshogs chad brtan rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang mngon par 'du bya la/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung ste bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes se khol gtog pas gsal gdab la dzap bskul bzlas pa grub nas rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ gzung thag la 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ nas phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas bum sgrub ched du rtsa sngags sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ las bum sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs dang thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/

ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu'i mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ ༈ rig me dor ba spyi ltar byas rjes bsngo smon mdor bsdus tsam bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ rang lugs gsol kha spyi dang bye brag gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba ni/ sta gon sngon du song ba'i slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma drag po che mchog kī la ya bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig

/ gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid bdud 'dul khro rgyal gyi: thugs las 'gugs pa'i sa bon 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bgegs rnams khug: mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim zhing dengs: gal te 'tshe zhing sdang sems na: kī la khro tshogs me 'od 'khrugs: rdor mtshon char 'bebs bgegs dpung 'joms: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ ma hā gu ru kī la ya baṃ ḍākki nī gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu khro bo'i gur: me dpung rab 'bar bgegs mtshams chod: rdo rwa me ri phyi nang gur: mi shigs sra brtan rwa bas bskor: oṃ badzra tsakra raṃ khaḍga rakṣa rakṣa ham̐'u phaṭḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ slob dpon shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: sgo ba ging chen dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan las can te: dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya ba'i phyir: khyed rnams dam tshig sgo phyes 'tshal: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal ba 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ nged rnams khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i rigs: 'jigs byed me yi kha rlangs can: skal med sgrol ba'i gnyen po mchog:

khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing rigs dang skal par ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi sgo skyong ba: snying rje'i bdag nyid dregs pa'i gzugs: bar chod sgrol ba'i laṅka ging : nged rnams bka' mchis dam gnas so: zhes zhus pas phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pas nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /ces pas sgo dbye la nang du spro ba dang bcas 'jug pa la phyi 'brang gi bgegs rdo rje ging chen rnams kyis bskrad pa'i las mdzad par mos mdzod/ sgo drung du ging dkar nag gis rdo thun thogs te/ rngam stabs ha ha dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te phyir 'brang gi 'byung po bskrad/ hoḥ de ltar yin na nang du shog: ngar 'dzin ru tra'i bdud dang phral: bar chod bdud dang dam med rigs: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i thun gyis brdeg: oṃ badzra kro ta ging ka ra ging ka ra gnod byed dam sri hu lu ya phaṭḥ

ces slob bu rnams sgo phyi ma'i nang du zhugs: de nas nang du zhugs la gral du 'khod pa la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: khrag 'thung bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dpa' bos bdag la gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: hoḥ khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: bka' 'gal dam med mi 'jug phyir: khyed cag dam ldan yin lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ kun 'dus bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan cis mi dad: dam tshig dbang po dwang du blang : dam la mi 'da' na ra kan: de nas ye shes lnga'i dar thag ring po'i sne mor slob ma rnams kyis bzung ste slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i lam la khrid cing nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: yang gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig ldan pa'i bu mchog khyod: 'jug phyir dkyil 'khor gral du shog: ces pas nang du khrid nas gral la 'khod: sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i gdong g.yogs re bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsakṣu bhandha ma na wā ra hūm̐/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten du u dum wā ra la sogs pa mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig: om̐ puṣpe siddhi hūm̐: de nas lo rgyus brjod pa ni/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/
