de'i ched du smin byed dbang gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal gdab ste gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ 'dir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po de nyid kyi/ gdul bya'i blo yi bye brag dang mthun par theg pa rim pa dgu'am/ mtshan nyid mdo'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgo gnyis su 'du ba las/ da lam skabs su bab pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten 'di na kun mkhyen dang*/ /u dumbā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang nas re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshul du ma'i khyad par 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin zhing*/ dela'ang gsar rnying gnyis las 'di ni snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs su gtogs la/ der bka' gter dag snang bab so gsum du bzhugs pa'i skabs su bab pa zab mo gter gyi ring lugs yin/ dela'ang mang zhig bzhugs pas/ da lam 'di'i lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du gsol na/ o rgyan gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'am padma gter bdag gling pa zhes mthu nus yon tan 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid kyis ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas/ gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu nas zab gter bdun cu don lnga'i bgo skal bzhes pa'i nang tshan las 'di ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa phag lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'am/ brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu zhes bya ba yin la/ de'ang dbang mchog rdo rje'i phreng ba drag po'i rgyud dang lo rgyus dbye bar: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas ngas dang po mdo sngags rgyud kun la legs par sbyangs shing : dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad: rim par stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu:

khro bo 'dus pa rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes par: rgya bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis tho 'tshams pas: khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba stag zhon du sprul ste: lha srin gdug pa can rnams dam la btags shing bran du bkol: de'i dus su mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can gyis lung bstan pa ni: skye med kyi rang sgra las 'di ltar thos so: kye ma ya mtshan mchog gi sku: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i bdag nyid mchog: ma 'ongs yang mtha' kha ral dus: ru bzhi mi bde dbus 'khrug g.yo: mdo sngags ri mo shul rjes gtong : da lta'i sde brgyad ma rungs rigs: yang mthar bdud kyi kha 'dzin pas: rgyal khams phung ba'i sna thag 'dren: sgrub pa po la bar du gcod: gtsug lag chos 'khor rnams kyang 'joms: ma rungs de rnams dar ba'i tshe: srung zlog bsad pa'i gdams pa gces: zhes gsungs so: de nas mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'ang gdod ma'i dbyings su thim: slob dpon gyis khrag 'thung rngam pa'i dpa' stobs dang bcas: drag po ki lā ya chen por sprul te bdud 'dul gyi rang sgra 'di bsgrags so: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ artsig nirtsig badzra kī li kī la ya badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes drag sngags me'i rang bzhin can du 'bar bas 'khor rnams sngangs shing srog snying 'di phul lo: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya ṭa ṭa: oṃ kro ta kā la tsaṇḍa dun 'dus ṭa 'dus ṭa mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces brjod pas dregs pa ma rungs pa'i rigs rnams shin tu brgyal bar 'gyur to: de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phags te: khro bo'i zhal nas bdud 'dul gyi tha tshig 'di bsgrags: hūm̐ hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog kī la rngam pa'i sgra: lha srin sde brgyad mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod rigs: bstan la sdang zhing gdug pa'i g.yul bsham na: bdud 'dul ngan sngags drag pos 'joms par gyis: hūm̐ ṭa hūm̐ ṭa dun ṭa phaṭ ṭa ram̐:

zhes khro bos drag sngags bgrangs shing rdo rje gdeng ba las me dpung rab tu mched de mu stegs phal cher brgyal thabs su rengs par gyur to: de nas drag po'i dal du zhugs nas phyag gnyis rdo rje dang phur pa gdeng ste: 'di skad ces gsungs so: e ma hoḥ nyon dang jo mo mtsho rgyal lcam: mkha' 'gro'i brda lung ci bzhin du: mu stegs 'dre rgod 'dul mdzad pa: drag sngags srid pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ e ma zab pa'i yang gsang bla med 'di: gsang sngags 'khrul med rnal 'byor snying gi chos: log lta tshar gcod smin grol dbang bzhi ldan: mtsho rgyal yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang smon lam thob: gdams ngag snying du chongs la brtson 'grus bskyed: dus mtha'i rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: sa steng log chos mu stegs dmag gis khengs: chos la 'dre zhugs bande glang snying gi: dam log sprul pa kha dar sa steng khengs: 'dzam gling gsal ba'i gsang sngags sgron me 'di: dam sri chos gzugs bzhi yis bsnub par 'byung : res mos dga' sdug dar thag rlung g.yos ltar: gsal yang bstan pa'i 'phel sgrib dug rlangs 'phyur: stong sgra tig chom sa g.yos than ltas 'byung : che chung ma nges log chos blo gtad 'cha': chos spyod rgyal po sdig gi dmangs su 'bebs: sa snying kha tham dam chos mi 'dod 'byung : de dus mi rnams rang phung mtshon cha spyod: nad du rmu chu zha grum khong lhog dang : gdon du rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rgya 'dre ldang : sku gsung thugs rten mer bsreg chu la bskyur: dus ngan 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa 'byung : gnas khang rnams kyang zhig ral had por lus: mtha' mi mgo can bzhi yang dbus su 'thab: de dus 'o skol 'gro rnams snying re rje: zhes slob dpon gyis de skad gsungs pa'i mod la: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis spyan chab mang po shor te smre sngags kyis zhus pa:

kye ma kyi hud rje btsun gu ru lags: sdug bsngal las ngan dus ngan de byung tshe: phan pa'i man ngag zab gnad ji ltar lags: thugs kyi ti ka yongs rdzogs stsol bar zhu: zhes zhus pas slob dpon gyis: nyon cig bu mo skal ldan mtsho rgyal ma: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog thabs bsrung thabs dang : bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel chos bzhin skyong sgrub bstan: drag sgrub gsang ba'i sgrub thabs 'di lta bu: phyi sgrub drag po dregs pa yongs rdzogs dang : gsang sgrub kī la me yi spu gri dang : nang sgrub hūm̐ gi skor dang rnam gsum bstan: gsang ba'i zab shog thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi 'phel 'grib shar ba'i dus: las can hūm̐ gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin dus bab kyi zab chos byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang skur zab mo sgrub par bgyi ba la'ang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ sta gon gyi chos rnams grub la dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa la/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul rgya mtshos bskor te sprin phung gtib pa ltar bzhugs pa'i drung du/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

na moḥ 'das dang ma byon dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: sgo gsum bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir: mi 'bral rtse gcig skyabs su mchi: de nas mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du smon 'jug bla na med pa'i sems mchog dam pa bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ srid pa'i ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i mchog reg cing : nyon mongs chu srin las bsgral phyir: mtha' bral de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud dbang gi snod rung du bya ba'i phyir du phyag 'tshal ba sogs bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'i skabs don so so'i tshig don yid la bya bzhin par 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: bla ma thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dpa' bo rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no: chags bral padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: chos dbyings ro gcig ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis med 'khrul snang rang grol mchod pa 'bul: re dogs sdug bsngal skye med klong du bshags: gdod ma'i chos sku'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: 'od gsal chos kyi sku la rjes yi rang : 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin bral bar chos 'khor bskor: dmigs med khyab brdal dge ba yongs su bsngo: kun kyang kun bzang klong du grol bar shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hoḥ 'di ni che mchog khro rgyal gyi: dam tshig rdo rje las kyi chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs mnyes: dam med dbang po bsreg par 'gyur: rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra pā paṃ ru lu na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las che mchog ma hā gu ru drag tu khros pa'i ngo bo/ /bdud 'dul kī la ya khro bo'i rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag bco brgyad khro bo'i zhabs brgyad lha srin sde brgyad kyi snying khar brjid pa: zhal rnams shin tu khro zhing spyan drag po'i glog ltar du 'khyug pa: rngam pa'i mche ba gtsigs shing spyi bor thod skam dang dar nag 'phur ba: dbu skra dmar nag sprin ltar du gzengs pa'i gseb nas rta zhal rnam gsum rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa: snyan g.yas g.yon du khyung dang seṅges brgyan cing sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug: gnyis pas rdo rje: gsum pas ral gri/ bzhi pas gsal shing*/ lnga pas rgyu zhags: drug pas gsang rnga: bdun pas thong gshol:

brgyad pas tshangs mgo: dgu pas me'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o: g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag: gnyis pas kha ṭwāṃ: gsum pas lcags sdig: bzhi pas spu gri: lnga pas mdung thung : drug pas me zhags: bdun pas tsitta: brgyad pas klu mgo: dgu pas khro rgyal gyi phur bu 'gril ba: spu gri'i sgro gshog dang rdo rje'i go khrab kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba: de'i thugs kar dregs pa zil gnon kī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug pa shin tu khro ba: phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag: bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang kha ṭwāṃ: tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang phur pa'i steng du lcags sdig gis brgyan pa: sku smad khro chu'i phur gsham rngam pa: yum bdud 'dul khro mo gri thod mar 'khyud pa: de'i thugs kar bdud 'dul kī la zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dril ba: dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa: dbal zur rngam pa: yum drag mo bdud 'dul mar 'khril ba'o: gtso bo'i pang du yum tsa ti dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa spyi bor phag mgos brgyan pa phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gri thod/ bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang nad rkyal/ mtha' gnyis kyis be con dang rgyu zhags 'dzin cing zhabs bzhis yab la 'khril ba'o: de'i spyi bor gu ru snang srid zil gnon thod phreng rol pa'i cha lugs can gzi brjid 'phro ba: dpral bar 'jam dpal ral gri dang po ti: mgrin par rta mgrin dbyug pa dang lcags sgrog: snying khar phyag rdor rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub: lte bar khro mo gri gug dang thod khrag: gsang bar yaksha dang tho ba dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dur khrod chas brgyad dang rab tu ldan pa'o: shar du badzra kī la ya: lho ru ratna kī la ya: nub tu padma kī la ya: byang du karma kī la ya ste sras bzhi'ang : gtso bo rang 'dra ba'i chas la phyag rnams kyis rdo rje dang phur pa 'dzin pa me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o:

de'i phyi rol dregs pa sde brgyad sgo ba ging laṅka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa til gyi gang bu 'phel ba'i grangs dang mnyam par gsal thob/ de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings dang*/ gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas bla ma che mchog kī la ya drag po 'dus pa'i lha tshogs ma lus pa nam mkha' bar snang kun khengs te/ snang srid thams cad yom yom shig shig tu g.yo zhing*/ dus mtha'i rlung dang 'bigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog rgod tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bar rgya mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /

ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: che mchog 'dus pa khro bo rol pa'i lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur mdzad phyir: thogs med thugs rje'i nus rtsal myur du skyed: ye shes dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bdag la stsol: skal ldan dbang bskur byin chen dbab tu gsol: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ me tog 'dor ba'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya ste/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid khyed rang dang tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor bar zhu/ shar lho nub byang gi sgo ma rnams la smon lam 'di ltar gdab: dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor shar sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lho sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: bam̐ḥ nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor nub sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor byang sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig:

oṃ badzra puṣpe ind+ra ye swā hā: zhes dor te gang du babs pa'i gsang mtshan rigs mthun gsang mtshan ming 'dogs so: de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal ba'i mos shig / slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la: hūm̐: yang dag sa mkhan ye shes spyan: khyed kyi ma rig mun pa'i tshogs: shes rig rdo rje'i thur mas phye: 'od gsal mchog gi spyan ldan shog: oṃ tsakṣu pra we sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: de ltar glo bur gyi sgrib pa bsal nas rnam dag ye shes kyi mig thob pas bla med yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rol pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis phyag shing thogs la/ hoḥ che mchog khrag 'thung sprul pa'i gzhal yas chen po 'di mjal ba ni khyed rang rnams kyang las dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas: legs par ltos shig: dang po dkyil 'khor 'di la sgo brgyad yod pa ni: sgo brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi brda: logs bcu drug ni 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'byed pa rig pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi brda: rmang rdo rje rgya gram ni mi shigs pa'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i brda: rtsig pa lnga ni ye shes lnga'i brda: 'dod snam dmar bar lha mos brgyan pa ni shes rab kyi bud med rnams kyis 'khor ba'i bag chags bsregs pa'i brda: pha gu ser zhing drwa phyed nag pa ni: pho brang la brten nas ye shes kyi khro bo sprul pa'i brda: mda' yab pu shu ba gam la thod pas brgyan pa ni: phyi'i log rtog ngan pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i brda: thog steng thams cad mi lpags dang rus rgyan la sogs pas brgyan pa ni nyon mongs ma spangs par gnas su dag nas rang byung gi ngo bor yon tan lhun grub tu rdzogs pa'i brda:

chos 'khor la me dpung dang khyung chen gyis brgyan cing dur khrod kyi bkod pa rdzogs pa ni zhi ba'i rang mdangs la khro bo'i zer 'gyed pa'i brda: phyi rol rdo rwa dang dur khrod me ris bskor ba ni: khrag 'thung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: drwa mig dang : me long : rdo rje: phur pa: ral gri: rgyal mtshan: mda' dar gyis brgyan pa ni: ye nas kī la ya srung ba'i gur khang dgu dang ldan pa'i brda: ka rgyan gnam rgyan yol bas mdzes pa ni gzhi'i dkyil 'khor lam gyi gsal mdangs du mas mtshon pa'i brda: phyi nang gi mchod gtor rgya chen por bshams pa ni skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams mchog thun smin grol gyi lam mchog zab mo la 'god pa'i brda'o: de ltar dkyil 'khor kyi rnam bshad legs par thob pas deng phyin chad dkyil 'khor phyi nang bskyed rdzogs gi bya bar las su rung ba'i skal ldan du byas so: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/ nang rdo rje phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ /ces de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas snod bcud snang grags rig gsum/ lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ he ru ka pa'i dkyil 'khor du: yang dag skal ldan 'jug mdzad phyir: smin grol dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ badzra tiṣṭha lhan: a be sha ya a āḥ de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi dbang ni/ de la spyir dbang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi 'tshogs pa la brten nas go 'phang gi chos rgyud la 'jog par byed pa ste/ dang po la'ang gnyis las de'ang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ni gdod nas rang chas su zhugs pa'i chos nyid de/ bye brag tu phung khams skye mched lhar gnas pa bum dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ ngag rlung yi ge dang bcas pa sngags su gnas pa gsang dbang gi mtshungs ldan no/ khams kyi dwangs ma bde chen du 'dug pa sher dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ sems chos skur gnas pa bzhi pa ste/ de dang de'i mtshungs ldan no/ dbang mchog rgyal po'i rgyud las/ dbang mchog rang la med gyur na/ /bskur bas 'thob par ga la 'gyur/ /bra sran 'bras bu'i dbang bskur yang*/ /de la 'bras kyi dngos snang med/ /ces gsungs so/ gnyis pa lhan cig byed rgyu ni/ slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas pa'i dbang rdzas khyad par can nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rkyen bzhi ni/ dad brtson brtul zhugs dang ldan pa'i slob bu rgyu'i rkyen/ slob ma'i rgyud smin nus pa'i mtshan nyid kun tshang gi slob dpon bdag po'i rkyen/ brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan zhing gzhung ltar cho ga'i yan lag tshang ba'i nus pa khyad par can dmigs pa'i rkyen/ snga ma snga mas go phyes nas phyi ma phyi mas 'byung zhing brda don 'phrod pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ de lta bu'i rgyu rkyen gyi chos drug 'tshogs pa la brten te/ go 'phang gi chos dbang gi ye shes rgyud la 'jog pa'i las kyi thar pa'i myu gu mngon du bskyed pa'am/ skye nges kyi nus rung du smin par byed pa'am/ nges tshig ni/ gtor blugs te/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'khrus pa'i cha nas gtor ba dang*/

'bras bu ye shes kyi nus pa khyad par can 'jog pa'i cha nas blugs pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya bas/ /des na dbang zhes brjod par bya/ zhes dang*/ dbye ba ni/ spyir gang zag gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar te/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang*/ grol byed lam gyi dbang*/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste gsum du bzhag pa dang*/ rnam pa bye brag rgyud sde'i dbang gi babs so mi 'dra ba bzhir bzhag pa sogs mtha' yas kyang*/ gsang ba bla med kyi skabs 'dir/ snying po'i rgyud phyi mar/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /de ma thag pa'i bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dbang bzhir nges pa yin no/ /de ltar dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon kyang*/ gnas skabs grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo gdab pa'i snod du rung zhing*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid phrin las bzhi rdzogs kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud las/ gang zhig dbang bskur 'dzin pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sku la 'di yis reg /'di la skyes bu'i dbang thob na/ /rig pa'i sku la rang dbang thob/ /ces so/ /dbang tshul bzhin du ma thob par/ /ye shes kyi lha'i bsnyen sgrub lta ci/ rgyud tshig klog pa dang phrin las kyi tshig shar gyer ba la'ang mi dbang ste/ phyag chen thig le kha sbyor las/ dbang ma thob la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bar mar med bzhin/ /de bas dbang bskur dam pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas blang bar bya/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de'ang bla med kyi rgyud sder bum gsang sher ye tshig gi dbang bzhi grags che la/ re re la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba du mar 'byung ba las/ 'di ni sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po las/ dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtogs na/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang*/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/

nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal pa ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med du lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces brda sbyar nas/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa mi shigs chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni che mchog yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: che mchog 'dus pa sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang zhing nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ arghaṃ

sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇḍal phul: gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa la sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin par nges shes bskyed cing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ 'og min gyi zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par du mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas kī la ya khro rgyal gyi sku spyi bor bzhag cing: hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog stobs 'dus pa: 'jigs byed gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: sku gsung thugs mchog 'dus pa'i dpal: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas zil gnon rtsal gyi sku thogs la: khyed rang rnams la gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi dbang bskur bas/ gnyis snang gi chos thams cad gnyis med ye shes kyi rgyas thebs shing ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog: bdud 'dul dregs pa zil gnon rtsal: mkha' 'gro rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dregs pa khrag 'thung nag po thogs la: hūm̐: ma hā gu ru zil gnon rtsal: bdud dang mu stegs 'dul mdzad pa: drag sngags dmod pa he ru kas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas bya khyung thogs te: khyed rang rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbang chen che mchog ki la ya'i dbu gtsug tu rtsal chen ye shes kyi bya khyung me zer dang gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ krang kring 'jigs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar byon khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan pas/ sgong chag gi khyung bzhin 'khor ba la ji mi snyam pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pas 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyung chen rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal sprul pa'i ga ru ḍaḥ klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: nad rims dal yams 'joms mdzad pa: bya khyung rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas 'jam dpal gyi tsakli dpral bar bzhag cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku yi bdag nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzi brjid chen po dbang thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: sku yi gzi brjid gshin rje'i gshed: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: stobs 'dus dpa' bo chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ

rta mgrin gyi tsakli mgrin par bzhag cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das gsung mchog padma dbang chen gyi dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung bdag nyid nus mthu chen po yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: gsung gi dbang phyug he ru kaḥ drag sngags bdag po dbang gi sku: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyag rdor gyi tsakli snying khar bzhag cing: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das thugs mchog gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bdag nyid ye shes chen po yongs su rdzogs dbang chen po thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: thugs mchog mi g.yo gtum chen dpal: nus pa'i rtsal ldan rdo rje'i me: khro rgyal gsang bdag chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas khro mo lte bar bzhag cing: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la yon tan ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan yid bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chen po thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: srid gsum mnga' bdag khros pa'i sku: bdud 'dul chen mo 'bar ba'i gzugs: las bzhi'i dbang mo chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas yaksha me dbal gyi tsakli gsang bar bskur la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bdud 'dul phrin las yaksha me dbal gyi dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid las bzhi lhun grub chen po dbang thob par gyur cig

/hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi stobs 'dus pa: gzi byin mthu stobs rtsal dang ldan: dgyes pa'i dbang phyug ston mdzad pa: yaksha khro bos dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas yang badzra kī la ya thogs nas: khyed rang rnams la dpal chen badzra kī la ya yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ zhi ba'i phrin las ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: che mchog badzra kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa'i sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: nad gdon zhi ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas ratna kī la ya thogs nas: khyed rang rnams la dpal chen ratna kī la ya yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ rgyas pa'i phrin las ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: che mchog ratna kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa'i sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tshe bsod rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas padma kī la ya thogs nas: khyed rang rnams la dpal chen padma kī la ya yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi phrin las ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: che mchog padma kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa'i sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas karma kī la ya thogs nas: khyed rang rnams la dpal chen karma kī la ya yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig

/hūm̐: che mchog karma kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa'i sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: da khyed rang rnams la yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i dbang bskur bas/ zhe sdang gnas su dag ste me long ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: zhe sdang gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: khyed rang rnams la yum chen rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal gnas su dag ste mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: yum chen ratna mkha' 'gro ma: nga rgyal gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas padma mkha' 'gro thogs la: khyed rang rnams la yum chen padma mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bas/ 'dod chags gnas su dag ste sor rtogs ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: yum chen padma mkha' 'gro ma: 'dod chags gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: khyed rang rnams la yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bas/ phrag dog gnas su dag ste bya grub ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐: yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: phrag dog gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro thogs la: khyed rang rnams la yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bas/ gti mug gnas su dag ste chos dbyings ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: gti mug gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas khro bcu'i tsakli thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la dpal chen po bdud 'dul khro bcu yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas pha rol phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs/ sa bcu cig car du bgrod cing*/ stobs bcu'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: che mchog sprul pa'i 'od zer las: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i khro bo bcu: sa bcu mnga' ba'i dbang phyug pa'i: yab yum gnyis med dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ sku'i ging chen thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la rdo rje ging chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ zhe sdang rang sar dag ste sku'i phrin las yongs su grub pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: zhe sdang chu khams dag pa yi: sku yi ging chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas gsung gi ging chen thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la padma ging chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/

'dod chags rang sar dag ste gsung gi phrin las yongs su grub pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: 'dod chags me khams gnas dag pa'i: gsung gi ging chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas thugs kyi ging chen thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la buddha ging chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ gti mug rang sar dag ste thugs kyi phrin las yongs su grub pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: gti mug ma rig gnas dag pa'i: thugs kyi ging chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas yon tan ging chen thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la ratna ging chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal rang sar dag ste yon tan gyi las yongs su grub pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: nga rgyal sa khams gnas dag pa'i: yon tan ging chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phrin las ging chen thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la karma ging chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ phrag dog rang sar dag ste phrin las yongs su grub pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: phrag dog rlung khams gnas dag pa'i: phrin las ging chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas shar gyi sgo ma thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la byams pa tshad med kyi ngo bo shar gyi sgo skyong ma'i dbang bskur bas rtag lta gnas su dag

/'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bar mos shig /dzaḥ shar phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: byams pa'i 'od zer ston mdzad ma: 'jigs brgyad zhi mdzad chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas lho'i sgo ma thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la snying rje tshad med kyi ngo bo lho'i sgo skyong ma'i dbang bskur bas chad lta gnas su dag /'byor ba drug sogs rgyas pa'i las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bar mos shig /hūm̐: lho phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: snying rjes thar lam ston mdzad ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas nub kyi sgo ma thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la dga' ba tshad med kyi ngo bo nub kyi sgo skyong ma'i dbang bskur bas bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag /mos bzhi sogs dbang gi las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bar mos shig /bam̐ḥ nub phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: dga' bzhi bde stong bskyed mdzad ma: mos bzhis dbang sdud chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas byang gi sgo ma thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngo bo byang gi sgo skyong ma'i dbang bskur bas mtshan mar lta ba gnas su dag /dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba sogs drag po'i las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bar mos shig /hoḥ byang phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: btang snyoms 'khor 'das shan 'byed ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar lha tshogs rnams gnas so sor thim pas che mchog padma drag po'i ki la ya/ sku'i rnam 'gyur gang dang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i rnam rol 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob pa yin no/ /de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog he ru ka drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas khams gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyis dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol bas ma mo mkha' 'gros rje bor bskur te dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing*/ zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu dang : glang ko zhing lpags chu srin gos: sbrul chun mgo phreng rus pa'i rgyan: khrag zhag stag sham dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes shing 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor bas 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces ru raksha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badzra bha ra hi kro ti kā li badzra kī li kī la ya badzra ratna padma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī hya ghṛ wa badzra pā ṇi ḍākk-i ha ri ni sa yaksha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du bhandha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhandha dri med longs sku'i rtsal snod mchog: bcud ni dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: che mchog 'dus pa gsung gi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas raksha'i phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: drag sngags kun 'dus khro rgyal me phreng can: phrin las dmod pa bor chog sngags phreng 'dis: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang skur ro: che mchog 'dus pa phrin las dbang thob shog:

ces rtsa sngags dang bcas nas bskur ro: de nas rdo rje dril bu thogs nas: hoḥ dril bu 'di gnyis med longs sku grags stong gi gzugs dang ldan pa mgo bo rdo rje ni thabs la ske bum pa ni gzhal yas khang : rtsa ba sgra ldan ni shes rab yin pas: gnyis med zung 'jug gi don dang ldan pa: sgra bzlas sngags thams cad brag cha lta bu'am: pi waṃ gi sgra lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor ltar yin par ngo shes nas: gnyis med a nu yo ga'i ngo sprod thob pa yin no: de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon spyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor thogs la: hūm̐: che mchog 'dus pa bla ma drag po rtsal: yongs rdzogs ngo sprod dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i mchog: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: che mchog 'dus pa thugs kyi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/

'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: ngo mtshar rmad byung dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpal: rtsa gsum kun 'dus 'dod yon lha yi gtor: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: che mchog 'dus pa yon tan dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de nas tshogs kyi yo byad gtad cing : hūm̐: ngo bor 'dod yon rmad du byung : bha ling gtor mchod bla na med: ga ṇa tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di: skal ldan khyod la zas su sbyin: zhes rtsa sngags kyis sbyin: de nas tshogs chang thogs nas: hūm̐: rin chen rang byung snod mchog tu: 'bras rgun bu ram sbrang gi chang : gtams pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di: skal ldan khyod la skom du sbyin: zhes rtsa sngags kyis sbyin: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la mngon spyod rtsom pa po rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog gu ru drag po gtum drag shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i skur lam gyis gsal zhing lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs/

sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/ spyod pa snying rje'i srog dang ldan pas mngon spyod kyi las la rtsom par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgral dbang dngos la'ang bsad pa/ bzlog pa/ 'phang ba/ sreg pa/ mnan pa dang lnga las/ dang po bsad pa'i ched du mnga' gsol zhing thugs dam bskul ba la thugs gtad par zhu/ dang po bsad pa'i dngos gzhir mdun du hom khung liṅga las phur dbye sgro bsgral chas rnams 'du bya la/ de nas slob dpon drag po'i chas su zhugs shing dar nag dang*/ zhwa nag gos nag gis brgyan cing*/ de nas slob dpon gyi phyag tu 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par drag po kī la'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ de nas gdab las bya ba la phrin las rtsom pa'i yul nyams pa bdun ldan gyi dgra bgegs la/ ji ltar brtsam pa'i phrin las dmigs pa'i rim pa gsal 'debs gnang bar zhu/ phaṭḥ mdun du e las gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po mun pa dgu rim gyi rang bzhin nag la 'thug pa tsha la rtsub pa dmar la rngam pa: steng na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: 'og na 'dod chags kyi chu khol ba: bar na nga rgyal gyi thog ser 'bebs pa:

log na phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa: las kyi gshin rje'i bsha' ra: bdud kyi bsad ra: srog gcod nag po'i btson khang : snang srid srog bdag nag po'i brub khung : zin nas thar pa med pa de'i nang du: nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo byad ma de nyid lus nyams pa sngo la ham pa srog chad la khad: dbugs bral la khad: lag pa gnyis kyis skra 'bal zhing brang brdungs pa: bu ga dgu nas nad rlangs dang khrag 'dzag pa: mgo bo lho nub mtshams su bstan zhing : rkang pa byang du bsgrogs pa: dmyal srung las mkhan nag po'i zhags pas drag tu bsdams pa: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bskor nas bros dbang med pa zhig tu gyur: bka'i bden stobs kyis 'gugs shing dmigs pa'i rten la dbab pa ni: na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du bdud 'dul che mchog kī la ya rigs lnga: ye shes kyi khro mo lnga: sprul pa'i khro bo yab yum bcu: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sgo ma bzhi: dregs pa'i sde tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la snga dgra lag gis bsdo ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed ky-i bgegs/ dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig /tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ rgya bzhi dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: mdun gyi drag po'i hom khung du: dmigs bya dgra bo myur du khug: pho nya las mkhan dus la bab: 'gugs shing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ru tra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas thun ru'i thun gyis brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: tshe nyungs zangs lcags rdo yi thun: dug thun skam rlon nad rlung 'thibs: ldog med drag po'i thun zor ya: gtub cing dgra sri rdul du rlog: oṃ tsha thun na lo nye thun kha lo ya rbad rbad: de nas thun ru dang rdzas lag tu gtad de: hūm̐: srin glang dmar po'i lho rwa la: mi shor chu gnas srid pa'i gzugs: thun rdzas skam rlon snod mchog gtad: bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral bar gyis: oṃ thun dza bhed ya ha la sa ma ya: slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i bde gshegs kyi sras mchog badzra ki' la ya phyag gnyis kyis phur bu 'dril ba/ sku smad dbal phur zur gsum 'bar ba la thog mda' skar chen gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ srid gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa 'di nyid lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis/ thabs kyis mi thul ba'i gdul bya log 'dren bdud kyi dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang nus rtsal yongs su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa kī la ya: thugs dam tha tshig gnad nas bskul: nyes can dgra bo dam nyams 'di'i: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ru tra shag tshal pa rbad rbad: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padm sogs drag sngags so lnga phur bskor dang bcas 'debs tshul bya la thams cad kyis bsgral: tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal bar/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/ nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus dwangs ma'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtser ling gis btegs nas dpal chen po'i thugs kar stim/

phur bu'i dbal nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par gyur/ de nas gtub cing slob ma rnams la 'bul ba ni: de nas khyed rang rnams dpal chen por gsal ba la nyon mongs dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i sha khrag zhal du phul bas/ bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum rtsad nas bcom zhing mtshan ma'i bdud tshogs kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal phyes shig: dgra bo'i sha khrag zhal du stob: zhe sdang spyod cing sha la zo: rtag tu srog gcod byed par gyis: oṃ he ru ka hā la pañtsa māṃ sa khā hi: de nas rakta gtad cing : hūm̐: 'dod chags spyod pa'i bdag nyid che: skom du khrag mchod 'thung bar gyis: rtag tu dug lnga'i rakta 'thung : 'dod chags spyod pa ma spongs shig: rakta pū dza khā hi: de nas bsad las spyi'i mtha' rten du drag po sngags kyi rjes gnang dang las chas gtad pa la dang po mgo phreng gtad de/ hūm̐: srin po raksha'i mgo bo la: drag sngags dmod pa'i phreng ba bsgrubs: ngan sngags bzlas pa 'dren par gyis: bsad pa las bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma la ru tra mā ra ya rbad a be sha ya āḥ de nas g.yang gzhi gtad cing : hūm̐: gti mug gdug pa'i g.yang gzhi'i gos: rtag tu gyon zhing 'chang bar gyis: blang dor med pa'i gti mug spyod: 'jol nyog ci ltar dgyes par gyis: oṃ saṃ bho ra tsitta ba ra hoḥ rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad de: hūm̐: rdo rje drag po dga' ba che: rdo rje hūm̐ ste sgra sgrogs pa: mi phyed rdo rje 'bar ba che'i: las kyi rdo rje 'chang bar gyis: oṃ badzra a ḍaṃ hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phur bu g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: rdo rje sgeg pa'i gtum nyid las: srid pa'i ri rab phur bu grub: 'bebs pa rdo rje kī la che: las kyi phur bu 'chang bar gyis: oṃ badzra anḍa kī la ya hūm̐ hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnyis pa bzlog pa ni zor gtor dpal 'bar btsug nas/

hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng skur bzhengs shig: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: du ru ra tsa bzlog pa'i dus la bab: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mu stegs dmag g.yo bzlog pa'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gnyan nad smyo 'bog 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sngon gyi dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags 'khor lo'i steng : gnas pa'i sde brgyad dmag dpung rnams: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te: rang rtags rgyan dang phyag mtshan rdzogs: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: rngam brjid ha ha'i gad mo sgrogs: rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal bar rlog: las la chas pa'i mthu bo che: srog la rngam pa'i 'jig rten lha: myur du rgyug pa'i drag rtsal can: bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: sde brgyad mngon spyod las la bskul: khyed rnams gang bcol phrin las rnams: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: sangs rgyas bstan la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can las la chos: mtha' 'khob dmag tshogs bzlog pa dang : dus 'khrug nad yams bzlog pa sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa na sa ma ya hūm̐: gsum pa pha rol gyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i don du 'phang ba ni/ dmigs bya rten la 'gugs gzhug drag po dang bcas/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang du bzhugs nas gtor ma'i dam tshig pa srid gsum phung ba'i nad mtshon dug gi sdong por dmigs la gtor zor lag tu thogs te dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /da khyed rang rnams dpal chen por gsal ba'i gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags kyi thog ltar 'phang bas bstan dgra bdud dpung brlag pa'i mthu thob par mos mdzod:

gtor zor lag tu gtad cing mthar 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus he ru kas: stong gsum dmigs pa'i zor chen bsgril: gdug pa'i dug rdzas sna dgus brgyan: dregs pa gshin rje'i dmod pa bor: ldog med las kyi dbal zor 'dis: bzlog go chag che nyam nga zlog: bsgyur ro rkyen ngan dgra la sgyur: rbad do pho nya las la bskul: 'phen no dgra bo'i srog la ya: hūm̐ kro ta ya: nye lo ya: te lo ya: shag dza ya: rbad bhyo ya: ru tra ya: tra tra ya: rbad lo ya: thun thun ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces gtor zor me hom gyi dbus su 'phang la bsreg go /bzhi pa drag po bsreg pa'i las mtha' brtsam pa ni/ shin tu mi bsrun pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i phyir du dug shing gi me hom lcags snod du sbar la sreg ling yod na dgra bgegs dngos su dmigs la bsreg /med tshe ling ro me hom du bsregs shing : phaṭḥ skad cig gis mdun du dur khrod kyi pho brang la gshin rje gdug pa'i me hom mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su ngo bo khrag 'thung la rnam pa me lha'i gtso bo ltar gsal bar gyur:

hom bskyed bya: de nas bsreg pa ni/ hūm̐: gru gsum gshin rje'i pho brang du: dug shing sna dgu'i sbyin sreg sbar: dgra bgegs ru tra'i sha khrag 'di: 'jigs byed me lha'i zhal du thob: oṃ agne ye ru tra dzwa la ram̐ ram̐: zhes me hom du phul lo/ /de nas hom gzar gtad pa ni: slar yang de'i nus pa brtan par bya ba'i don du hom gzar dang thab gtad la/ hūm̐: snang srid gnyis kyi nyi zla'i snod: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi hom yangs 'di: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: bsgral mchod sbyin sreg brtson par gyis: oṃ tha ru bi na dzwa la raṃ bha ta hi hoḥ lnga pa las mtha' mi mngon par rgyas gdab pa'i don du mnan pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs rje drag po'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas phye mar gas pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas hab sgra dir gyis lhags pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bden stobs drag pos srid pa gsum gyi dgra bgegs dam sri bdud rigs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas 'chi bdag gi zhal du stim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo g.yam la yi ge tri re re bris nas rang mal de ru mnan par gsungs kyang lag len du mi bde na/ sngar drag sreg gi me thal sgo drung du mnan la de steng gtor gzhong kha sbub ste bden stobs 'gugs gzhug gi mthar/ hūm̐: khro rgyal bdud 'dul bden pa'i mthus: dam sri gzugs kyi liṅgar khug: rim dgu'i sa 'og gshin rjer gtad: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas las gzhung bzhin rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje rngam klong bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i bag chags dbyings su gtor: pho brang yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong pho nyas bro brdungs pas:

zhe sdang ru tra thabs kyis bsgral: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i mtshan ma bshig: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang 'khor ba yongs grol gar: gsang sngags rdo rje'i khro bo yis: rgyas gdab ru tra ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: zhes mnan zhing lug gu rgyud du brdung : zhes gtad pas mthar shor med rgya mtsho'i klong du chol sgra dang bcas nas thim pa'i steng du ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa dpal chen po'i pho brang gsal ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams drag po kī la ya'i thugs rje drag po'i phyag rgya rdzogs pas srid pa dpyi gnon gyi bro brdung gzir zhing bdud tshogs nam yang ldang med du bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor snod kha yar bzed la bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku dri med rol rtsal drag po'i lhas: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: zhes gtor gzhong la me tog 'thor ro/ / de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas/ khrag 'thung he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas me long dang lha sku ngos sbyor thogs nas:

hūm̐: ma skyes chu zla'i stong gzugs sam me long 'gying log lta bu'am: dbyings la mkha' yi gzhu shar ba lta bur khyod kyis deng phyin chod: bskyed rim sprul sku'i lam khyer gyi phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa: ma hā yo ga'i ngo sprod thob pa yin no: zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen por bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rtsa gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul skur 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / de nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang dbang bka' rgya ma las gzungs ma mtshan ldan bcu drug dang nyer lnga'i bar: lus 'tshams dang che chung ran pa dam tshig gtsang ma gsang thub pa lus rgyas shing bde drod dang ldan pa: dang po dbang gis rgyud smin par byin gyis brlabs: rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad cing rten 'brel brtag: bar du khrus bya: gos dkar gyon zhing bgegs bskrad te: bla ma la maṇḍal gyi tshul du 'bul: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma la: nyams tshad gsum btab pa'i dam ldan min na bskur du mi rung : dam ldan la zab lam bstan pa ni: dang po bum dbang nas me long bar rdzogs rjes: gzungs ma de slob bu rnams kyis bla ma la 'bul zhing :

zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ da lam gsang dbang bskur ba'i don du slob ma rnams kyi gsang ba'i gzungs ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lo bcu drug lon pa zhig bla ma la maṇḍal gyi tshul du dbul ba'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye: gzhi lam gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'dir: mtshan tshang shes rab rgyas shing mdzes: 'bul bzhes bdag la gnang ba stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis rig ma'i rgyud smin cing grol bar byas la/ rig ma de rigs lnga sogs longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras te padma 'dab brgyad kyi khar bzhag la ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /oṃ badzra a mṛ? bum chu'i bsang sbyangs/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing : pad 'byung rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas 'dir gshegs shing byin chen myur phob la: gzungs ma ye shes mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi lnga ldan dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas: ye shes ḍākki'i sprul pa bye ba 'bum: gnas 'dir gshegs shing byin chen myur phob la: gzungs ma ye shes ḍākkir byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel dbang gi rtsa rlung byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badzra a be sha ya ḍākki nī mu ṭa rā ga ya pha la dza dzaḥ yab yum dga' ba bzhis rjes su bskul te sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ badzra padma rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu bas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med par mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu gnyis lhan cig tu babs pa bhandha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ pra mo ti ri kunda li rakta a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi dang rakta lan gsum dkrugs:

de nas rdo rje slob dpon yab yum gyis dam tshig gi lam nas bdud rtsi phab pa de nyid sman raka la gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis gsang dbang zab mo stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: bdag cag zab lam mos pa'i bur: gsang ba'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis lan byin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: grol lam mchog gi pho nya 'di: dam ldan lam la bsngags pa'i mchog: khas longs khyod la sbyin par bya: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig gi rim pa las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: zab mo bde ba'i lam mchog la: snod ldan rnal 'byor cis mi dad: gtso bos bdag la gnang ba stsol: dam tshig mi 'da' sa ma ya: dam chu sbyin cing : bdud rtsi nang mchod byang sems dang sbyar ba ngag tu byin cing : hrīḥ che mchog dbyings kyi mkha' lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: thabs shes sbyor ba'i dam tshig rdzas: sbyin pas gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ a rakta a mṛ ta khā hi: de nas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du 'dres pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med pa nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rang byin rlabs kyis rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ byang sems kyi yi ge'i sprin ā li kā li'i rnam par 'char bas rtsa gnas thams cad gang ste rtsa'i 'ching byed kyi mdud pa grol/

gzung 'dzin brgyad cu'i rtogs pa 'gag /thig rlung sems gsum ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas bde ba'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la sngar slob dpon la phul ba'i gzungs ma de nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyis phyag g.yas kyis rig ma'i lag g.yon nas bzung ste bstod pa/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba nam mkha'i mdzod: lam bsgyur rdo rje sgeg pa mo: yid chags mdzes 'dzum gar rtsed can: gsang ba bde stong rig mar bstod: de nas slob ma rnams kyis grol lam pho nya'i gsang lam dam pa bstan du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye: rdo rje dpa' bo thabs bskul phyir: gsang ba dbyings nyid rig ma'i mchog: rdo rje gsang ba'i grol lam 'di: skal ldan bdag la gnang ba stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis bde chen gsang ba'i dam tshig la rtag tu gnas par nus na bstsal bar zhal gyis bzhes pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ 'di ni pho nya bde stong lam: zung 'jug ye shes lnga dang ldan: rtag tu mkha' 'gror mchod nus sam: de ltar khas longs dbang mchog bstsal: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig gi rim pa las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ shes rab bde chen grub pa 'd-i: thabs ldan bdag la gnang ba stsol: rtag tu mkha' 'gro bskul zhing mchod: dam bsrung badzra sa ma ya: de nas sku'i dbang bskur ba ni: gzungs ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros zhabs slob ma'i spyi bor bkod cing sku'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: gzugs sku snang stong bskyed rim lam: sprul pa'i 'gro don yid snang ngor: rdo rje thugs kyi yid dga' mos: dbang bskur rtsa khams lha ru bsgom: om̐ badzra padma rā ga akṣo bhya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas rgya rtags bstan te: hoḥ thabs shes gsang sngags gnyis med lam: rtag tu brda skad sgra bsgyur ram: de ltar khas longs dbang mchog sbyin: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: de nas slob dpon gyis ci ltar bsgos pa'i dam las 'da' bar mi bya'o snyam pas slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye: grol lam zung gi brda 'di la: gsang sngags rnal 'byor cis mi dad: bzlas sgrub skong bshags dam mi 'gal: bde ba'i dam tshig sa ma ya: zhes dam tshig khas len du gzhug /de nas rig mas phyag rgya slob ma'i gnas lngar bzhag par mos la rig tsaka gtad/ hūm̐: rdo rje padma rtags kyi rgya: dam tshig rdzas mchog rab bskul phyir: khyod kyi gnas lngar bzhag pa yis: rten 'brel 'khor los dbang bsgyur shog: rtsa sngags bzlas la: de nas rig mas: sindhu ra'i gnas lngar thig le gdab cing bdud rtsi blud/ hūm̐: thabs shes dam tshig rdo rje'i dbyings: dpa' bo ḍākki'i dkar dmar rgyun: skal ldan gnas lngar dbang mchog sbyin: byang sems gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ma la hi a hūm̐: ḍākki nī dza dzaḥ slob bu'i gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing dbang bskur: hoḥ gsang sngags pho nya myur lam gyis: bha ga kun bzang dkyil 'khor 'dir: khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam: de ltar khas longs dkyil 'khor bstan: zhes pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye: sku yi yon tan rabs rdzogs pa'i: bde chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mar: snod ldan rjes su 'jug phyir du: skal ldan yid spros rtag tu mchod: mna' chu sbyin: bha ga phye zhing ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bdag mo'i bha ga 'di: sngon tshe sangs rgyas byon pa'i shul: kun ldan skyon bral padma'i mkha': rang byung bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i gnas: rtsa rlung ye shes rtsal rdzogs shog: de nas slob bus rig ma'i padma'i ze'u 'bru'i bdud rtsi myang zhing :

bha ga la 'o bya: de nas slob dpon gyis rig ma'i phyag slob bu la gtad cing ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: ka dag rang byung rig pa mo: bcu drug yon tan mdzes ldan 'di: khyod kyis 'di rol tshul bzhin spyod: rang byung ye shes lhag ger 'char: bde ba ngos zungs dbyings la zhog: hoḥ mtshan ldan yid 'ong dge ba'i grogs: 'di bsten bde stong rgyud la skye: thig le dbab bzung 'dren par gyis: gnyis med ye shes ngo bor ltos: sa ma ya hoḥ rā ga ya hoḥ rdo rje padma mkha' gsang sbyar te: hūm̐: slob ma mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : che mchog drag po yab yum gsal: rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor spyod: dbab 'dren ldog pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: ho mu ṭa rā ga ya mi: zhes rol zhing bde ba bzhi ngos bzung : thig le rnams mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'bul: de ltar khyed rang yab yum gnyis ka lhar 'du shes pa dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padmar 'du shes pa dang*/ yid chos su 'du shes pa ste 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su mngon sum gyi dus su gzhon nu ma la bde ba'i ro myong ba ltar/ yas bab mas brtan gyis dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ste/ dbyer med kyi dus su rlung dbu mar tshud pas/ brjod bral lkugs pas rmi lam mthong ba ltar brjod bya kha las 'das te tshig gis mtshon du med par ro gcig gi dus su/ bde stong du 'dzin pa gzhi la thim pas khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung dang bral ba blo 'das zang thal la spyod par byos shig /

de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ zab lam gsang rgyud la zhugs nas: mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med smad pa 'dzin mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: bud med smad pa bshad mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bud med log lta bzung mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i yon tan dam tshig tu: bud med thabs kyis smad mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i phrin las dam tshig tu: bud med shes rab spang mi bya: dbyings phyug skong bshags tshogs gtor brtson: zung 'jug grol lam brtson pa dang : nam yang mkha' 'gro brten par bya: lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: zab lam bu yis mchog thob shog: rtsa sngags brjod cing : de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la shin tu spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog tshogs sbyangs te yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su pho nya bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i gseng lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde sdug byung tshor thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su dag nas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nge zhog cig /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas skye med rdo rje'i tshig gis rang byung don gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad de dbugs dbyung bar mos la/ de nas shel rdo thogs nas: hoḥ shel rdo 'di ni gnas lugs gshis kyi rig pa'i rtsal dang mtshungs pa: ngo bo gsal la rnam pa bkra ba: gzhi dwangs la gsal zhing ma 'gags pa: snang ba'i ngogs la shar yang sgrib pa med pas stong pa:

snang stong zung du 'jug pa 'di dang mtshungs pas khyod kyi rig pa smig sgyu'i drung du sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'gyu ba lta bu sa le hrig ge rjen ne ba: dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes pas gzhi'i gnas lugs: bar du gang du'ang mi gnas pas lam shar grol: tha mar gang du'ang mi 'gag pas 'bras bu'i grol tshul mthong ba bsgoms med a ti yo ga'i ngo sprod thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang mngon du bya ba'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ da ni mtha' rten du rdo rje rgyal tshab la mnga' gsol ba'i ched dkyil 'khor gtad pa dang*/ byin rlabs gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba/ dmigs bsal la dregs pa'i srog dbang bskur ba/ dge legs spel ba bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi dbang bcas bzhi yod pa las/ dang po slob ma rnams rdo rje rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol zhing pha nor bu la sprod pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs legs par rjes su gtad zin pas/ deng phyin chad 'chang ba dang klog pa dang 'dzin pa dang gzhan la rgya cher ston zhing*/ don gnyis lhun grub rgyun ma chad par gyis shig ces bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gzung thag nas bzung ste: hūm̐: phyi nang mu mtha' khyab pa yi: pho brang drag po'i zhing khams 'dir: rten 'brel 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phyir: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badzra dharma tsakra tiṣṭha a be sha ya a hūm̐: zhes gtad do: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi chas sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang 'di ni sgrub pa'i rten: rgyal mtshan 'di ni mdzes pa'i tog: gnam rgyan yol ba bkra ba'i rdzas: sa rgyan 'di ni dbang gi gzhi: phur pa ral gri srung ba'i gur:

me long mda' dar rten 'brel rdzas: drwa mig 'ja' ris longs sku'i zhing : drwa ba cod pan mdzes pa'i phyam: stag sham thod phreng drag po'i chas: sgo gzhi'i phyag mtshan srung ba'i rten: sman gtor rakta skong ba'i rdzas: phyi nang nyer spyod mnyes pa'i srid: bkra shis lha mo dge ba'i grogs: de ltar dkyil 'khor rten 'di dag: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: sgrub pa mthar phyin nus par gyis: oṃ badzra siddhi raṃ shuddhe hoḥ zhes sbyin no/ /de nas byin rlabs gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya ba ni: gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang rdor 'chang : longs sku rdo rje sems dpa': sprul sku che mchog zil gnon: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: mkhas pa shrī singha : rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: sngags 'chang shākya pra bha: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du che mchog kī la ya yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ༈ de nas dregs pa'i srog dbang bskur ba ni: dmar gtor che ba gcig la 'khor brgyad kyis bskor bar sha yis brgyan pa dang sde brgyad kyi tsakli btsug pa bsham: de nas sde brgyad spyan drangs te gtor mar bstim: zhes gsungs pas 'dir dbang drag kī la ya'i srung ma nyer bsdus dang sbyar ba ni/ rang nyid dpal chen 'bar ba yi/ /gzi byin 'bar ba'i stobs shugs kyis/ /sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams dang*/ /'byung lnga snod bcud mkha' klong nas/ /bka' dang gter srung rgya mtsho rnams/ /mchod sbyin slad du spyan drangs gyur/ /badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbyings las ma g.yos cho 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhing skyong dbang*/ /ma gza' rdor legs lha bdud btsan klu dang*/

/dge bsnyen sde bzhi lha srin sde brgyad sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /rngam brjid drag po'i mthun rdzas sprin ltar gtibs/ /drag mchod sha khrag gling bzhi'i khyon ltar bdal/ /mngon spyod las byed bshan pa rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /nyams dgra'i bla tshe srog dbugs bun ltar g.yo/ /sman raka gtor mchod dwangs ma'i zer ltar 'khrugs/ /'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams gsum srid pa'i sprin/ /thugs rjes rtsal las 'gog med shar ba'i dpyid/ /ye shes 'jig rten pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs/ /bdud 'dul dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams la 'bul/ /srid pa dregs sde'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang*/ /thogs med phrin las gnyan gyi g.yar dam stsol/ om̐ pā shaṃ de wi ha ri ni sa bhyo ra tri e du tsa na yaksha tsa tur sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ phrin las myur mgyogs tha tshig gnyer ba'i tshogs/ khyod la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /chos bzhin sgrub la bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dpal ye shes snyan grags gong du 'phel/ /lha 'dre mi gsum 'dod rgu dbang du sdus/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra zur dgra thal bar rlog khyad par zab gsang theg pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /nyi ltar gsal zhing mkha' ltar khyab cing brtan/ /snod bcud bde 'byor chos bzhin spyod pa sogs/ /bdud 'dul padma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las lhun 'grub mdzod/ de nas dam chu gtad la/ hoḥ las can skyes bu skal ldan khyod: de ring drag po lag tu bcug: dam can dregs pa khyod la gtad: slob dpon bdag gi bka' ltar bgyid: gal te 'gal zhing nyams gyur na: khyod kyi snying khrag dregs pas phyung : tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i skal ldan la:

khyod kyi grogs su bran bzhin 'gyur: 'khu ldog ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ a mṛ ta sa ma ya ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ oṃ sa ma ya dregs pa dun dun na ra kan: bdud rtsi gtor zhing rdo rjes bsdig: dam tshig rjes dran phrin las grub par bsam: de nas dregs pa'i srog gtad ni gsham gsal tshig ris dang bstun te slob ma la bka' gtad pa yin la/ 'di rnams dregs pa'i gtso bo yin zhing bka' gnyan la 'khu ldog che bas dregs pa 'chun nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang dam pa rnams ma gtogs gang thod thod du mi bskur/ shin tu khe nyen che bas gzab dgos so/ /de nas lha'i tsakli'i dbang bskur zhing srog yig gtad la/ hrīḥ lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa khyod: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ a sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de bzhin du gshin rje'i tsakli dang srog yig gtad la/ hūm̐: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ ya sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ma mo'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: ma mo'i dmag dpon rgyal mo ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ ma sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bdud kyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ du sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgyal po'i tsakli thogs la: hūm̐: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom:

oṃ ru sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas btsan gyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa che: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ tsa sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gnod sbyin gyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ sha sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas klu'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ nā sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dge bsnyen bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma ches: lha bdud klu btsan dge bsnyen khyod: bstsal ba'i gter kha ji bzhin du: zab chos 'di yi phyi la 'brongs: slob bu 'di yi rogs dan sgrubs: dam nyams rnams la chad pa chod: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mdzod: sngon tshe slob dpon tha tshig bzhin: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: dam la ma 'da' dam tshig srungs: bka' gtad gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ a ru tsa tri hṛ da ya sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes bskur/ myur mgyogs sde bzhi thogs la/ hūm̐: lha bdud btsan klu drag po'i tshogs: sngon tshe spa gro mchims phu sogs: dben gnas gter gyi srung ma rgyud: ci ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas bzhin: deng nas slob bu sngags 'chang 'dir: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: rig 'dzin bka' yi srung ma mdzod: chos 'di sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: log lta bdud rigs tshar gcod mdzod: oṃ a du tsa na badzra sa ma ya tsitta i dante na ra kan: de nas dmar gtor gnas lngar bzhag cing : hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal:

nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung che: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag rnams: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod: de bas ci ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: khyod kyis thogs med 'grub par mdzod: dam ldan rigs kyi slob bu 'dis: zhi rgyas las bzhi gang brtsam yang : khyod rnams 'khu 'am ma ldog cig: gal te bka' las 'da' srid na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin gyi dam yang bskul: dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom zhing bshig: na raka chen por ltung bar 'gyur: de bas dam tshig dran par mdzod: rtsal chen dregs pa'i sde tshogs kyi: srog gi dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ: aḥ yaḥ maḥ duḥ ruḥ tsaḥ shaḥ naḥ sa ma ya i dante badzra na ra kan hūm̐ hūm̐: dregs pa so so'i srog gtad mi bgyi na gong gsal dam tshig bsre ba nas 'dir 'jug pas chog /de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ ho/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang khyad par du nges don gyi snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las kyi nyin byed de nyid ji srid kyi bar du mi nub pa'i gnyer kha blangs shing*/ bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam pa'i chos skyong yongs kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan ma mgon lcam dral/ sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi/ gza' mchog khyab mjug rā hu la/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi/ bshan pa spu gri mched gsum/ lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/ gshin rje ya ma ra tsa/ ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo/ bdud po skra dkar nag po/ rgyal po chen po dpe dkar/ btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po/ gnod sbyin kā la yaksha/ klu bdud 'chi bdag nag po/ sprul pa yang sprul 'jig rten dregs pa'i sde dpon bka' sdod mngag gzhug pho nya dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro/ sprul sku mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad/

o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje nas rtsa ba'i bla ma sūrya rasmi'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar dam tshig gi rim par rjes su dgongs la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ mdzad phrin spel/ bstan pa rin po che rim 'gro dang bkur sti bcas te bla nas bla ru spel cig /sems can gyi phan bde spel/ 'jigs rten gyi rgud pa sol/ snod bcud kyi legs tshogs skyed/ gdug can gyi gnya' nas non/ dam can gyi sdong grogs gyis/ dam med kyi dbang po snubs/ thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba sgrubs shig khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid dam/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di khyed la gtad kyis lus dang grib ma bzhin srungs shig /ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phyi'i dgra nang gi bgegs/ gsang ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad las srungs shig /mdun nas bsus shig /rgyab nas skyor cig /'gal rkyen dang g.yol cig /mthun rkyen dang sprod cig /gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul ma nus na gang dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las drag pos tshar chod cig /sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs chom/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog bsam pa sgrubs re ba skongs/ tshe srings dpal skyed/ rgyags mthud/ phyi'i tshe bsod/ nang gi nyams rtogs/ gsang ba'i ye shes dang yon tan ma lus pa gong nas gong du spel nas/ dam pa'i phrin las blar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /mi mthun pa'i bar chad zhi/ snang ba dbang du bsdus/ phas rgol zil gyis non/ dgra gdon thal bar brlag pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor/

chos bzhin yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor cig /chos skyong mthu ma chung*/ dam can rtsal ma zhan/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde blag tu stsol cig /de nas dam tshig la spyir mchod gtor skong bshags ma chag par brtson pa byos shig /
