rgyun du chos skyong gi bskang gsol sogs la 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis rdzas rtags dang rgyal srid sna bdun gtad: khyed rang rnams kyis che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gis brgyan pa legs par grub ste rgyal bu rgyal sar mnga' gsol nas rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba bzhin dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob cing*/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por slob ma khyed rang rnams mnga' gsol ba'i ched du dge legs spel ba bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad dang*/ rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun bcas kyi dbang bskur ba la/ hūm̐: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor la: bsnyen bkur maṇḍal 'bul bar gyis: oṃ maṅga laṃ aṣṭa rā dza dhi swa bhā hoḥ zhes so sor gtad cing mnga' gsol/ de ltar nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs bzhin par me tog gi char dbab pa'i dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs dus kun tu yongs su khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis brjod/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig gi dbang bskur thob pa yin pas/ de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig la rag las pas/ dbang dus su thob pa'i spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung nas su/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /bdud dpung mthar byed drag po kīm̐ lam̐ yam̐'i/ /smim̐n byem̐d bdud 'dul drem̐gs pam̐'i srom̐g tim̐g 'di/ /gsaṃng sngaṃgs bstanaṃ pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*/ /bdud kyi ru dar bsnyil la 'dziṃn par 'os/ de dag ni nyer drug pa che mchog drag po kī la ya'i rdo rje'i phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig gi smin byed kyi dbang chog chu 'bab kyi lugs su bkod pa ste kī la ya'i dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ hor sog g.yul 'joms drag po kīm̐ lam̐ yam̐'i/ /las tshogs dug gi spar bu'i lde'u mig /dbam̐ng 'brim̐ng rdom̐ rjem̐ ram̐b tu 'bam̐r ba yi/ /ngo mtshar phrin las khrigs su bsdebs 'di rmad/ nyer bdun pa kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar khrigs su bsdeb pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ gzhung las/ sngon 'gro bkra shis byin chags sa phyogs su: dkyil 'khor maṇḍal mkho ba'i yo byad bsag: ces gsungs pa ltar stegs bu'i khar bum pa bhandha me long rdo rje phur bu 'jog /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la las byang 'bring po rdo rje thog rgod gzhung bsrang bstod pa dzap khang dbye zhing*/

bsnyen sgrub ci nus dang gtso las bum pa sgrub pa'i rjes sudabyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod grub pa dang bum lha 'od zhu bya/ de nas rang gzhung gsol kha rgyas bsdus dang tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas slob ma mdun du bos te khrus bstsal ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas bgegs bskrad pa dang mtshams gcod pa sogs spyi ltar grub nas lo rgyus 'chad pa ni/ 'khyogs mtshams la/ dus mtha'i rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: sa steng log chos mu stegs dmag gis khengs: chos la 'dre zhugs bande glang snying gi: dam log sprul pa kha dar sa steng khengs: 'dzam gling gsal ba'i gsang sngags sgron me 'di: dam sri chos gzugs bzhi yis bsnub par 'byung : res mos dga' sdug dar thag rlung g.yos ltar: gsal yang bstan pa'i 'phel sgrib dug rlangs 'phyur: stong sgra tig chom sa g.yos than ltas 'byung : che chung ma nges log chos blo gtad 'cha': chos spyod rgyal po sdig gi dmangs su 'bebs: sa snying kha tham dam chos mi 'dod 'byung : de dus mi rnams rang phung mtshon cha spyod: nad du rmu chu zha grum khong lhog dang : gdon du rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rgya 'dre ldang : sku gsung thugs rten mer bsreg chu la bskyur: dus ngan 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa 'byung : gnas khang rnams kyang zhig ral had por lus: mtha' mi mgo can bzhi yang dbus su 'thab: de dus 'o skol 'gro rnams snying re rje: zhes slob dpon gyis de skad gsungs pa'i mod la: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis spyan chab mang po shor te smre sngags kyis zhus pa: kye ma kyi hud rje btsun gu ru lags: sdug bsngal las ngan dus ngan de byung tshe: phan pa'i man ngag zab gnad ji ltar lags: thugs kyi ti ka yongs rdzogs stsol bar zhu: zhes zhus pas slob dpon gyis: nyon cig bu mo skal ldan mtsho rgyal ma:

gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog thabs bsrung thabs dang : bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel chos bzhin skyong sgrub bstan: drag sgrub gsang ba'i sgrub thabs 'di lta bu: phyi sgrub drag po dregs pa yongs rdzogs dang : gsang sgrub kī la me yi spu gri dang : nang sgrub hūm̐ gi skor dang rnam gsum bstan: gsang ba'i zab shog thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi 'phel 'grib shar ba'i dus: las can hūm̐ gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin dus bab kyi zab chos byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang skur zab mo sgrub par bgyi ba la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa gu ru rdo rje thod phreng rtsal bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs klong zab gsal nyag gcig tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed dman pa rnams theg chen byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang*/ spang blang gi chos thams cad blo bral stong gsal mnyam yangs chen por sdom zhing ye bsrungs chen por gzhol bar bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni:

skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung : de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod pa bzhin srung dgos te/ dpal mchog las/ sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi gnas/ de bsrungs dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces pas sdom gsum gyi spang blang mtshan ma thams cad rang grol ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bar chig chod du srung ba thabs kyi sgo zab pa'o/ /de ltar skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ rang nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo 'gro ba kun gyi dad dpon mchog tu gyur par bsams la/ dngos gzhi'i dbang gi slad du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma: che mchog dbang gi bdag: dregs 'joms khro bo he ru kaḥ yang gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ skal ldan bu khyod tshur nyon dang : dkyil 'khor sgom sgrub byed nus sam: de ltar yin na dbang mchog sbyin: rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: zhes mna' chu sbyin/ dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig

/de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs byasal/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: phung po khams dang skye mched kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig slob ma ni/ bla ma drag po 'jigs byed kī la ya: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsang bdag khros pa'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum sdang mig spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu rgyan rin chen snyan cha 'khrol: rta zhal mthing nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: g.yon pas bdud dmag sgrol 'debs phur bu bsgril: rdo rje spu gri'i sgro gshog bar snang khengs: seng glang zhing lpags khrag zhag thig les brgyan: rdo rje go khrab rus rgyan stag sham gsol: thod rlon sbrul chun dar nag cod pan 'phur: sku lus spyan stong de nang sangs rgyas stong : sku smad chu srin rngam zhal khro phur te: dam nyams byad ma'i snying khar brjid par bsgom: de yi pang du phag mo bdud 'dul ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis yab la 'khyud: gri gug thod khrag zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbu skra kham nag thod skam lnga yis brgyan: spyi gtsug phag zhal mu stegs dmag tshogs 'dul: rin chen rus rgyan dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: sku lus spyan stong mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: gar gyi nyams ldan gzi brjid me dpung 'bar: bde stong gnyis med yab la 'khril bar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings dang*/ gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas bla ma che mchog kī la ya drag po 'dus pa'i lha tshogs ma lus pas nam mkha' bar snang khengs te/ snang srid thams cad yom yom shig shig tu g.yo zhing dus mtha'i rlung dang 'bigs pa'i 'brug sgra/ gnam lcags kyi thog rgod tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bar rgya mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren pa ni: kyai: gling mchog rnga yab padma 'od: tsitta bam ro'i gnas mchog nas: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: bde chen gsang ba mtsho rgyal mar: gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs kyis: gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: dbang chen drag po'i dbang bskur la: dkyil 'khor dbyer med thim par mdzod: om̐ gu ru kī la ya a be sha ya a ā: ye shes pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐ hūm̐: dngos gzhi'i dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: kyai: skye med bla ma drag po rtsal: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i yang snying gi: smin grol dbang mchog bskur du gsol: de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ dngos gzhi la phyi phan par byed pa'i dbang dang*/ nang nus pa 'jug pa'i dbang*/ mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gis slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum dbang dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/

rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te/ 'khor lo lnga po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis zhing gang lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bla ma drag po'i sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs nas: hūm̐: drag po 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang : skye med snang stong dkyil 'khor lha: bdud 'dul kī la'i dbang bskur bas: 'gyur med sku yi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang : nyon mongs pa lnga'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag: ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur: bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur: gnyis pa gsung bzla ba sngags kyi lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dmar nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor du rang sgra bcas 'khor ba slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs: mgrin pa'i lam brgyud de thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar 'khod cing g.yas bskor du 'ur ldir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: 'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas gsang sngags mtha' dag la dbang brnyes pa'i mos pas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍākki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ

sngags phreng bgrang la sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum du byar gzhug /de nyid brtan pa'i slad du thod pa'i phreng ba thogs la/ hūm̐: rig stong grags stong hūm̐ gi sgra: thabs kyis skye med don rtogs phyir: drag po'i phrin las dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs dbang bskur thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bhandha thogs la/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor 'byung 'jug bdud rtsi'i dbang : gnyis med rol rtsal drag po'i sngags: zung 'jug rang bzhin dbang bskur bas: thabs shes rang bzhin dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar gsung phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /grags stong dbyer med kyi bzlas brjod la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa thugs me long gi dbang bskur ba la/ brda don rtags gsum mtshon pa'i thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pas gdul bya rjes su bzung pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long thogs la: hūm̐: chos sku skye med rig rtsal dbang : rang byung rang grol ngo bos stong : yang dag don dam dbang bskur bas: chos nyid bde chen dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dbang bskur bas yid tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /rig stong 'od gsal gyi t-ing 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa yon tan phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje 'di nyid gtad pa tsam gyis dug lnga'i zug rngu las grol te bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par mos mdzod/ rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: sku bzhi mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje rab 'bar khro bo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

zil gnon dbang sdud dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas/ rtog sgrib nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag /gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa phrin las khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang sbyin pa la thabs kyis gdul bar dka' ba'i log lta bdud kyi sde bcas shugs sgrol tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig / de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan spros pa'i sku: drag rtsal badzra kī la ya: sprul pa las mkhan dbang bskur ro: log lta tshar gcod dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur bas bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i nus rtsal mngon du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams la yi dam gyi lha'i phyag rgya rdzogs pa la rgyal byed dpa' rtags kyi mnga' gsol bas gdug pa can zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig / de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad 'khrul ba'i bdud bcom pa: ye shes cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i sku: dpa' chas brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro: dkyil 'khor brgyad dag dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ gtor snod rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang du gtor ma nyid bla ma drag po gtum chen kī la ya gtso bo'i chas yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba khyed rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas/ dgra gsum zhi/ bdud bzhi thul/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stan thog gcig tu thob par mos shig / gtor ma thogs la:

hūm̐: ngo mtshar 'dod yon rmad du byung : kun 'dus dngos grub mchod mchog 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs gsang 'dus dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍākki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ bcom ldan 'das chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ gnubs chen buddha dzñā na/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa/ grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje nas bla ma nyi ma 'od zer gyi bar byon pa'i/ drin can rtsa ba dang*/ brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gu ru drag po/ yum chen rdo rje phag mo/ zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lha dbang lus la bskur bas skye 'chi dang bral bar gyur cig /sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas bgres rgud dang bral bar gyur cig /chos dbang sems la bskur bas bying rmugs dang bral bar gyur cig /tshig dbang don gyi ngo sprad pas dgag sgrub dang bral bar gyur cig /chas dbang lus la brgyan pas he ru ka'i don dang ldan par gyur cig /de ltar dbang bzhi don lnga'i phrin las dang yon tan rdzogs par gyur cig: oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de rnams kyis dbang gi dngos gzhi rgyas par grub nas mjug gi bya ba'i thog mar/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis shis pa'i tshigs bcad dbyangs su len cing me tog gi char rgyun sil mar bsnyil bas dbang don gyi ye shes brtan cing gong 'phel du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mi 'gyur lhun po? deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar gyi dbang bskur thob pa yin pas/ de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin pas dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung nas su/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /gu ru drag khros bdud 'dul kīm̐ lam̐ yam̐'i/ /dbam̐ng bsgyur phyag mtshan gcig chom̐g rdom̐ rjem̐'i thog /ram̐b 'bam̐r mtshon chen gsaṃng sngaṃgs bla med kyis/ /bstanaṃ pa'i gnyer kha 'dziṃn la nyer mkhor byin/ de dag ni nyer bdun pa kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar khrigs su bsdebs pa'i le tshan no// // ༈ gdul dka'i 'gro 'dul dbam̐ng dram̐g 'bar ba'i gar/ /pam̐dmam̐ khros pa yam̐ng dag gsam̐ng ba che'i/ /snying po'i dbam̐ng chom̐g snyigs lnga'i mtshon gyi dbal/ /srung byed gnam̐m lcam̐gs gom̐ khram̐b sbyin gyis longs/ / nyer brgyad pa dbang drag padma yang gsang snying po'i dbang mchog gnam lcags go khrab la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid mthun gyi gnas su stegs bu rgya khyon ji ltar rigs pa la rdul tshon ras bris 'bru tshom sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i dbus su/

mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis gtams pa'i steng du bhandha mtshan ldan bzang po bdud rtsis bkang ba dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa/ steng me long dang man shel bzhag /sku tsaka rnams gnas so sor dgod/ 'og tu nya bo las phur btab pa 'jog /byang shar du las bum/ mdun du sgrub gtor dang sman raka /rgyab tu zor gtor ji ltar bab par chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi mchod gtor khor yug tu phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor tshogs chad brtan rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang mngon par 'du bya la/ las byang gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo'i gzhung bsrangs shing bstod pa'i mthar dzap khang dbye/ gzhung gi bsnyen sgrub ci nus mthar grub mtshams su rnam bum dang las bum sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ de nas rig pa'i me tog dor zhing gnang ba zhu/ de nas bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gi gsol kha rgyas par gtong*/ tshogs mchod byis rlabs skong bshags bsgral bstab yan grub par bgyis la dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib/ gnyis pa dbang la 'jug pa'i thog mar slob bu rnams la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chu: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: bkru bar bgyi 'o byang zhing dag gyur cig: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐: sarba pā paṃ da ha na shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ sarba bhu ta tri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes bgegs bkug cing bka' bsgo ba ni/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang*/ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya chos nyid don gyi bden pa dang*/ khyad par du dbang drag padma drag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la tshe rabs thog med nas byang chub kyi gegs byed cing*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub zab mo thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin kyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig hūm̐: bdag ni gtum chen khro rgyal thod phreng rtsal: 'byung po tshogs rnams bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor mas tshims shing byang chub lam la dengs: 'tshe ba'i gdon dang ma rungs tshar chod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐: log lta 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: 'byung ba lnga nyid ye shes gzhal yas khang : mi dmigs srung 'khor ye nas rdo rje'i gur: stong nyid me dpung skye med mtshon cha yis: nyon mongs bgrod 'gyu med par mtshams chod cig: oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan te nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de'ang thun mong gi theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par rtsol sgrub kyis yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg par zhugs par bya'o/ /de'ang smin byed kyi dbang zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/

lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la'ang gang 'dul sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa sogs byon par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gu ru'i thugs sras snying gi bu dgu'i nang tshan/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar/ sprul pa'i gter chen rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba de nyid kyis/ gter gnas so dgu nas zab gter don lnga bzhes pa'i nang tshan spu bo 'dong chu byams pa'i lha khang zhes/ mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi rten gtso byams pa'i snyan khungs nas gdan drangs pa'i zab gter/ dbang drag padma yang gsang snying po zhes bya ba yin te/ de'i lo rgyus mdo tsam bshad na/ rgyud gnam lcags me ri dmar po las/ ma hā gu ru nyid ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mor: mi g.yo rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre drag po rnams kyis tho 'tsham: khyad par btsan yam shud dmar po dang : bdud mo gser mig ma: gnyan gu lang ral gri can: dam sri ya ma spun bdun gyis bar chad brtsams pa'i tshe: mdun gyi nam mkha' nas rdo rje drag mo khro gnyer can gyis lung bstan pa: kyaiḥ snying stobs ldan pa'i dpa' bo brtul zhugs 'chang : chos dang bar chad zung 'brel rkyen dbang che: bdud rigs kha 'byams sangs rgyas bstan la 'tshe: gsang sngags bstan dang phyi rabs skal ldan don: bdud bzhi tshar gcod drag po'i skur bzhengs 'tshal: ting 'dzin mtshon chas mi g.yo rtsal phyungs shig: ces lung bstan la/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma'ang gsang ba'i rig mar gyur te: de'i shugs las ting nge 'dzin gsal ba gsum gyis rgyud bskul bas: dbyings rang byung dur khrod rngam sgra rol pa nas: che mchog rdo rje drag rtsal: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa:

de la rang 'dra ba'i khro bo bzhi: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro yang sprul: khro tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas 'ja' lhags pa ltar gsal lo: de'i tshe pad 'byung yab yum yang : drag po dang dbyer med du gyur te: sku las me ri stong gsum khengs par 'bar: gnam lcags can gyi rtser byon nas drag po'i rngam sgra bsgrags: drag sngags rdo rje'i mtshon char phab pas: 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams dbang du bsdus shing tshar bcad: thams cad kyis srog snying phul: 'byung po ma rungs pa phal cher gnam lcags me ri'i 'khor los gtubs shing dran med du 'gyel: de'i tshe drag po gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo can du grags so: de nas drag po dbyings la thim zhing gu ru rin po che nyid dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams sngar ltar gyur: de'i tshe gsang ba rdo rje drag mo khro gnyer can gyis gu ru'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa dang 'brel ba'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnams brda'i yi ger btab nas/ rin po che'i sgrom du bzhag ste ma la ya'i rtse mor sbas/ gter srung khyab 'jug ljang sngon la bcol lo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ de nas bod yul mchims phu'i dben gnas su bzhugs pa'i tshe: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gu ru rin po che la gser g.yu'i maṇḍal phul zhing : ma 'ongs pa'i don du zhus pa: e maḥ rgyal sras rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas lags: ma 'ongs bod 'dir bde skyid ci ltar 'byung : gsang sngags bstan pa gang gi phyogs su rgyas: rjes 'jug gter ston rig 'dzin ci ltar 'byon: zhes zhus so: de'i lan du gu rus gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'byung tshul sprul pa'i gter ston ji ltar 'byon tshul sogs mang du bka' bstsal zhing*/ khyad par chos dang gdams pa gang gces zhus lan du/ e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: da lta phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyid la: sems can rgyud ngan dmus long bod 'bangs kyis: rten 'brel kha bsags ngan pa'i dus ngan smra:

de phyir kha smon log pa'i las stobs kyis: bod yul 'jig rten bde ba gnas skabs tsam: ma 'ongs tha ma bod yul mi min chags: bde ba zad la sdug bsngal mtsho ltar 'khyil: dam sri nag po mun pa'i zug rngu can: mtshon gyi bu yug 'gyed cing dbus gtsang 'joms: gtsug lag chos 'khor phal cher sprul pas sdud: bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyang sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal sde dpon rnams ni gri ru 'chi: mi sde dmangs chung rnams kyang rim gyis zad: lo nyes nad yams dar zhing mi thog 'bud: dam sri nag pos stod smad ru bzhi dkrug: de dus bod kyi bde skyid zad pa stai: blun rmongs bod 'di bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: de dus rang dbang can rnams rong bzhi dang : sbas gnas rnams su phyin na blo re bde: de dus kho bo nga yi sprul pa ni: bstan pa gso ba'i gter ston mang rab 'byon: gsang sngags bstan pa rong bzhi sbas yul tsam: mdo yang rim sdud dgong ka'i nyi zer 'dra: de dus zab chos bka' brgyad yang gsang dang : nga nyid drag por sgrub pa'i gdams pa ni: gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo'i yang snying zab: kho mo mtsho rgyal yid la de ltar bcag: ces sogs snyigs ma'i dus su 'di nyid shin tu zab cing dus bab dang gdul bya'i skabs dang mtshams pa sogs khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa ste/ de nyid las/ de phyir rten 'brel gnad 'di shin tu zab: sbas yul mi rnams drag po 'di nyid zab: sa 'dzin srog gi phur pa lta bu'o: yang gsang bzlog bsgyur dmod pa mang du bya: sa rten g.yo zhing rten mkhar brtsigs par gyis: smon lam kho bo'i brda ltar yid la bcag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs pa bzhin bla ma drag po dbang drag padma yang gsang snying po zhes byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing*/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi/

smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur zab mo bsgrub par bgyi ba la/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ dbang drag padma rigs kyi bdag: che mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag yang dag 'jug par stsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyi bka' yis gnang ba bstsal bas lan gsan par khyab pa gda'/ kyaiḥ khyed rnams las sad skal bar ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dkon: deng nas bdag cag gsang sngags kyi: snod ldan lags na dbang bskur 'tshal: de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul rgya mtshos bskor te sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i drung du byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ kun gzhi ma bcos dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid: gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal snying po can: thog ma'i mgon po dran rig chos sku la: 'khor 'das bral ba bzo med ngang du skyabs: de nas mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du smon 'jug bla na med pa'i sems mchog dam pa bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rang byung lhun grub ka dag ngang nyid las: rol pa'i rtsal rdzogs snying rje'i 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das ma gyur byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir: klong yangs ye nas snying rjer sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud dbang gi snod rung du bya ba'i phyir du phyag 'tshal ba sogs bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'i skabs don so so'i tshig don yid la bya bzhin par 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hūm̐: bla ma thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dpal ri rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no: chags bral padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: chos dbyings ro gcig ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis med 'khrul snang rang grol mchod pa 'bul: re dogs sdug bsngal skye med klong du bshags: gdod ma'i chos sku'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: 'od gsal chos kyi sku la rjes yi rang : 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin bral bar chos 'khor bskor: dmigs med khyab brdal dge ba yongs su bsngo: kun kyang kun bzang klong du grol bar shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

de nas dam chu thogs nas: hūm̐: 'di ni drag po'i dam tshig chu: dam bsrungs skal ldan dngos grub thob: nyams na pho nya lcags sdig gis: dbang po bsnubs pas dam tshig srungs: rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su: pad nyi bam gyi gdan la che mchog rdo rje drag po rtsal sku mdog smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum gyis gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje dang ral gri g.yon gsum gyis me'i 'khor lo sdig pa dang phur bu bsnams pa: dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing : yum mchog rdo rje bskul byed mas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud de: me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: spyi bor bya khyung nag po: phyogs bzhir drag po rigs bzhi: sgo ma dang bcas gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: thod phreng yang gsang 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kha ba dang bu yug 'thibs pa ltar byon te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ badzra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri padma 'od: laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul gling nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal dbang drag lha tshogs rnams:

deng 'dir drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ: dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai: dpal chen gsang ba gsum gyi bdag: che mchog gu ru drag po yi: dbang bskur dngos grub stsal du gsol: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang la bla med rgyud sder bum gsang sher ye tshig gi dbang bzhir grags che la/ bye brag yo ga gsum so so'i rang skad dang mthun pa phan nus zab mo'i dbang gsum/ chu bo bzhi rdzogs kyi dbang bzhi/ spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med/ re re la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba du mar 'byung ba las/ 'di ni sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po las/ dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtogs na/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang*/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi yi dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal pa ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/

rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs/ rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dang po bum pa thogs te ngo sprad do: hūm̐: bum pa skye med chos kyi dbyings: bum chu drag po'i lha tshogs nyid: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: drag po'i sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed la/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ 'og min gyi zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje thod phreng rtsal thogs nas: hūm̐: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bla med rig 'dzin dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra padma thod phreng rtsal ḍākki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar khyed rang rnams la rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang bskur bas/ gnyis snang gi chos thams cad gnyis med ye shes kyi rgyas thebs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig

/ dbu rgyan bya khyung thogs la: hūm̐ khroṃḥ mthing nag bya khyung ga ru ḍas/ krang kring sgra sgrogs klu gnyan 'joms: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bgegs srin tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa kā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams padma thod phreng du gsal bas dbu gtsug tu ye shes kyi bya khyung krang kring 'jigs pa'i sgra 'od zer me tshwa dang bcas byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan pas/ sgong chag khyung bzhin 'khor ba la ji mi snyam pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rje thod phreng drag po rtsal thogs nas: de nas khyed rang rnams la gu ru thod phreng sde lnga yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga ma spangs rang sar dag pas ye shes lnga mngon du gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: sku mchog rdo rje drag po rtsal: yab yum sku yi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: zhe sdang rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: padma drag po thogs la: hūm̐: gsung mchog padma drag po rtsal: yab yum gsung gi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: 'dod chags rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ padma tsaṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: srog yig thogs la: hūm̐: che mchog buddha drag po rtsal: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: gti mug rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ buddha tsaṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ratna drag po thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan ratna drag po rtsal: yab yum yon tan lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: nga rgyal rnam dag dbang thob shog: oṃ ratna tsaṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: karma drag po thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las karma drag po rtsal: yab yum phrin las lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: phrag dog rnam dag dbang thob shog:

oṃ karma tsaṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma bzhi thogs la: yang khyed rang rnams la tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo sgo skyong rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur bas/ mtha' bzhi'i lta ba gnas su dag /phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor bar mos shig /hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen padma dang : las kyi rigs sogs sgo ma bzhis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: tshad med bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ su kha tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar che mchog padma drag po'i sku gang la gang 'dul gyis/ de dang de'i rnam rol 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob pa yin no/ /de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog he ru ka drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas khams gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyi dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol bas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur te dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpa' stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu cod pan rin chen brgyan: seng glang zhing lpags khrag zhag tshom: thod phreng stag sham rus rgyan sbrul: rnam thar brgyad ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ bo dhi aṣṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la/

hūm̐ dmar nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor bas 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas/ rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags phreng gtad la: hūm̐: rang byung grags stong snying po'i sgra: bzlas brjod bsnyen sgrub brtson par gyis: shes rab phreng ba'i dbang bskur bas: gsung rab yan lag dbang thob shog: oṃ aṣṭa ma lye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes ru raksha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: oṃ padma he ru ka tsaṇḍa ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro dhi ra tri ta tsarya hūm̐ bhyoḥ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du bhandha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhandha ma 'gag gsang ba'i snod: bdud rtsi'i ngo bo drag po'i gsung : skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: drag po'i gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon padma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od mdangs nyi ma stong gi zer ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar phog pas ma rig gnyis 'dzin gyi mun pa sangs te/ rig pa'i ye shes lhang gis rtogs te rang lus 'od phung du yal/

ka dag gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas cung zad mnyam par bzhag mdzod/ me long snying khar gtad la: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung ngo bo nyid: me long drag po'i thugs kyi ngang : skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar gtad: yang dag ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi/ don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong bar thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: gtor ma lte bar gtad de: hūm̐: bha liṃ drag po'i dngos grub mchog: yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i phyir: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar gtad: lhun grub brda yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la/ mngon spyod rtsom pa po rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog gu ru drag po gtum drag shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i skur lam gyis gsal zhing lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs/

sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/ spyod pa snying rje'i srog dang ldan pas mngon spyod kyi las rtsom par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgral dbang dngos la'ang srung ba/ bsad pa/ bzlog 'phang sreg mnan bcas las/ dang po srung ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /hūm̐: skad cig gis bdag nyid drag por gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng dmar po me'i rang bzhin du 'khor zhing : lus kyi nang thams cad gang : ba spu dang bu ga thams cad bya khyung nag pos gang : bsrung bya thams cad pho g.yas mo g.yon: mdun du nor rdzas rgyab tu zhing khang thams cad tshud de bskal pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar gyur: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba ro ṣa na kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig raksha rakṣa: de nas srung 'khor gtad la/ hūm̐: phyi nang mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: bdag gzhan srung ba'i cho ga nyid: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gnyis pa bsad pa'i dngos gzhir mdun du hom khung liṅga las phur dbye sgro bsgral chas rnams 'du bya la/ de nas slob dpon drag po'i chas su zhugs shing dar nag dang bcas phyag tu 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems thogs la/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ nya bo mdun du bkod la/ de nas gdab las bya ba la phrin las rtsom pa'i yul nyams pa bdun ldan gyi dgra bgegs la/ ji ltar brtsam pa'i phrin las kyi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsal 'debs gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum phyag rgya sngags dang ni: dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bstan dgra sgos dgra gdug cing sdang ba rnams: gru gsum snod kyi liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ phur bu thogs shing bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog khro rgyal dbang drag padma yi: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la yas: g.yas g.yon phyag bar 'debs pa'i phur bu bsgril: thob cig ru tra'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya 'byung po byad ma trig thum shag rbad bhyoḥ tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal bar/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyang*/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/

nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus dwangs ma tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtser ling gis btegs nas dpal chen po'i thugs kar stim/ phur bu'i dbal zur nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par gyur/ / ces bsgral ba'i stangs stabs dang bcas bsgral tu gzhug cing*/ de nas rdo rje phur pa gtad de/ hūm̐: phrin las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rdzas: rdo rje phur pa thabs shes te: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtub cing zhal du 'bul ba ni: de nas khyed rang rnams dpal chen por gsal ba la nyon mongs dug gsum gyi ru tra bsgral ba'i sha khrag zhal du phul bas/ bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum rtsad nas bcom zhing mtshan ma'i bdud tshogs kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dbang drag 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shig: gnam sa'i zhal phyes gangs ri'i mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar ljags rkyongs dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid bde stong lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: bsgral rdzas ras ma sbyin/ gsum pa pha rol g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i don du 'phang ba dang*/ sreg pa/ mnan pa bcas stabs gcig tu bya ba ni/ 'gugs pa snga ma ltar 'ben la dmigs bya 'gugs nas gtor zor lag tu gtad cing mthar bzlog pa dang sbrags te 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus he ru kas: stong gsum dmigs pa'i zor chen bsgril: gdug pa'i dug rdzas sna dgus brgyan: dregs pa gshin rje'i dmod pa bor: ldog med las kyi dbal zor 'dis: bzlog go chag che nyam nga zlog: bsgyur ro rkyen ngan dgra la sgyur: rbad do pho nya las la bskul:

'phen no dgra bo'i srog la ya: hūm̐ kro ta ya: nye lo ya: te lo ya: shag dza ya: rbad bhyo ya: ru tra ya: tra tra ya: rbad lo ya: thun thun ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces gtor zor slob ma'i lag tu bzhag /mthar me hom du 'phang la bsregs shing gtor gzhong sbub nas mnan par bya ba ni/ hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: che btsan khro bo'i bro brdungs pas: dgra dang dam sri thal bar rlog: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ ru tra ma tha ma tha nan: tshindha tshindha nan: ru tra nan: 'byung po rbad thum nan: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan: gtor snod kha yar bzed la bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku dri med rol rtsal drag po'i lhas: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: ces gtor gzhong la me tog 'thor ro/ /de nas bzlog bsad mnan sreg gi 'khor lo lag tu gtad la: hūm̐: drag po las kyi mtha' sdud pa: bzlog rbad 'gugs bsgral bsad dang mnan: 'phang ba'i zor bcas khyod la gtad: drag po'i las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ badzra du tri ya zlog: bhyo ma ra ram̐ dzwa la a mu ka nan: du khying rbad do shag lo zor zor: de nas me long dang sku 'bag thogs la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mi bzad 'bar ba'igazi brjid can: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru tsaṇḍa badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gnas lngar bzhag cing : hūm̐: snang stong grags stong bde stong ngang : rang byung skye med rtsal mdangs kyis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin dbang thob shog: oṃ swa bhā dharma nirmā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas/ khrag 'thung he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /phyi'i snod bcud thams cad snang stong dag pa rab 'byams su spyod pa la dbang*/ 'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /gnyis pa gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur la bhandha 'di nyid tha mal pa ma yin zhing zla gam bde chen dbang gi pho brang du mos pa'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas bde chen gyi sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs khro bo rab 'byams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu gnyis lhan cig tu babs pa bhandha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med pa nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/

hūm̐: spros bral rang byung bhandha ru: dam tshig bla med rdzas kyis bkang : khrag 'thung yab yum ngo bo nyid: dbang bskur longs sku'i rtsal ldan shog: om̐ padma he ru ka kro ti muṃ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa muṃ: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rang byin gyis brlabs pas rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ las rlung dbang du sdud pas las thams cad grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa gcer bu bde nyams khyug ge ba zhig byung*/ khyed rang rnams la gtad pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren bzung : dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar khyed rang rnams 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pas yas bab mas brtan gyis dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ bde stong du 'dzin pa'ang gzhi la thim pas khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung dang bral bar blo 'das zang thal gcig tu spyod par mos mdzod/ ces ngo sprad/ de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la shin tu spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ thig le bde chen bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbyings mi shigs pa mchog gi las thams cad grub/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med par chos sku bde ba chen por thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nge zhog cig /de ltar bzhag pas sems zhes bya ba de gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po'i mtshan ma can du ma grub pas stong pa/ de'i mdangs ma 'gags par rang bzhin gsal la/ thugs rje kun khyab ste/ chos longs sprul gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum sogs mtshan don ji ltar sbyar yang gzhan nas btsal du med par gdod ma nas lhun grub tu gnas pa la/ deng phyin chad 'dzin med ngo bo rang gsal gyi ye shes chen po la spyod pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzod/ / ces man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dzñā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ chos nyid khyab brdal chen po bsgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ nyams rtogs dang yon tan sogs rgyas pa'i las grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /de dag gi sgo nas dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

de nas dbang bzhi'i dam tshig gi gnad rnams la nye bar gnas nas lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid yi dam du bzung ba dang bsnyen sgrub sogs ci nus su 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ches: dam pa'i bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung : de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas mtshon rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /dbam̐ng dram̐g pam̐dmam̐ yam̐ng gsam̐ng ltar sgrub pa'i/ /snying po'i dbam̐ng chog gsaṃng ba spyi mthun bzhin/ /sbyar 'di mdo sngaṃgs rgyal bstaṃn 'dziṃn mchog rnams/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur 'gyur smon/ de dag ni nyer brgyad pa dbang drag padma yang gsang snying po'i dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam zhi drag gi skor la/ nyer dgu pa yi dam zhi ba thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang chen dngos sta sbrags ma grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa bzhin mthar chags su bskur bas grub bo/

/thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang chen gyi le tshan no// // ༈ rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khom̐r 'dam̐s zim̐l gnom̐n gyi/ /smin grol sgo 'byed dbam̐ng chog 'brim̐ng po'i srol/ /don gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i btsas su spel/ sum cu pa thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang chog 'bring po'i lugs su dgod pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ mdun stegs khebs ldan gyi steng du dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su rnam bum rgyan can bhandha me long gtor ma/ rdo rje rgya gram/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ longs sku rigs bzhi/ yum bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi/ phyag mtshan sna tshogs/ zhi rgyan/ rigs lnga'i tshom bu dang shel rdo/ bdag bskyed gtor ma sman raka gtor gsum/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos srung gtor ma/ sngon gtor rnams 'du bya la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ru chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum/ ḍā dril/ nas yungs/ nang mchod sogs nyer mkho tshang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sku gsum gsol 'debs rnam thar gsol 'debs/ gsol 'debs 'bral med ma rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed las byang rgyas pa'am bsdus pa longs sku ltar sgrub pa gang rung skyabs sems nas bstod pa'i bar dkyus ltar btang la/ dzap khang dbye zhing dzap bskul nas bsnyen sgrub ci nus rjes su bum pa gnyis spyi chings ltar sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ rig me dor ba gnang zhus chos skyong gtor 'bul dang skong bshags tshogs 'khor drangs pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams sgo drung du bos pa la las bum gyi chus/

hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chu: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum? sogs khrus bya zhing bgegs la gtor ma bsngo ba mtshams gcod pa sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /de nas lo rgyus brjod pa ni/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhus te lam rim gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang bcas gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang mthun pa'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa mchog dman gnyis su 'du la/ de las 'di ni theg chen gyi khongs su gtogs shing*/ de la'ang rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis las/ 'di 'bras bu lam byed gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yin/ de la'ang gsar rnying gnyis las 'di ni gsar ma las khyad chos drug ldan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ rnying ma de la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma dang nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi chos sde gsum yod pa las/ zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing*/ gter ma la'ang gter chen brgya rtsa sogs mang du byon pa'i nang tshan/ gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba de nyid kyis/ ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/

thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po yan lag dang bcas pa rgya che bar bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol/ zhes bya ba la rgyas 'bring gnyis kyi phyi ma yin no/ /de la bsgrub bya lha'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon bskal pa kun bkod ces bya ba'i dus su: 'og min snang mtha'i zhing khams gyi pho brang dbyings bkod pa blo las 'das pa'i dbus su: yon tan thams cad rab tu rdzogs pa'i khri'i steng du ston pa thog ma'i mgon po rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs so: yang de'i tshe gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar mas thog ma'i mgon po la dgongs brgyud kyi tshul du theg pa mtha' dag zhus te mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger bsgyur nas dbyings la sbas: yang de'i tshe klong dgu rgyud kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa dbyings dga' rab rdo rjes brda bzhi'i tshul du rgyud rnams gdan drangs te: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas la snyan brgyud mu tig rtsal phreng longs sku thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gi tshul du lung gnang*/ gu ru rin po ches gsang ba'i dbang phyug mtsho rgyal dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes lha lcam rdo rje dhe ba dha ra rnams la tshig brgyud brda'i shog ser la btab ste bka' yi rgya gtad/ ma 'ongs smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te rten 'brel sbas yul rgya rtags bka' yi gnyer gtad dang bcas ma 'ongs pa'i don du zab mos gter du sbas so/ /de la spyan ras gzigs bya ba ni/ sngon bskal pa 'bum phrag tshad med pa'i nang de bzhin gshegs pa 'od stong gi rgyal po zhi bar gnas pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ sangs rgyas des spyan ras gzigs bdag la phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs gsungs nas/ phyag gser gyi mdog can spyi bor byugs te lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba'i tshe/ spyan ras gzigs kyis ma 'ongs par mig stong lag stong yod pas 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i smon lam btab bo:

de'ang sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtsho gling du me tog u dum wa rar brdzus te sku 'khrungs shing*/ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te 'jig rten na sems can gcig kyang med par mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod do/ de nas shar phyogs ri bo tā lar byon te slar gzigs pa na/ sems can ni sngar bas mang ba byung bas snying rje bzod blag med pa skyes shing*/ da ni sems can 'di dag thul ba'i dus shig e yong dgongs te/ thugs zhum pas dam bca' nyams te dbu lus tshal pa stong du gas so/ /de'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis dbu lus rnams bsgrigs te/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong du byin gyis brlabs te/ a mi dhe was rigs bdag mdzad nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro don gyis shig gsungs nas dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /de nas phyag stong gis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong du sprul/ spyan stong gis bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong du sprul te 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ khyad par du bod kha ba can gyi lha skal ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ chos skal ni gsung yi ge drug ma yin te/ thog mar gangs ljongs su 'phags pa'i thugs rje las byung ba'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sgrol ma khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa'i brag srin mo gnyis kyi mi'i 'gro ba spel/ zas skal du 'bru sna lnga bskur zhing gser phye khyor gang bod yul gyi phyogs su gtor nas thugs rje'i rjes su bzung ngo*/ /ji zhig na/ yul yar lung du sangs rgyas 'od srung gi sprul pa rgyal po tho ri snyan shal byon te rje de'i sku mkhar yum bu bla sgang gi steng du/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo za ma tog gi yang snying*/ gsung yi ge drug ma bod kha ba can gyi chos skal du nam mkha' nas babs te bod du dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/

'di nas mi rabs lnga nas don shes par 'ong zhes rmi lam du lung bstan pa bzhin du rgyal rabs lnga pa'i dus su/ spyan ras gzigs dngos chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po zhes/ spyi gtsug tu 'od dpag med bzhugs pa de'i sku dus su/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi pho brang dmar po ri'i thog drangs gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ sgrol dkar sngon gyi rnam 'phrul rgya bza' dang bal bza' gnyis khab tu bzhes/ jo shāka rin po che rnam gnyis gdan drangs lo tsā thu mi sambho ṭa rgya gar du byon chos thams cad bod du bsgyur/ chos dge bcu'i khrims bcas/ de'i dus su chos rgyal chen po'i thugs dam yi ge drug ma la brtson par mdzad de/ gangs can 'phags pa'i gdul byar gyur/ khyad par thub pa'i dbang pos lung las bstan pa bzhin sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod yul du phebs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bod kha ba can gyi lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na padmo dang snying po yi ge drug ma 'di yin zhes zhal gdams su bstsal ba ma zad/ sprul pa'i gter ston brgya dang rtsa brgyad phal che bar bla rdzogs thugs gsum zhes/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig zab gter gnas so sor sbas par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gnas chen padma bkod kyi nye ba'i char brag gad padma shel phug gi mtsho nang nas ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul du ma dang bcas/ lcags glang lor sprel zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyi shar dus khrom sum brgya skor dang bcas te/ kun gyis mthong bar gza' klu btsan gyis/ shog ser dngos su phul ba'i thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon zhes/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs bun ne ba de nyid kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa la/ bdag nyid kyis sgrub 'os rnams legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/

thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas slob ma rnams la dam tshig gi rim pa rnams bzung bar nus sam zhes 'dri ba 'di la gsan 'tshal/ hoḥ bla med yang gsang snying po mchog: ye shes sprul pa'i pho brang 'dir: skal ldan 'jug cing smin rlom na: dam tshig snying po 'bul bar gyis: zhes dris pa'i lan du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ rdo rje rgyal po rigs kyi bdag: theg chen gsang sngags mdzod kyi mchog: deng 'dir 'phags mchog dkyil 'khor du: dam bsrung skal ldan 'jug par stsol: khe nyen gnyis kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ dam chu sbyin la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: bsrungs na dngos grub sna tshogs rnyed: ma bsrung ngan song dmyal bar skye: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ smon 'jug byang chub tu sems bskyed cing rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa/ spang blang gi chos thams cad blo bral stong gsal mnyam yangs chen por sdom zhing*/ ye bsrungs chen por gzhol bar bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi:

sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod pa bzhin srung dgos te/ dpal mchog las/ sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi gnas/ de bsrungs dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces pas sdom gsum gyi spang blang mtshan ma thams cad/ rang grol ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bar chig chod du srung ba thabs kyi sgo zab pa'o/ /de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang gi gzhi 'god pa la/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / slob ma rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bsang*/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang slob ma rnams pam̐ las padma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: hrī las thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku mdog dkar gsal 'od du 'bar ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi zer las shel phreng dang pad dkar yu ba 'khril ba: longs sku'i cha byad can mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa: sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing : zhabs phyed pa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa: yum dbyangs can ma dmar mo dung dmar can gyis mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: de'i spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag thog ma'i mgon po sku mdog dmar gsal padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan mnyam bzhag skyil krung gis bzhugs pa: phyogs bzhir thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas:

shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon la: sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba sku che ba ri rab tsam chung ba nas 'bru tsam/ yang sprul rdul phran tsam/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos shig om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ārya lo ki shwa ri badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥphaiṃ phaiṃ: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: 'khor 'das zil gnon gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ rdo rje mgor bzhag la: hoḥ ye shes pa brtan par gyur cig: tiṣṭha badzra: rdo rje rgya gram bya/ de nas sku bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i sku'i dbang bskur ba yin te: bum pa 'di nyid phyi ltar na ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang : nang ltar na bum chu yi dam lha'i ngo bo yin te: slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te: spyi bo'i gtsug nas sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: bum pa longs sku'i gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des sku'i dbang thob cing lus kyi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas gsung bhandha thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi dbang bskur ba yin pas: bhandha 'di nyid phyi ltar na rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin: nang ltar na a haṃ byang sems dkar dmar yi dam lha'i ngo bo yin te:

slob ma rnams kyi mgrin par dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te mgrin par sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: bhandha ye shes 'khor lo lnga: byang sems 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sngags dbang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des gsung gi dbang thob cing ngag gi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad nas sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas thugs kyi dbang me long ngam dkyil 'khor gang rung thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi dbang bskur ba yin pas: dkyil 'khor 'di phyi ltar na chos dbyings thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor: nang ltar na yi dam lha'i thugs kyi ngo bo yin te: slob ma rnams kyi snying khar bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas: snying khar sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor ka dag chos kyi dbyings: ngo bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos dbyings dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: deng phyin chad yid ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so:

gtor ma thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba yin pas: gtor ma 'di nyid phyi ltar na rmad byung dngos grub 'byung ba'i dam rdzas: nang ltar na ro bcud yi dam lha'i ngo bo yin te: slob ma rnams kyi lte bar dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas lte bar sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: gtor ma rmad byung bla med rdzas: dngos grub bcud mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug las tshogs dbang thob shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra ghu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des yon tan gyi dbang thob: sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad dbang bskur dang 'chad rtsod sgom sgrub las su rung ste dbang : 'bras bu mchog thun dbyer med 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: rdo rje rgya gram thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i phrin las yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ba yin pas: sku dang rdo rje rgya gram 'di: phyi ltar na yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lam du lhong : nang ltar na ting 'dzin mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu'i rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur ba'i brda yin te: slob ma rnams kyi gsang bar dbang bskur bas thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te gsang gnas su sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: rdo rje'i sku mchog longs spyod rdzogs: spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum sku: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ri gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des phrin las kyi dbang thob cing bdag 'dzin phra rags kyi bag chags dag: deng phyin chad las mtha' sna tshogs kyi bya ba la dbang : 'bras bu yongs rdzogs 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so:

sku gzugs de nyid rang snang 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas rang rig bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi lha tshogs/ gang 'dul der ston thugs rje'i rol pa sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba las/ ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa zhig byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas lha dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rigs bdag thogs la: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog ldan: ye shes drwa ba'i bdag nyid mchog: rigs kyi bdag po thog ma'i mgon: bla med theg chen dbang thob shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: longs sku rigs bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: rang bzhin lhun grub ngo bo nyid: ye shes bzhi sbyor 'od stong 'phro: ma rig bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: 'phags mchog rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ ārya bhi dho tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yum bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: 'byung bzhi rnam dag ngo bo nyid: rnam thar ting 'dzin shes rab gzugs: bla med theg chen pho nya'i mchog: gsang ye rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu hya dzñā na tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan ngo bo nyid: rdo rje sgeg bzhed khro chags mdzes: bdag 'dzin 'joms mdzad ḍākki'i tshul: sgo ma rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ ḍākki baṃ ti dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams kyis gdan gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa la/ che rtags su phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgya rtags dang rgyan chas kyis mnga' gsol bas/ chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' dbang brnyes te 'gro don thogs med la spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par mos shig / de nas phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: shel phreng pad dkar rdo rje dang : nor bu padma lcags kyu dang : padma zhags pa nor bu sgrog: dung dril me long dbang bskur ro:

om̐ sarba bhi shwa dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rigs lnga cod pan dar dpyangs dang : snyan rgyan mgul rgyan stod g.yogs mdzes: phyag gdub zhabs gdub se mo do: smad dkris dar tshon dbang bskur ro: om̐ bhi shwa arbha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtha' rten du snang grags rig gsum sku gsung thugs su ngo sprad pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ de nas rigs lnga'i tshom bu dang shel rdo thogs nas: hūm̐: snang stong lha sku grags stong sngags: dran stong shes rab ye shes sku: sna tshogs gsal stong ngo bo nyid: ngo sprod tshig gi dbang bskur ro: om̐ dharma swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ngo sprad pa ni/ hoḥ tshom bu ye shes lnga dang ldan pa ni bskyed rim sgyu mas sprul bsgyur yin pa'i brda: ngo sprod tshig gi grags stong yin pas 'byung 'jug sngags la dngos po bral ba'i brda: shel rdo'i 'gying log 'di snang stong yin pas: rig pa ka dag zang thal yin pa'i brda: bskyed rdzogs thams cad tshig gis mtshon tsam yin pas 'dus ma byas la rtag chad dang bral ba'i brda yin no/ de nas rgyud byin gyis brlab cing bden pa'i tshig 'grub pa dang gnas pa'i phyir: byin rlabs bka' bsgo bya ba ni: gtor ma thogs la: hoḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro: longs sku thugs rje chen po: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa/ rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje/ mchog sprul o rgyan rig 'dzin/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las/ kun bzang 'chi med nor bu/ rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje/ rig 'dzin snyan grags rgya mtsho/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje/ bka' bab kun dga' blo gros/ ngag dbang dkon mchog seṅge/

lung zin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ brgyud 'dzin ārya dhwa dza/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa dge legs/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ karma o rgyan/ rnam sprul padma phrin las/ 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer gyi bar du byon pa'i drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ chos bdag rig 'dzin bcu gsum: bka' bab grub thob rtsa lnga la sogs brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyi sngon las 'phral rkyen du gyur pa'i/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig /nam zhig mi rtag 'pho ba'i dus su ma dag rigs drug gi skye sgo khegs nas/ bar do drug gi 'phrang las sgrol zhing sku gsum skye ba med pa'i don rtogs nas/ shar phyogs ri bo tā lar yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku dang dbyer med du sangs rgyas te/ 'gro don thogs pa med par 'byung bar gyur cig /om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma ṇi? kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo legs par bskur grub pa lags pas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi da nas bzung byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du tshe rabs kyi lha skal du 'dzin snyam pa dang*/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dam tshig gis gtsos bsrung bya thams cad mi nyams par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p zhes lan gsum/ de ltar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi tshul du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos sogs? slar sgo gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa yid kyis blangs te bla ma la 'bul ba lags na cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
