deng nas brtsam ste sogs lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ 'phags mchog thum̐gs rje chem̐n po nam mkha'i rgyal/ /'khom̐r 'dam̐s zim̐l gnom̐n spyan ras gzigs dbam̐ng gis/ /smin byed gsaṃng sngaṃgs chu bo kun 'dus mchog /bstanaṃ 'gro don gnyis 'dziṃn la mchog du rmad/ de dag ni sum cu pa thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang 'bring gi le tshan no// // ༈ yi dam zhi khro spyi'i skor las/ dgos dbang gi zhi khro na raka dong sprugs gong du song*// // ༈ bkam̐' bab rig 'dzin brgyam̐d dang pad 'byung gi /thugs kyi gsam̐ng bam̐ zim̐l gnom̐n dpal dgu yi/ /smin byed dbam̐ng chem̐n dam pa'i phyag srol bzhin/ /sgrub pa spyi rdzong chom̐g khrim̐gs 'di na spel/ so gcig pa bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ spros bcas dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong zhes bya ba'i smin byed gyi dbang chog nar 'gros su bkod pa la'ang*/ smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ shin tu spros bcas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang chen mo zhes pa ni/ sgrub chen dang sbrags pa ste/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs sta gon byas la/ bsnyen grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol te nyin bcu'i nang rdzogs par byed pa yin mod/ 'di 'dra'i lag len deng sang byed mkhan dkon pas lag len thebs par dka' bas 'dir dbang rkyang gi khongs su sgrub khog gi nang du bshad pa'i sta gon dang sgrub dbang rnams kyis 'thus par mdzad pa gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa la/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang*/ sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgrub gnas rnying pa'am ras bris lta bur ma byas kyang chog mod/ mdo tsam spros par mos na/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ bsang chu 'thor byed ku sha sogs 'du bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsam ste/ nas bzed/ yungs thun/ g.yab dar ḍā ru/ rdor dril gdab phur nang mchod rnams dgod/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu bkod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum bya/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gying : dbyings phyug yum 'khyud gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo'i gnas: lnga dang yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpal rngam brjid par gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya tsam bzla/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mthing nag phur bu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/

oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams shing*/ de'i steng du gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/

gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas rang nyid skad cig gis dpal chen che mchog he ru ka'i skur gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ti padma kro ti? rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/ /de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha dang bum pa sta gon chabs cig tu bshad na/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan sogs bkram pa'i mdun stegs khebs ldan gyi steng du/ maṇḍa lar dri'i thig le'i dbus su/ tshom bu lha grangs ltar bsnyen sgrub sngags kho na'i mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag phyed par bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma/ mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/

de nas bum pa rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug ste hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la yungs dkar gyis brab/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang dri bzang bum rdzas so lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu gtsang gis phyed ka khengs par blugs/ rnam bum la mgul chings dmar nag dang*/ las bum la mgul chings ljang gu sgron/ kha rgyan gzung thag dang bcas pa 'du bya la tshom bu'i steng rkang gsum thog dgod/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu dgram/ hūm̐: phyi mchod rnam lnga dbang po mdangs ldan? sogs mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar btang la/ bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa khyug tsam byas la rnam bum dang las bum sgrub nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ spros med kyi skabs/ sgrub gzhi rang byung gi ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal gdab la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod dang yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spos dang thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu so sor smin: de ldog phyir na rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes pas nongs par bshags shing*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba ni/ dril spos dang bcas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs: khyed rnams mchod dang slob ma la: phan phyir dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/

slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'dus pa'i skur: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rdzogs: bdun brgya nyer lngas 'bar zhing sreg: gzi brjid glog dmar chi li li: drag sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: nyams 'gyur me char spungs se spung : dkyil 'khor khro bo'i pho brang du: glags lta'i gdon bgegs mi gnas par: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: mtshon cha drag po thog ltar 'bebs: mgo lus tshal pa phye mar gtong :

rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: om̐ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ mkha' ltar khyab pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru nam yang 'bral brlag med: rnam rtog ru tra gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: chos dbyings brdal khyab bsrungs mtshams med par gsal: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga bdag ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ dharma dzñā na badzra tsakra satwaṃ: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon zhwa chos dang bcas te/ lo rgyus rgyas bsdus mtshams sbyar ltar ci rigs par long khom dang bstun nas 'chad la/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon zhes byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ de ring gi skabs su sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad gsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/

gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar/ de ring gi skabs lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes thun mong gi maṇḍal spyi dang khyad par gyi maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kyi gtso: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: gling bzhi ri rab maṇḍal 'bul: lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa bshags: sku gsung dam tshig sdom pa bsrung: yang dag sangs rgyas thob par shog: de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yis gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ skal ldan dam gtsang rigs kyi sras: snod kyi dam pa mchog rnams nyon: deng 'dir bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du: smin phyir bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo hūm̐: hoḥ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs zhing la: rtag par bdag cag skyabs mchi bas:

'gro kun bde ldan lam gnas shog: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pas smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ 'khor 'das bral ba'i gshis lugs la: ka dag zang thal 'od zer gyis: ma rig 'khrul ba'i mun pa bsal: ye grol chen por sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ hūm̐: kun bzang klong yangs dkyil 'khor nas: cho 'phrul longs sku'i zhi khro rnams: dran rdzogs wal gyis lhang nger gshegs: skyon bral padma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyag gcig sprul skur phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa bzhes: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa bshags: ye grol chen po khyed la bstod: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin chen por bsngo: smon lam kun khyab dbyings gnas shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig bla med chu: bsrungs na dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: nyams na snying khrag las mkhan dgyes: de bas dam srungs sa ma ya:

de ltar rtsa ba yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra karma du pā la nan sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis gang mang byin rlabs bya: pho'i lag g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du 'dogs: oṃ badzra he ru ka kro ta kro ti ma ma tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐ hūm̐: de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings la phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gcod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lngar mtshon pas kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba 'di nyid bcings pas phyi ltar na rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing nang ltar na ma dag nyon mongs pa thams cad dang*/ gsang ba ltar na dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid: dkyil 'khor bar chod bsrung ba dang : dbang rnams rab tu gnas pa'i phyir: dam tshig rdo rjes rgyas btab bo: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha tsakra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ rmi lam brtag phyir skye med yi ge āḥre gtad/ om̐ dang po skye med stong par āḥ bar du 'gags med gsal snang āḥ tha ma bde stong 'dzin med āḥ rang sems dri med āḥdakar sgom: om̐ a a āḥ snying gar gtad/ de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ hya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shuddho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur:

dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sngon du chu bo nai rañdza na'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad cing rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas te seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log nas mgo dkyil 'khor phyogs su gtad la rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ /hūm̐: sngon tshe byang chub sems dpa' yis: rtswa mchog la ni gdan byas te: ma gha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad: rten 'brel brtags shing rdzogs sangs rgyas: oṃ badzra a sa na gha ta ru pa sa muṅga te āḥhūm̐: de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: dkyil 'khor rigs lnga tshang ba zhig gi steng du skyer pa'i shing la mgo bo me tog /rtsa ba phur bu bgyis pa'i so shing smon lam dang bcas nas dor te: de'ang slob dpon gyis so shing sbyin pa'i dus su thal sbyar bar du blangs: rjes zlos kyi tshe mkha' dbyings phyag rgya zhes mthe bong lto sbyar ba'i bar so shing gi rtsa ba bzung nas sos 'cha' ba'i tshul dang*/ sor mo rnams thad kar brkyangs pa'i gung mos so shing gi rtse mo me tog dang ldan pa bzung : de lta bu'i phyag rgya'i bar gyi so shing cung zad sos 'cha' ba dang lhan cig tu dmigs pa so shing las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis khong pa'i nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin/ nag 'dur gyis phyir 'then te dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim song snyam pa dang sngags lung 'bog pa'i āḥde sems nyid dbye ba med pa de nyid rtse mo me tog 'dor yul gyi maṇḍa lar gtad de dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gsal por ston cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod:

hūm̐: lus ngag yid kyi so shing la: rten 'brel dbang po'i me tog brgyan: de ring bzang ngan las 'phro brtag: tsittar 'grub pa bzhin du shog: oṃ sa ma ya puṣpe pha la ma ma siddhi hoḥ zhes bden tshig dang bcas pas dor bas: dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub: shar zhi ba: lhor rgyas pa: nub tu dbang : byang du drag po: mtshams bzhir thun mong gi dngos grub phran tshegs re 'thob pa'i ltas yin/ gal te dal gyi phyi rol du lhungs na ngan pas lan gsum du bskyar/ ma phog na shin tu ngan pas dbang gi snod du mi rung ba'i ltas yin pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa dang dge ba rlabs chen bya/ ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung bas/ lhag par tshogs brgya sātstsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos so: de nas spyi bor cod pan gyis brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: cod pan ye shes lnga yi rtags: deng nas dkyil 'khor 'dzin mdzad cing : che mchog lha dang skal ba mnyam: gsang ba rdo rje'i ming thob shog: oṃ badzra mu ṭa dhā ti ta hoḥ 'di'i don lnga ni: dam chu kha ru blud pas dam tshig mi nyams par khas len: mna' tho rang chad kyi rnam dbye: cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags/ dpung skud legs par 'dogs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgya chings: āḥsnying khar sgom pa sems mi 'khrul ba'i dam mdzer: rtswa gdan gyi 'og tu 'ding ba sgrub pa mthar ma phyin bar mi 'gul ba'i dam bca' ste sngon du 'gro ba'i gzer bu lnga'o:

de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rang gi spyi gtsug zla gdan dbus: bcom ldan rdor sems dung mdog sku: rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: rnal 'byor dmar mo gri thod 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i na bza' bklubs: snang stong ma 'gags lam gyis gsal: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las: 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' ni: rang 'dra dbang lhas bskor bar byon: spyi bor zhu nas snying khar thim: thugs kar hrīḥyig dkar po'i mthar: sngags phreng 'od zer drwa ba can: g.yas g.yon bskor nas sdig sgrib dag: chu shel dwangs ma'i sgong ltar gyur: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas la skong bshags sogs la 'bad pas bar chad sel zhing dbang gi snod rung du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ de dag gis bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar smin byed sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub pa yin no/ /de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di? de dag gis sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub zin te dngos gzhi ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ / sta gon gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las spros bcas dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong zhes bya ba'i dngos gzhi'i dbang la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dbus su/ stegs bu mthing nag gi steng*/ bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor ras bris dgram/ de'i steng du 'bru tshom lha grangs sam gtso dgu'i tshom bu bkod pa'i khar rkang gsum gyi thog tu rnam rgyal bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings mthing nag gis brgyan pa de'i thog ka pā la bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa'i dza gad kyis dgang*/

de'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyis bkab cing me long sindhu ras chos 'byung bsnol ma lte bar mūm̐ḥzur bzhi ha ri ni sa bris pa man shel zur drug dang bcas dgod/ mdun rgyab gang bder gong gtor la/ gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng du zla gam sgo gcig /de'i steng du chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khar dpal gtor rtse thon dpung zlum 'khyil ba/ lto ba nor bu'i dbyibs can pad 'dab dang pad tshab bzhi/ 'khor rtsibs brgyad kyi steng du dmar gtor re bcas dang*/ bka' gter srung ma mgon po dregs dpung*/ gzhan yang rang lugs rgyun gsol gyi gtor ma/ chad brtan bskul gsum dkar bgegs bcas mkho ba'i yo byad dang*/ de bzhin dbang gi yo chas bum tsaka a yig dor ra/ gser thur/ cod pan/ che mchog he ru ka yum dbyings phyug ma/ rdo rje/ bhandha/ yum gyi phyag mtshan dang dur khrod kyi chas/ kun bzang yab yum/ rdor sems yab yum/ bya khyung*/ 'jam dpal/ rta mgrin/ yang dag phur pa/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ bla ma rig 'dzin/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ dmod pa drag sngags/ khyung brgyad/ he ru ka yab yum bcu drug /mgon po bya rog gdong*/ sgo srung sogs lha dbang dang*/ thod skam prog zhu/ thal chen tshom bu/ glang ko /rdo rje'i go khrab/ zhing lpags/ chu srin gyi stod g.yogs/ sbrul chun dang thod phreng*/ sku reg rus sbal gyi phreng ba/ rus rgyan/ stag sham/ me dpung sogs chas dbang*/ bskang gtor/ rdo rje rgya gram/ rigs lnga/ dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje gzung thag 'khor lo/ dung dkar/ rdor dril/ po ti/ padma'i phreng ba/ me long*/ srung 'khor/ rdo rje/ raksha'i phreng ba/ thun snod/ phod kha dang sngags zhwa/ gtor zor/ hom gzar dang thab/ 'ja' gur dang me long*/ man shel/ rdo rje/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun sogs ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs ye phreng skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar btang zhing dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ rang lugs gsol kha spyi dang bye brag mgon po'i gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba ni/ sta gon sngon du song ba'i slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'dus pa'i skur: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rdzogs: bdun brgya nyer lngas 'bar zhing sreg: gzi brjid glog dmar chi li li: drag sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: nyams 'gyur me char spungs se spung : dkyil 'khor khro bo'i pho brang du: glags lta'i gdon bgegs mi gnas par: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: mtshon cha drag po thog ltar 'bebs: mgo lus tshal pa phye mar gtong : rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: om̐ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ mkha' ltar khyab pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru nam yang 'bral brlag med: rnam rtog ru tra gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: chos dbyings brdal khyab bsrungs mtshams med par gsal: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga bdag ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ dharma dzñā na badzra tsakra satwaṃ: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ slob dpon shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ sgo ba chen po dgongs su gsol: che mchog khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug phyir du: rig pa ye shes 'char sgo phyes: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal ba 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ nged rnams 'jigs byed ma rungs pa: skal med 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin: ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun gcod: khyed rnams dam tshig ldan nges sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing rigs dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ nged rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: sngon dbang bzang zhing phyi 'phro legs: khyed rnams rgyu 'bras sgo srung nyid: phra zhib ston pas sgo phyes 'tshal: nged rnams ci bzhin dam la gnas: zhes zhus pas phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pa la nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces pas sgo dbye la nang du spro ba dang bcas 'jug pa la phyir 'brang gi bgegs rdo rje ging chen rnams kyis bskrad pa'i las mdzad par mos mdzod/ sgo drung du ging dkar nag gis rdo thun thogs te/ rngam stabs ha ha dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te phyir 'brang gi 'byung po bskrad/ hoḥ de ltar dam tshig bsrung lags na: ma rig nyon mongs sgo bkag ste: rang byung ye shes 'char sgo dbye: skal med bdud dang bar chad 'dul: oṃ badzra kro ta ging ka ra ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyo: log 'dren bdud dang bar chad ngan pa mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces thun gyis brabs la rgyud ma dag pa rnams dag par byas shing dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs bar/ phyi nang gi ngo gsar ram dam tshig ma blang ba la bskur du mi rung*/ de nas nang du zhugs te gral du 'khod la/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyimadun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: che mchog ye shes dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug phyir du: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: hoḥ 'di ni che mchog rdo rje'i dbyings: khrag 'thung gsang ba'i pho brang yin: khyed rnams snod mchog ldan lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ mi phyed dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la: rigs ldan rnal 'byor cis mi dad: snod ldan bdag la gnang ba stsol: bla med dam tshig srog ltar bsrung : de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag tu rdo rje thogs la dbye rgya dang bcas/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phye bar mos mdzod/ hūm̐: pho brang chen po ye shes dbyings: yang dag rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid: de ring khyed rnams 'jug pa'i phyir: rten 'brel brda yi sgo dbye'o: om̐ dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ yol ba bsal/ de nas ye shes lnga'i dar thag ring po'i sne mor slob ma rnams kyis bzung ste slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i lam la khrid de nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i dar thag brkyangs te: slob ma rnams kyis sne mor 'ju zhing 'khrid: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ lhun grub lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du: las sad smon lam ldan rnams shog: the tshom can rnams phyir dengs shig: ces rig pa ye shes kyi lam du khrid de gral du 'khod: sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i gdong g.yogs re bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/

tsakṣu bhandha ma na wā ra hūm̐/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten du u dum wā ra la sogs pa mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig: om̐ puṣpe siddhi hūm̐: da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med pa gsum la sogs pa'i rtsol sgrub kyi yun tu 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la zhugs par bya'o/ /de'ang smin byed kyi dbang zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pa'i thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa thugs nges dang*/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/ chos nyams su len pa ni/

sman bsten na nad nye bar sel ba'i 'du shes te yang dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos su mos gus dad pa dang ldan pas/ sgo gsum legs par bsdams te gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed zin kyang*/ de kho nas mi chog ste phyi ma phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med yin pa ma tshad tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen nye 'brel grogs dga' mdza' thob go sa nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang ste/ las dkar nag 'ba' zhig rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma sgrub par khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing*/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos/ de'ang lha mi'i ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid gdod nas gzhi dbyings 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams rgya khyon blo 'das bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa khyab brdal gyi klong du/ ston pa rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo chos nyid bya rtsol las 'das pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi dpal ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba/

rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyi ye shes lnga'i rang rtsal chen pos dam pa'i chos kyi rang sgra'am nges pa don gyi chos 'khor 'ba' zhig bskor ba/ de nyid gdul bya'i blo'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i theg pa sna tshogs su gyur te sde snod dang theg pa'i dbye sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang mdor bsdus na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus/ theg chen de la'ang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis te/ gal po las/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas rgyu ru shes/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas nyid du shes/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gang yin pa/ /phyogs kyis rab tu shes par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir bsgrub bya byang chub thob par 'dod pa don gcig kyang*/ sgrub byed thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par che ste/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na'ang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi/ /dbang po rnon pos rkyen byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes gsungs pas snga ma las khyad 'phags kyi chos du ma dang ldan pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgya gar 'phags yul du de lta'i dbye ba med mod/ byang phyogs kai la sha'i yul ljongs su 'gyur snga phyi la brten nas sngags gsar rnying gnyis su btags pa las/ 'di ni phyi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa gsar ma las/ khyad chos drug ldan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi chos sde gsum yod pa las/ skabs su bab par rtsod ldan dus kyi gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las rlabs che ba bka' bab lung bstan smon lam dbang bskur shog ser tshig brgyud de/ brgyud pa'i bka' srol drug gam brgyud pa dgu ldan gyis khyad par du byas pa'i zab mo gter ma yin/ de la'ang sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa sogs byon par mdzad pa las/

'di ni gu ru'i thugs sras snying gi bu dgu zhes 'phags yul gyi grub chen rig 'dzin brgyad dang tha mi dad par sgrub sde brgyad kyi bka' bab bu dgu'i nang tshan/ 'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab dang*/ khyad par du mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i shing rta chen po/ gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal zhing*/ grub gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa/ grub pa'i rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur zhing nyi zla gdan du bting ba dang*/ brag la phur pa 'debs pa/ sdigs mdzub gtad pa tsam gyis sra mkhregs brag gi ri bo'ang rdul phran du bshig nus pa sogs/ mdor na bdud rje glang dar ma'ang rje 'di'i nus mthus zil gyis mnan pas mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa gos dkar lcang lo'i sde dang bcas par glags blta bar ma nus pas mtshon bstan pa 'dzin srung spel ba'i bka' drin che zhing*/ sku tshe'ang mnga' bdag khri srong nas rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar mi lo sum brgya ma zin tsam du bzhugs pas mtshon/ nus pa'i mthu/ rnam bzhi'i las/ 'chi med kyi tshe sogs thun mong gi grub pa dang*/ thun min sku tshe de ny-id la theg mchog snying po'i lam mthar son cing*/ mthar sku mi snang bar 'od lus su gshegs pa de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar sprul pa'i gter chen gtsug lag dpal dge /dum rgya zhang khrom/ dri med kun dga' sogs gter ston rkyang pa bdun dang gzhan du ma byon tshul yang*/gter lung rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ gnubs chen khyod 'di nas skye ba bcu bdun pa'i mtshams su ming gnam lcags las grub pa ma nges pa rlung ltar rgyu ba zhig 'byung ngo zhes dang*/ o rgyan gling pa'i gter lung las/ de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu: chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang : lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan grags pas khyab:

sha 'ug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung : o rgyan gter bdag gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes dang*/ gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ gnubs kyi ban de sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: ma 'ongs dus mthar la stod ye shes mchog: sngags 'chang sbas tshul nus pa'i rtsal shugs can: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin: zhes dang*/ rang gter las/ sems can skyabs med dbul phongs a tsa ma: gang phyir pad 'byung nga yi smon lam gyis: gnubs kyi lo tsā buddha dzñā na 'dis: skye ba du mar sems can 'gro don byed: lan gcig mdo khams yul gyi stod dag la: padma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags nas: bod 'bangs skyob pa'i gter kha dpag med 'byin: ma 'ongs de dus zab chos 'di 'byung ste: 'brel tshad byang chub thob par lung yang bstan: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rje gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje/ o rgyan rog rje gling pa/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa sogs tshad ma'i gter chen du mas gtsug tu bkur zhing*/ zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pa sogs padma'i rgyal tshab sprul pa'i gter chen du/ sus kyang bsnyon med du grub par ma zad mthu nus yon tan 'gran zla dang bral ba/ de nyid kyis ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las/ zab gter bdun cu don lnga'i bgo skal thob pa'i nang tshan bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs/ rtsa gsum sgrub skor mang du bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni zab pa rtsa ba'i chos sde yi dam sgrub sde bka' brgyad ces rgyud sde dang sgrub sde thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin la/ rang gzhung las/ e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan rjes 'brang dang : smon lam las can chos bdag bu yi don:

bka' brgyad yang snying gsang ba zil gnon bzhag: dbang gi rgyal mo ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: sangs rgyas ye shes rje 'bangs grogs lnga rnams: zab gter brda dang rgya rtags ri mo dang : gter gyi sgrom bu 'di nyid sbas pa'i yul: 'don dang spel ba'i sa rtags dus dang skabs: lo zla rten 'brel la sogs bstan pa ni: mi brjed zungs la snying gi dkyil du chongs: kha byang lung byang gter byang yang byang bzhi: snyan brgyud bka' gtad lung bstan zab rgya'i skor: kho bo'i bka' ltar 'dzin 'chang spel bar gyis: 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i chos dka' mang lags kyang : snying thig zab mo 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rgyud sde lung gi bshad pa mang lags kyang : kha tshang don 'dus 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rgya cher sbas lags kyang : phyi nang gsang gsum gcig dril 'di 'dra med: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ 'og min gyi gnas su kun tu bzang po dpal he ru kas yongs su dag pa'i/ 'khor rnams la rdo rje'i tshig tu gsungs pa rnams sdud pa po rdo rje chos la sogs pas bsdus shing*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yi ger snang ba rin po che'i sgrom du bcug ste/ mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs par mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mos gtsos/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gnyer du gtad par mdzad pa dang*/ gang gi tshe dur khrod ro gling bsil ba'i tshal zhes/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngul sgrom/ lcags sgrom/ zangs sgrom/ g.yu sgrom/ bswe sgrom/ mchong sgrom/ gzi sgrom/ rin chen sna lnga'i sgrom bu sogs so sor gtad cing bka' bab pa dang*/ de rnams kyis slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gnyis par gtad cing dbang bskur bas sgrub sde yongs rdzogs kyi bka' bab/ rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyis bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la/

sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing so so'i me tog rigs kyi lha/ tshom bu dgur babs pa'i lha so so'i grub pa brnyes shing*/ de rnams la gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag mang du byung ba'i snying bcud du dril ba/ bka' brgyad rnam gsum sogs sprul pa'i gter chen du ma'i/ zab gter so so'i bgo skal du babs pa mtha' yas pa byung ba'i nang tshan/ 'di ni o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas gu ru'i gnas chen sbas yul padma bkod bal phu yar 'brog mtsho 'khor rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo ba'i klong nas/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i kun ldan zhes lcags byi lo'i hor zla bcu pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma dang bcas/ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos skor gyi gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan/ rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa rin po che ru bya'i mdog can sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ sgo dang po la rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang zhi khro na raka dong sprugs phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu dang bcas pa bzhugs/ sgo bar pa la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ sgo 'og ma la dregs pa srog thig nag po'i man ngag lag len dang bcas pa/ 'di gcig pu glegs bam sa bcu'i grangs ldan dang sku tshab padma mthong grol/ dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu/ a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ gu ru'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu/ las phur bdud dpung zil gnon/ mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi na bza' gos ber mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs khrom gter du gdan drangs pa/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon zhes byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing*/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba/ 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/

sta gon gyi chos rnams grub la dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med pa legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yis gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ skal ldan dam gtsang rigs kyi sras: snod kyi dam pa mchog rnams nyon: deng 'dir bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du: smin phyir bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: ka dag kun gzhi sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: ma 'gags tshogs drug cir snang chos kyi mdzod:

yengs med rtse gcig dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul rang byung de bzhin skyabs su gsol: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pas smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ 'khor 'das bral ba snod bcud dag pa'i zhing : kun gzhi ma bcos ye nas sems bskyed bral: blo 'das sems can bdag gzhan gnyis su med: de don rig pa'i kun nas sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ hoḥ chos dbyings lhun grub dag pa'i zhing : kun bzang bla ma gshegs su gsol: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol khyod la don phyag 'tshal: 'gags med shar grol dbang pos mchod: zang thal kun rig khyod la bstod: dgag sgrub gnyis 'dzin mthol lo bshags: khregs chod lta ba'i chos 'khor bskor: lhun grub bde stong dge ba bsngo: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di nyid 'da' dka' rdo rje'i chu: dam tshig gnyan gyis sdom pa srungs: nyams na na raka dmyal bar ltung : tshul bzhin ldan na dngos grub thob: khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya khaṃ i dante na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yaksha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar snod bcud thams cad ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa e'i rang bzhin can: 'byung lnga brtsegs thabs su spel ba'i pho brang chen po dgu dang ldan pa'i dbus su: nyi zla padma bam dang lha klu byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan la khyed rang rnams skad cig gis che mchog he ru ka chen po: sku mdog smug nag: dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig khro zhing phyag bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyis rdo rje dang bhandha bsnams pa: rdo rje rin po che'i sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod kyi dpal chas rdzogs la zhabs bco brgyad brkyang bskum gyis 'gying ba: de'i pang du khro mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu khro la phyag bco brgyad kyis gri thod 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa:

dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs la zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum yab kyi sked nas 'khril zhing : yab yum me ri dmar nag 'khrigs pa'i klong du thugs yig 'bru sa bon sngags dang bcas pa'i spyi bor rdor sems kun bzang khyung dang bcas te zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsal ba'o/ /shar du pad nyi ru tra'i gdan la yang dag he ru ka mthing nag gis yum kro ti shwa rī mar 'khril zhing thugs kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: lho ru chu glang pad nyi'i gdan la 'jam dpal gshin rje ser nag gis yum bhe ta lir 'khril zhing sku'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: nub tu klu dbang pad nyi'i gdan la dbang chen rta mgrin dmar pos yum padma gzi ldan mar 'khril zhing gsung gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: byang tu gnod sbyin dang pad nyi'i gdan la phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag gis yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar 'khril zhing phrin las kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: shar lhor pad nyi zla gdan la bla med he ru ka ljang nag gis yum nyid zhi kun bzang mar 'khril zhing yon tan gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa gsal ba'o: lho nub tu ru tra pad nyi'i gdan la drag po dmar nag me phreng can gyis yum rdo rje bdud 'dul mar 'khril zhing bla ma rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs gsal ba'o: nub byang du dam sri dang pad nyi'i gdan la dregs pa stobs ldan khams nag gis yum srid gsum spyi 'dul mar 'khril zhing gnyis med kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: byang shar du ru tra'i bam gyi gdan la dmod pa khrag 'thung nag pos yum 'byung lnga'i khro mor 'khril zhing drag sngags rbad pa'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: de rnams khro shing gtum pa dur khrod kyi chas brgyad rdzogs shing phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin te sku la bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad rdul 'khrigs pa ltar gsal thob/

de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings dang*/ gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs ma lus pa nam mkha' nas sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu/ bar snang nas kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ sa gzhi nas dpyid rlangs drag tu phyur ba lta bur snang srid thams cad yom yom shig shig tu g.yo zhing*/ dus mtha'i rlung dang 'bigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog rgod tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bar rgya mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub ka dag pho brang nas: khyab brdal rol pa che mchog zhi khro'i lha: zhi rgyas dbang drag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : che mchog 'dus pa'i tshom bu dgu: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag rnams: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob: dbang chen rigs kyi dbang bskur la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya phyir/

sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ye shes pa brtan par gyur cig tiṣṭha badzra: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ me tog 'dor bar tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya ste/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid khyed rang dang tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i/ rigs kyi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor bar zhu/ kyaiḥ bdag gis tshe rabs 'di bar du: sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : deng 'dir smon lam ldan pa yi: yi dam lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe pra ti tsa hoḥ zhes me tog dor bas gang du babs pa'i rigs mthun gsang mtshan gyi ming 'dogs par bya'o: hoḥ khyod ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas lta ba mi shigs pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya: bla mas: khyed kyi ming ci yin gsung rtsar: slob mas: lta ba mi shigs pa: rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba lags so: shar du babs na zhi ba'i lha nas ming gdags: lhor rgyas pa'i lha nas ming gdags: nub tu dbang gi lha nas ming gdags: byang du drag po'i lha nas ming gdags: de nas phur pa lag tu gtad de: hūm̐: dam tshig dbang po brten pa'i phyir: gsang ba bla med phur pa 'chang : deng nas sgrub pa srog ltar brtson: dam med rnams la reg mi bya: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha nan kī la ya hūm̐: de nas slob ma rnams kyis mig dbye ba'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ nyon mongs nad sel ye shes sman: ma rig bcom pa'i shes rab spyan: zang thal rdo rje slob dpon gyis: bdag gi rab rib mun sel stsol: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig / slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la:

hoḥ nga ni lta ba'i ye shes rgyal: sgrib g.yogs 'khrul ba'i dbyings dang bral: rig pa chos dbyings thur ma yis: khyod kyi ma rig ling tog bsal: oṃ badzra dharma tsakṣu pra we sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong ba'i mthong ba bstan pa dang don ngo sprod par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor rlabs po che: ngo mtshar che zhing spro ba bskyed: nged rnams ma dag rmongs pa'i khyur: 'di don dkyil 'khor ngo sprod stsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ slob dpon gyis/ de ltar glo bur gyi sgrib pa bsal nas rnam dag ye shes kyi mig thob pas/ bla med yang dag ye shes rol pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ kyaiḥ khyed rnams skal ldan las 'phro can: deng 'dir bla med dkyil 'khor bstan: zab pa'i man ngag 'di 'dra dkon: yang dag ngo mtshar che 'di zungs: om̐ dharma gu hya badzra tsakra satwaṃ: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid mchog 'dod: dam chos ye shes lnga ru myong : dam tshig snying gi khrag ltar bsrung : skyon spang dag snang la gnas so: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams snod ldan rigs kyi sras: skal ldan las 'phro sad pa'i bu: bla med gsang ba'i dal du 'jug: dkyil 'khor dbang rdzogs smin par bskur: oṃ ma hā rasmi bha wa satwaṃ: de nas slob ma bde chen gyi lam la 'khrid pa ni: slob dpon gyis phyag shing thogs la/ hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: snying po ye shes dgu dang ldan: rnam dag blo yis bcos pa yin: ye nas rang byung ngo sprod bya: oṃ swa bhā wa dharma haṃ: hoḥ 'dus pa'i 'khor skal ldan rnams legs par nyon cig: dkyil 'khor dbyings nas grub pa ni: chos sku skye ba med pa'i brda:

rlung rdo rje rgya gram sogs 'byung ba lnga las grub pa ni: gzhi ye nas snod bcud gyi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i brda: rgyu rkyen stong pa'i hūm̐ dang bhrūm̐ las grub pa ni: dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i brda: rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zla gam dmar po sgo gcig ni: kun gyi 'char sgo rig pa gcig pa'i brda: phyi nang mi sgrib cing bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyis spras pa ni: chos kun zang thal la lam bdun mi rtog pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i brda: nang rim chos 'khor nyi zla'i 'od kyi gong bu dang rgyan dar sna tshogs 'phyang ba ni: sa bcu gsum rang la rdzogs te tsitta sha'i sgron me'i dkyil nas rgyangs zhag chu'i 'od zer snang ba dkar dmar la rig dang ma rig pa sna tshogs blo 'das su 'char ba'i brda: de'i dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma stong ldan yod pa ni: kun gzhi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brda: de'i phyi rol du 'dab ma bzhi dang brgyad yod pa ni: lam bzhi'i shes pa brgyad dag pa'i brda: dbus su gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ sgra dang ldan pa ni: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal rang byung rig pa'i dbyings la lhun grub tu shar ba'i brda: ye shes lnga'i tshom bu dang ldan pa ni: sa brgyad kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i brda: gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa ni: phrin las rnam bzhi dang tshad med bzhi mtshon pa'i brda: rtsig pa rnam pa lngar bhandha'i kha bad dang ldan pa ni: ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin las ma 'gags pa'i cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i brda: khro chu'i gzer gyis bsdams shing rmang pha lam las grub pa ni: chos sku rtog med kyi gzer la 'gyur ldog med pa'i brda: lha brgyad klu brgyad kyi ka gdung dang ldan pa ni: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag nas mi rtog pa'i rig pa brgyad ldan pa'i brda: rgyu skar gyi dral lcam btab cing zhing lpags kyi thog phub pa ni:

rtsa khams thig le grangs med gnas shing bem shun gyi rgyan dang ldan pa'i brda: nyi zla'i ka zhu g.yu 'brug gis brgyan pa ni: a haṃ thabs shes kha sbyor du rlung 'byin 'jug gi rang sgra dang ldan pa'i brda: chu srin gyi ka gdan byas shing nang rakta'i zham chu dang me ri 'bar ba ni: ye nas rlung sgra gcan gyis rnam shes bzung nas gtong du med cing phung po lha'i pho brang du stod chu dang smad me'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i brda: mi lpags kyi bla bre don snying lnga'i 'phan 'phyang ba ni: rnam shes chags pa'i rten nying lag brgyad yin pa'i brda: rin chen pha gu rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa ni: rang sems ye nas 'dod rgur 'byung zhing tshogs drug ma 'gags pa'i brda: drwa ba mun nag la me 'bar zhing sgra sgrogs pa ni: ye shes lnga la gzhi ma rig pa'i dri ma bral te 'khrul rtog chos nyid du grol zhing grags stong gi brda: rgyu ma dang brgyus pa'i dril bu rnga yab 'phan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa ni: shes rig ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: mi'i drwa ba mkhal mchin pho rdo brkyangs shing g.yer kha'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: 'khor 'das kun gyi sgra thams cad tshig gi brda la brten dgos pa'i brda: rlung ras mi lpags stag lpags sbrul sogs 'phyang ba ni: ye shes lnga'i rang rtsal gyis nyon mongs pa sna tshogs g.yer ba'i brda: mda' yab dkar po shel dang rgyang grags byi ru g.yu sogs rin po che'i mchod rten dang ldan pa ni: dbyings ma bcos lhun grub 'byung ba rin po che'i mchod rten yin pa'i brda: phyogs bzhi'i ka ba gshin rje dang gdung ma phyogs skyong khro bo khro mo'i zhu la keng rus kyi ka rgyan klu'i gdan byas pa ni: dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung khro bo'i pho brang log lta can gyis mi mthong ba'i brda: zhing skyong pho mo 'phro zhing phyogs bzhi'i ka rgyan seṅge 'brug chu srin stag las byas pa ni:

che mchog dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du sha za 'gyu bas dam med rnams bgrod du mi btub pa'i brda: rta babs bzhir ma mo ke'u ri ma 'phro zhing klong dgur khang bzang dgu dang ldan pa las ma mo ke'u ri 'gyu ba ni: tshad med pa'i ngo bor bdag 'dzin bral zhing sgo dgu rnams kyi 'gyu lam ma bkag pas rang shar du grol ba'i brda: chos 'khor bcu gnyis la khro bo khro mo'i rang sgra dang ldan zhing za ram ā li kā li'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: snang srid chos nyid kyi rang sgrar phyi nang dang bral ba'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i phyi rol du lha'i khye'us gar bsgyur ba ni: rang byung gi rig pa sna tshogs 'char ba'i brda: ri dwags rma bya khyung dang mi gcer bur gnas pa ni: 'khor 'das gzhi gcig la lam sna tshogs 'char te ngos bzung stong zhing bral ba'i brda: gzhal yas kyi steng thams cad du rgyal mtshan sna tshogs phyar ba ni: dpal gyi pho brang mtshan nyid stong dang ldan pa'i brda: keng rus kyis gar bsgyur ba ni: chos sku mtshan ma'i gzugs dang bral ba'i brda: pho brang gi phyi rol du padma'i phreng bas bskor ba ni: ye nas snod thams cad kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i klong yin pa'i brda: dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba ni: rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang byung du grol ba'i brda: zla phyed rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ni: rdo rje'i klong la 'khor 'das med pa'i brda: mtshon dang me ri'i gur khang ldan pa ni: dkyil 'khor bsrungs mtshams med par mi shigs pa'i gur dang ldan pa'i brda: gter bum chen po brgyad dang ldan pa ni: rang byung ye shes kyi gter rnyed nas 'khor 'das kun la re dogs dang bral ba'i brda: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsum dang ldan pa ni: gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum thig le gcig la rdzogs pa'i brda: de'i dbus su che mchog he ru ka smug nag tu bzhugs pa ni: gzhi chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda:

dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig ni: byang sems thig le nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mtshon pa'i brda: spyan mig drug cu rtsa gsum 'khyil ba ni: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro drug cu rtsa bzhir mtshon pa'i brda: sma ra smin ma la me 'bar zhing shangs nas rlung g.yo ba ni: ma rig pa'i dri ma bsregs shing nyon mongs pa'i bgegs gtor ba'i brda: dbu skra steng gi phyogs la gzengs shing khyung dang thod skam gyis brgyan pa ni: dbyings zang thal la dug lnga'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i brda: dar nag gi cod pan dang sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: phung po lnga ma spangs shing gnas su dag pa'i brda: phyag g.yas nyi shus gnam lcags kyi rdo rje gsor thabs su gdeng ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: g.yon pa nyi shus dung dmar rakta bsnams pa ni: mo rgyud kun gyi snying po gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: rtsa phyag gis gri thod thugs kar bsnol ba ni: thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: rdo rje dang rin po che'i sgro gshog brgyangs pa ni: chos sku'i rtsal las longs sku ma 'gags par 'gyu ba ston pa'i brda: dur khrod chas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas bcu gnyis dang ldan pa ni: tshogs brgyad gnas su dag ste skye 'chi bcu gnyis rang sar dag pa'i brda: zhabs bco brgyad dor thabs su bgrad cing byol song gtso brgyad mnan pa ni: sa lam bco brgyad rdzogs te 'bras bu kun gzhi'i klong du gyur pa'i brda: bskal pa'i me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa ni: ye nas ma rig pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i brda: yum gnam zhal gtso mo pang du 'khyud pa ni: gdod nas dbyings bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: zhal dgu dang ldan pa ni: theg pa rim dgu ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: spyan rtsa bdun shin tu bgrad pa ni: gsal ba'i lam mchog rtsa bdun sku la rdzogs pa'i brda: ral pa rdo rje dang thod skam sbrul rigs lnga dang dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba ni:

sku lnga zang thal ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bus snyan la brgyan pa ni: gsal stong zung du 'jug pa'i brda: g.yas dgus gri gug dang g.yon dgus dung khrag stob pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs dbyings su dag ste dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: rus rgyan dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan zhing gzig sham dkris pa ni: 'khor 'das snang srid gcig tu ston pa'i brda: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum bde stong 'khril ba ni: phyi nang rten 'brel don dang ldan pa'i brda: yab yum gyi spyi bor rdor sems kun bzang bzhugs pa ni: dam tshig dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i brda: ye shes khrag 'thung rigs brgyad kyis bskor ba ni: zhi khro rab 'byams ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: klu brgyad byol song gdan la 'gyings pa ni: mtha' yas sems can thugs kyis 'dren pa'i brda: sgo srung don gyi he ru ka bzhugs pa ni: khregs chod lta ba ro gcig tu shar ba'i brda: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rab tu bskor ba ni: chos kun ye nas buddha'i zhing khams yin pa'i brda: khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba ni: ma dag pa'i snang ba tshar gcod cing dag pa ye shes su ston pa'i brda: shar du yang dag gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: nub tu dbang chen rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: byang du phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: shar lhor ma mo rbod gtong gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: bla med rgyud kyi lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: lho nub tu rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni:

dgongs brda rten 'brel 'dus pa'i chos bzhi gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: nub byang du 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi mthu stobs lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: byang shar du dmod pa drag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi drag sngags kyi lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gyi bar khyams phyi nang la ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi sha za chos skyong thams cad rdzogs pa ni: skal ngan log par lta ba'i rigs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i brda: pho brang gi phyi nang la 'ja' 'od kyi zer 'khrigs pa ni: ye shes kyi klong dgu dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi'i drwa ba dang ral gri'i rgyal mtshan kha ṭwāṃ rnams ni: sgrub pa'i bar chad bsgral ba'i brda: mda' gzhu me long cod pan 'phur ba ni: rten 'brel gyi chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu sogs rgyan du mas spras pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon la dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda: sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan ni: tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa ni: chos dbyings mdzod la zad pa med pa'i brda: sa rgyan dang gnam rgyan yol ba dang dar dpyangs te rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa ni: zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i brda: rdo rje slob dpon la phyi nang chas dang khri gdan maṇḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dar la yun ring du gnas pa'i brda: khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor zab mo 'di mjal ba ni: mkha' spyod o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams la mngon sum du bgrod pa'i brda yin no: de lta bur khyed rang rnams dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor pho brang dgu dang ldan pa 'di yid la zungs shig sa ma ya: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/

nang rdo rje phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang*/ rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ /ces de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de/ ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: chos sku bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med rang byung gdan la bzhugs: oṃ: gnyis med sprul skur phyag 'tshal lo: hrīḥ phyi nang yid spyod mchod pa 'bul: hoḥ lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa bshags: trām̐: chos 'khor bskor zhing dbang mchog stsol: de nas dngos gzhi'i khyad par gyi dbang ni/ de la spyir dbang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyu gnyis dang rkyen bzhi 'tshogs pa la brten nas go 'phang gi chos rgyud la 'jog pa ste/ dang po la'ang gnyis te de'ang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ni gdod nas rang chas su zhugs pa'i chos nyid de/ bye brag tu phung khams skye mched lhar gnas pa bum dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ ngag rlung yi ge dang bcas pa sngags su gnas pa gsang dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ khams kyi dwangs ma bde chen du 'dug pa sher dbang gi mtshungs ldan/ sems chos skur gnas pa bzhi pa'i ste/ de dang de'i mtshungs ldan te/ dbang mchog rgyal po'i rgyud las/ dbang mchog rang la med gyur na/ /bskur bas 'thob par ga la 'gyur/ /bra sran 'bras bu'i dbang bskur yang*/

/de la 'bras kyi dngos snang med/ /ces gsungs/ gnyis pa lhan cig byed rgyu ni/ slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas pa'i dbang rdzas khyad par can nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rkyen bzhi ni/ dad brtson brtul zhugs dang ldan pa'i slob bu rgyu'i rkyen/ slob ma'i rgyud smin nus pa'i mtshan nyid kun tshang gi slob dpon bdag po'i rkyen/ brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan zhing gzhung ltar cho ga'i yan lag tshang ba'i nus pa khyad par can dmigs pa'i rkyen/ snga ma snga mas go phyes nas phyi ma phyi mas 'byung zhing brda don 'phrod pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ de lta bu'i rgyu rkyen gyi chos drug 'tshogs pa la brten te go 'phang gi chos dbang gi ye shes rgyud la 'jog pa'i las kyi thar pa'i myu gu mngon du bskyed pa'am/ skye nges kyi nus rung du smin par byed pa'am/ nges tshig ni/ gtor blugs te/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'khrus pa'i cha nas gtor ba dang*/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi nus pa khyad par can 'jog pa'i cha nas blugs pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya bas/ /des na dbang zhes brjod par bya/ zhes dang*/ dbye ba ni/ spyir gang zag gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar te/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang*/ grol byed lam gyi dbang*/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste gsum du bzhag pa dang*/ rnam pa bye brag la/ ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la gsal bar byas/ /de la drug pa bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni dbang*/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyas bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ /bzhi pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes rgyud sde'i dbang gi babs so mi 'dra ba bzhir bzhag pa sogs mtha' yas kyang*/

gsang ba bla med kyi skabs 'dir/ snying po'i rgyud phyi mar/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /de ma thag pa'i bzhi pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /

ces brda sbyar nas/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: sprul sku klong yangs bum pa zlum: yi dam sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga yi sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas 'gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyis/ dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇḍal phul: gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed cing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ 'og min gyi zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo yab yum las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sku 'bag thogs te:

hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka'i: sku gsung thugs yon bla na med: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka ma ma siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum mchog thogs nas: hūm̐: dbyings phyug chen mo bde chen yum: shes rab phar phyin kro ti mas: skal ldan khyod kyi pang du 'khyud: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bsgrub par gyis: oṃ kro ti bha ta ṇi gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo che mchog he ru ka yab yum 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thugs rje'i gzi byin nyi zla'i zer ltar 'phro zhing*/ gsang ba dga' bzhi'i brda skad dang bcas te gar nyams khyug khyug nam mkha' gang bar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ yon tan phrin las mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur cig /de nas dpal chen po che ba'i yon tan 'thob phyir phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba la thog mar yab kyi phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje thogs te: hūm̐: khro rgyal g.yas kyi phyag mtshan ni: rdo rje 'bar ba nyi shu gcig: hūm̐ bhyo pheṃ gyi rang sgra can: bde ba thabs kyi dbang bskur te: oṃ badzra ba shi ka dha ha na dha ri ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yas su gtad: bhandha thogs nas: hūm̐: khro rgyal g.yon gyi phyag mtshan ni: bhan dmar rakta chi li li: bla med gsang ba'i rdzas chen po: stong pa shes rab dbang bskur ro: oṃ bhandha rakta ha shi ba le dha ri ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum gyi phyag mtshan dang dur khrod kyi chas thogs la/ hūm̐: gri gug thod khrag bde stong rgyan: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas: gsang ba nyid kyi yum la brgyan: mchog gi bla med thob par shog: oṃ u ta a nu ta ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas kun bzang thogs te: khyed rang rnams la kun bzang yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas bya byed yid chos gnas su dag ste chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid mngon du gyur pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig hūm̐: chos sku skye med phrin las rdzogs: ka dag zang thal ngo bo nyid: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang mnyam: skal ldan khyod la rigs bdag bskur: oṃ sa mānta bha tra saṃ bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdor sems thogs te: khyed rang rnams la gsang chen rigs lnga rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur bas/ dug lnga gnas su dag ye shes lnga mngon du gyur cig rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid kyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i bdag: sna tshogs rang sar 'gags med pa: skal ldan khyod kyi skyabs yul du: longs sku sems dpa'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bya khyung thogs te: khyed rang rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso che mchog he ru ka'i dbu gtsug tu rtsal chen ye shes kyi bya khyung me zer dang gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ krang kring 'jigs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar byon te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan pas/ sgong chag gi khyung bzhin 'khor ba la ji mi snyam pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med par 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: che mchog thugs las sprul pa yi: ye shes bya khyung ga ru ṭas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: klu srin 'byung po'i gnyen por sgoms: oṃ dzñā na kā la ga ru ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'jam dpal gyi sku spyi bor bzhag cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid gzi brjid chen po'i dbang thob par gyur cig

/hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed: yum mchog bhe ta za byed sbyor: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: sku yi lha tshogs dbang rdzogs shog: oṃ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rta mgrin mgrin par gtad de: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid nus mthu chen po'i dbang thub par gyur cig /hūm̐: khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i skus: padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: gsung gi lha tshogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yang dag snying khar gtad cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das dpal chen badzra he ru yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid ye shes chen po'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: dpal chen thugs kyi he ru kas: yum mchog kro ti shwa rīr 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar bskur: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ he ru ka badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ma mo rbod gtong lte bar bzhag cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das bla med he ru ka yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid dngos grub chen po'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: bla med ma mo yongs rdzogs skus: yum chen nyid zhi kun bzang 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi gsang bar bskur: yon tan yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka ru lu ru lu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phur pa phrin las gsang bar gtad cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig

/hūm̐: khro rgyal badzra kī la yas: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar bskur: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos sgo yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chen po thob par gyur cig hūm̐: bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal: yum chen gsang ba ye shes 'khril: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bskur/ yang gsang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ artsig nirtsig thod phreng rtsal a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'jig rten mchod bstod dpung pa g.yas su bzhag ste: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chen po thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs ldan he ru kas: yum mchog srid gsum spyi 'dul 'khril: skal ldan dpung pa g.yas su bskur: gnyis med dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badzra duṣṭān lokka kro ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags dpung pa g.yon du gtad cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bcom ldan 'das dpal chen stobs ldan nag po yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chen po thob par gyur cig /hūm̐: drag sngags dmod pa'i khrag 'thung skus: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mor 'khril: skal ldan dpung g.yon dag tu bskur: drag sngags mthu stobs yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ sarba duṣṭān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyung brgyad snga ma ltar gnas so sor gtug cing : hoḥ ye shes sprul pa'i bya khyung gi dbang bskur bas gdug pa can rnams 'dul zhing kun snyoms yangs pa chen po'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig

/hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba'i thugs las sprul: mi bzad bya khyung sna tshogs 'dis: rim bzhin lha yi spyi bor brgyan: bya khyung brgyad kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: de nas he ru ka yab yum bcu drug thogs nas: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyud la skyes nas stong nyid bcu drug mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐: ye shes gsal stong rig stong pa: bde stong mngon byung dran rig mchog: lhan skyes kun grol khro bo brgyad: khro mo dang bcas dbang bskur ro: oṃ dzñā na kro ta kro ti dā sha kha ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mgon po bya rog lag tu gtad cing : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la dpal ye shes mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi dbang bskur bas/ bstan dgra bdud dpung thal bar brlag pa'i mthu thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung mgon po bya rog gdong : yum chen tsaṇḍi dmar mo 'khyud: skal ldan khyod kyi lag tu gtad: khrag 'thung gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo srung thogs nas: hoḥ sgo ba yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas rtag chad mu bzhi gnas su dag ste tshad med bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐: khro chen don gyi he ru kaḥ ye shes 'khor lo'i sgo skyong gis: skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur bas: 'char sgo'i ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra dharma gha te a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar lha tshogs rnams gnas so sor thim pas sgrub sde dgu'i sku'i rnam 'gyur/ gang dang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i rnam rol du 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob pa yin no/ /de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa/ ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog he ru ka drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas khams gsum gyi/
