gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir dur khrod chas brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ gnas rnams su byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyis mtshan ma/ sku'i stod smad la bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi na bza'/ mgul dang phyag zhabs la gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis kyis spras shing mnga' gsol bas ma mo mkha' 'gros rje bor bskur zhing*/ dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas thod skam prog zhu gtad de: hūm̐: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bkon: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid: dbu rgyan cod pan dbang thob shog: oṃ bhandha pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: thal chen gyi tshom bu thogs nas: hūm̐: thal chen 'bar ba'i tshom bu dang : khrag thig zhag gi zo ris 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la byugs: 'dod chags ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ badzra rā ga he a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: glang kos stod du g.yogs la: hūm̐: glang ko stobs bcu'i g.yang gzhi 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi stod du g.yogs: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo'i dbang : gti mug ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ tsarya dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje'i go khrab thogs te: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i snying po can: sra brtan 'jigs med pha lam go: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la bkon: skye med go cha'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhing lpags thogs nas: hūm̐: zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i rtog med gos: skal ldan khyod kyi rgyab tu gyon: gnyis med ye shes lhun grub dbang : nga rgyal ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ ma tsarya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: chu srin gyi stod g.yogs thogs nas: hūm̐: chu srin 'bar ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi phrag par brgyan: ngo bo de bzhin nyid kyi dbang :

bzang ngan blang dor bral bar spyod: oṃ bha tra a surtsi swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sbrul chun dang thod phreng thogs nas: hūm̐: thod phreng dug sbrul chun po 'dis: ga shal yan lag brgyan par gyis: me long ye shes rang byung dbang : zhe sdang ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ mo hā a dār sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rus sbal gyi rgyan thogs nas: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rus sbal phreng : skal ldan khyod kyi sku reg chings: lug 'byung ldog pa ye shes che: chags lam nyon mongs bde bar spyod: oṃ rā ga pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rus rgyan thogs nas: hūm̐: pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la brgyan: gsang ba'i gzungs ma bde stong yum: shes rab btsun mo ma spangs zungs: oṃ prañdzā pa ti dha ti ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stag sham thogs nas: hūm̐: stag gi sham thabs drag po'i chas: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkris: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phrag dog ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ a ti sha pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

me dpung thogs nas: hūm̐: ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar: yab yum bzhugs pa'i klong gur gyur: skal ldan khyod kyi srung 'khor gyi: drag sngags me yi dbang thob shog: oṃ tsaṇḍa aṇḍa ram̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams la gsang sngags kyi dngos grub 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du sgrub rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sman raka gtor ma las bzhi dam tshig gi rdzas kyis lha rnams/ bsnyen cing sgrub pa sogs gsang sngags zab mo'i thabs la brten nas/ 'khor 'das thams cad 'dod yon zag med ye shes kyi rnam rol chen por longs spyod cing las bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa'i mthu thob par mos shig / de nas gtor ma gtad cing : hoḥ che mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: bsnyen sgrub tshogs dang skong bshags dang : dus mchod rgyun gtor brtson par gyis: bsod nams tshogs chen dbang dang ldan: oṃ bha lingta gha na tsakra hoḥ de nas rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad cing : hoḥ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi'i: las kyi rim pa ma lus par: deng nas khyod kyis brtson par gyis: gang 'dul der ston dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra karma tsa tur hoḥ de nas rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang sbyin pa ni/ rgyal tshab 'os pa yin na khri la bzhag ste rigs lnga mgor bzhag /dkyil 'khor dang gzung thag lag tu gtad/ 'og tu khri brtsegs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ dung dkar dang rdor dril glegs bam sogs phul bas/ theg pa rim dgu gang 'dul der ston gyi chos ston la 'gro ba'i don rgyun ma chad par gyis shig ces bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs lnga thogs la/ hūm̐: dus rnams kun tu dkyil 'khor bdag: rigs la dbang zhing rgyan du 'chang : dbang chen la sogs 'chad par gyis: 'dus pa rigs bdag dbang thob shog: oṃ buddha dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje gzung thag gtad cing :

hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs las mtha' sogs: yongs rdzogs deng 'dir khyod la gtad: tshe rabs kun du brtan par zungs: oṃ badzra aṣṭa tsakra dha ti ta siddhi hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor gtad de rab tu gnas par bya: de nas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gtad de: hoḥ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis: dbang bskur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rgyud rnams smin par gyis: bla med mchog dang ldan par shog: oṃ dharma gha hri āḥhūm̐: de nas dung dkar gtad de: hoḥ skye med grags stong chos kyi sgra: 'gro ba lha mi'i sgra skad du: bshad cing spel sgrub 'chad rtsod rtsom: snyan grags chos kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma shang kha shabda āḥhūm̐: rdor dril gtad de: hoḥ thabs chen bla med lam gyi mchog: kun rdzob la brten don dam rnyed: dam tshig phyag rgya ldan par gyis: oṃ badzra mu ṭa ya hoḥ hoḥ shes rab snyan dbyangs theg pa dgu: dgra bcom nyan thos rang rgyal dang : kṛ ya u pa yo ga ste: ma hā a nu a ti'o: oṃ dharma ma hā ṣa na hoḥ chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i glo bur rnam rtog gi dri ma gzhi la dag ste ye gzhi kun tu bzang po'i klong du sangs rgyas par gyur cig / de nas po ti gtad cing : hūm̐: chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus pa: 'dzin 'chang gsung rab yan lag bcu: don ldan theg pa la gnas shog: oṃ badzra dharma dhā ra hṛ dha hoḥ chos kyi glegs bam gyi dbang bskur zhing lag tu gtad pas bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang rdzogs par thob ste/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /brtan par gyur cig /gnas par gyur cig /gsal bar gyur cig /'bar bar gyur cig /mched par gyur cig /ye dharm

de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ smug nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor bas 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces ru raksha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis bzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du bhandha thogs la/ hūm̐: longs sku ye shes bhandha'i zhing : bdud rtsi gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyed kyi mgrin par bskur: grags stong sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: padma'i phreng ba thogs la/ hūm̐: shes rab rang rtsal stong pa'i sgra: ma 'gags grags stong snying po can: gsang ba sngags kyi sgrub sde mos: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: oṃ prañdza mu ṭa aṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang chen po thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs shing sngags bzlas pa thams cad grags stong ma 'gags pa'i 'byin 'jug rdo rje'i sngags su shes shing*/

bzlas pa'i snying po sgrub pa la brtson par gyis shig /de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon spyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' dang bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin/ dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long thogs te: hūm̐: chos nyid skye med me long dbyings: che mchog thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar bskur: yang dag ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag /de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar/ mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas gtor ma thogs te:

hūm̐: 'dod yon sna tshogs bcud kyis brgyan: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar bskur: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka hrī ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol pa dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la mngon spyod rtsom pa po lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs shing*/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/ spyod pa snying rje'i srog dang ldan pas mngon spyod kyi las rtsom par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgral dbang dngos la'ang srung ba/ zlog pa/ bsad pa/ 'phang ba/ sreg pa/ mnan pa dang drug las/ dang po srung ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig om̐ shṝ he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭḥ rang nyid che mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang : 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi: bar thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa mig rnams la me'i bya khyung : dpag tu med pas gtams te bskal pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: nang gi khro bo dkar po stong gi zhal bdag la gyu zhing : srung ba'i sngags sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsgom: dmigs pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya: ma hā yaksha karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa:

kro ti shwa ri ā yurdzñā na ma ma rakṣa bhrūm̐: bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra rakṣa: de nyid brtan pa'i ched du srung 'khor gtad la/ hūm̐: stong nyid chos dbyings srung ba'i gur: mtshon cha mi shigs drwa ba'i gur: phyi nang gdon bgegs srung ba'i mchog: srung 'khor gur khang dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsakra raksha hoḥ zhes srung 'khor gnas lngar bskur ro/ / de'ang mi dmigs pa chos kyi dbyings su rgyas gdab cing nus pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ye dhar dang su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /yang srung 'khor de'i phyi rol du me'i tsakra dmar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur: de'i phyi rol zlog byed khro bo nag po stong gi zhal phyir gyu zhing pha rol byad ma bzlog pa'i sngags sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsams la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badzra kro ta kā la pa ha tsan hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad dgra bo kho rang la zlog cig: a mu ka bhandha sha ma zlog zlog: ru tra ma tha ma tha zlog zlog: bhū ta sarba tshindha tshindha zlog zlog: trig thum dgra la zlog zlog: gzer thum dgra la zlog zlog: de'i phyi rol du dug gi rlangs pa smyo byed rdzas kyi gur du gyur nas: pha rol byad ma rnams tshar bcad par gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: de nyid brtan pa'i ched rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi phyag mtshan 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: ting 'dzin longs spyod 'grub par gyis: zil gnon rang bzhin dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ti hoḥ de nas raksha'i phreng ba gtad nas: hūm̐: ting 'dzin skye med ngang nyid las: gsang ba dmod pa'i sngags phreng 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad:

snying po'i gzungs dang drag sngags sgrogs: oṃ raksha bhandha ma li ta hūm̐: thun snod gtad cing : hūm̐: chu gnas dmar po thun gyi snod: 'dzin shes gtong yang mi nus te: drag sngags dmod pa'i pho brang nyid: rbad pa'i sngags thun 'dzin par gyis: oṃ aṇa ḍa dha ra hoḥ de nas phod kha dang sngags zhwa gtad cing : hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags nag po'i zhwa: khams gsum zil gnon bklubs pa'i gos: rtag tu ngan sngags zhwa gos 'chang : bdud bzhi zil gnon dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra du kha na ya hoḥ /hūm̐: ram̐ ram̐ ya hoḥ gsum pa bsad pa'i dngos gzhir mdun du hom khung liṅga las phur dbye sgro bsgral chas rnams 'du bya la/ de nas slob dpon drag po'i chas su zhugs shing dar nag dang bcas 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma sogs/ de nas gsum pa bsad pa'i slad du/ gdab las bya bar phrin las rtsom pa'i yul nyams pa bdun ldan gyi dgra bgegs la/ ji ltar brtsam pa'i phrin las dmigs pa'i rim pa gsal 'debs gnang bar zhu/ de'ang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad e khrom 'bar ba'i rang bzhin/

nang bcud rnams sgrub sde bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad gtum chen rab tu 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs te/ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing mngon spyod drag po'i las la chas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo red cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka dpal dgu bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la snga dgra lag gis bsdo ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed ky-i bgegs/ dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig /tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ

rgya bzhi dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i bde gshegs kyi sras mchog badzra ki' la ya phyag gnyis kyis phur bu 'dril ba/ sku smad dbal phur zur gsum 'bar ba la thog mda' skar chen gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ srid gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis thabs kyis mi thul ba'i gdul bya log 'dren bdud kyi dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang*/ nus rtsal yongs su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: che mchog thugs las sprul pa yi: sras nyid rdo rje khrag 'thung sku: khro rgyal 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i mtshon: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padm sogs drag sngags so lnga phur bskor dang bcas 'debs tshul bya la thams cad kyis bsgral: oṃ badzra kī la ya: gnod byed mā ra ya rbad ya: tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal bar/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/ nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus dwangs ma'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtser ling gis btegs nas dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim/ phur bu'i dbal zur nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par gyur/ de nas gtub cing rol ba ni/ de ltar bsgral ba'i phung khams kyi rnam pa sha khrag gi longs spyod la/ ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'di dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du phul bar mos la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi'i bran zhing*/ hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po'i dam tshig tu: sbyor sgrol spyod pa mi 'bral bya: rtag tu dug lnga'i sha khrag rol: sgrol ba las kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ma hā māṃ sa rakta khā hi: de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du phur pa gtad la/ slar de dag gi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir phur pa lag tu gtad par mos mdzod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi brtul zhugs mtshon: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la gtad: bstan dgra sgos dgra nyon mongs sgrol: ma rig bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bzhi pa pha rol g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i don du dpal gtor rtsang gis brgyan pa g.yas su thogs la/ hūm̐: srid pa'i dregs chen rngam pa'i snod: dmar nag gtor chen rtsang gis brgyan: bskul bas phyi nang rkyen ngan bzlog: bzlog bskul drag po'i las thob shog: oṃ badzra ru tra mā ra ya zlog ya: zhes gtor zor lag tu gtad la dbang bskur/ 'phang ba ni/ dmigs bya rten la 'gug gzhug drag po dang bcas/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang du bzhugs nas gtor ma'i dam tshig pa srid gsum phung ba'i/ nad mtshon dug gi sdong por dmigs te gtor zor lag tu thogs la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /da khyed rang rnams dpal chen por gsal ba'i gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags kyi thog ltar 'phang bas/ bstan dgra bdud dpung brlag pa'i mthu thob par mos mdzod: de nas 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: pho nya rbad pa'i zor gyi bdag: bzlog med thun dang mtshon gyis brgyan: dam nyams dgra la gtor zor ya: las mtha' yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra thun bhyo rbad bhyo dgra la bzlog bhyoḥ zhes gtor zor me hom gyi dbus su 'phang la bsreg go /lnga pa drag po bsreg pa'i las mtha' brtsam pa ni/ shin tu mi bsrun pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i phyir du dug shing gi me hom lcags snod du sbar la sreg ling yod na dgra bgegs dngos su dmigs la bsreg

/med tshe ling ro me hom du bsregs shing : hūm̐: 'bar ba'i pho brang me hom du: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i bud shing bsregs: bstan dgra sgos dgra'i tshogs rnams kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: om̐ ru tra nṛ tri raṃ dzwa la ye swā hā: slar yang de'i nus pa brtan par bya ba'i don du hom gzar dang thab gtad la/ hoḥ chos nyid ye shes snod mchog thabs: nyon mongs bud shing la sogs pa: 'khor 'das ma rigs sregs par gyis: hom gzar la sogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra a hu ti āḥhūm̐: drug pa las mtha' mi mngon par rgyas gdab pa'i don du mnan pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs rje drag po'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas phye mar gas pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas/ hab sgra dir gyis lhags pa la bde bar gshegs pa'i bden stobs drag pos/ srid pa gsum gyi dgra bgegs dam sri bdud rigs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas 'chi bdag gi zhal du stim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo g.yam la yi ge tri re re bris nas rang mal de ru mnan par gsungs kyang lag len du mi bde na/ sngar drag bsregs kyi me thal sgo drung du mnan la de steng gtor gzhong kha sbub la bden stobs 'gugs gzhug gi mthar/ hūm̐: mdun du tri las dgra bo khug: rim dgu sa yi 'og tu non: dam sri sgab 'dre gnon par gyis: 'gugs dang mnan gtad las thob shog: oṃ tri dam sri mā ra ya nan: zhes gtad pas mthar shor med rgya mtsho'i klong du chol sgra dang bcas nas thim pa'i steng du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa dpal chen po'i pho brang gsal ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams la dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs rje drag po'i phyag rgya rdzogs pas/ srid pa spyi gnon gyi bro brdung gzir zhing bdud tshogs nam yang ldang med du bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod/

/ ces las gzhung bzhin rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: che mchog buddha thod phreng rtsal: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bro brdungs te: tshad med bzhi yi phur bu bsgrubs: btab pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: mnan no ru tra ma ldang cig: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor/ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pas che mchog he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ye shes lnga'i 'ja' gur dang me long thogs te: hūm̐: snang zhing stong la gsal zhing dwangs: nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'ja' tshon bzhin: stong gzugs sgyu ma'i ngang tshul gyis: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ swa bhā wa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/

bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud yi dam sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /de nas gsang dbang bskur ba'i don du slob ma rnams kyis gsang ba'i gzungs ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa zhig bla ma la maṇḍal gyi tshul du dbul ba'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ dpa' bo thugs rje che ba'i mchog: gsang sngags ston pa'i sa mkhan po: padma dbyangs can rig ma 'di: lam mchog zhugs phyir maṇḍal phul: oṃ padma mu ṭa maṇḍal keṃ nirya ta ya mi: de nas slob dpon gyis rig ma'i rgyud smin cing grol bar byas la/ rigs lnga sogs longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras te padma 'dab brgyad kyi khar bzhag la ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /oṃ badzra a mṛ? bum chus bsang sbyangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab padma 'od kyi zhing nas: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas yab yum la: 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba skad cig gis byon nas: bdag dang gzungs ma'i spyi bor zhugs te thugs dam gyis rgyud bskul bas byang sems dkar dmar gyi sprin 'phros nas bhandha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar la thim: slar yang 'od du zhu ste yum gyi tshangs bug tu thim: rim bzhin snying khar ye shes sems dpa' lam mer sgoms shig: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ yab yum dga' ba bzhis rjes su bskul te sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ badzra padma rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/

rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu bas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu gnyis lhan cig tu babs pa bhandha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ pra mo ti ri kunda li rakta a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi dang rakta lan gsum dkrugs/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon yab yum gyis dam tshig gi lam nas bdud rtsi phab pa de nyid sman raka la gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis gsang dbang zab mo stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gsang ba bla na med pa yi: yang dag rdo rje'i grol lam mchog: deng 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol: dam tshig srog gi snying po bsrung: rdo rje slob dpon gyis lan byin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed cag dam tshig ldan lags na: gsang rgyud mkha' 'gro'i nye lam bsten: nyams na sha zas srog lus phral: bsrungs na tshe gcig sangs rgyas nyid: ces gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi rim pa las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ram bdud rtsi nang mchod byang sems sbyar ba ngag tu byin cing : de nas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du 'dres pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sindhu ra'i gnas lngar thig le gdab cing bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/

ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rang byin gyis brlabs pas rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ byang sems kyi yi ge'i sprin ā li kā li'i rnam par 'char bas rtsa gnas thams cad gang ste rtsa'i 'ching byed kyi mdud pa grol/ gzung 'dzin brgyad cu'i rtogs pa 'gag /thig rlung sems gsum ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas bde ba'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ bgrod pa gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la sngar slob dpon la phul ba'i gzungs ma de nyid/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas kyis rig ma'i lag g.yon nas bzung ste/ khyed rang slob bu rnams la gtad nas thar pa bsten par bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: shes rab yid 'ong dge ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad sgrogs: 'di bsten bde stong lhag gis 'char: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: ces sprad pas yum gyi bskul bar mos la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ nga yi padma bde chen dgyes pa 'di: rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i gnas: skal ldan khyod kyi 'di bzung rtag tu mchod: 'di spangs pa la mchog gi dngos grub med: de phyir the tshom med pa'i brtul zhugs bskyed: yum gyis: a nu rā ga ya hoḥ sa chags pa bskul: yab kyis: a nu rā ga ya mi: dgyes pa ster: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa nye bar bskul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma kau3 haṃ: de ltar khyed rang yab yum gnyis ka lhar 'du shes pa dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padmar 'du shes pa dang*/ yid chos su 'du shes pa ste 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su mngon sum gyi dus gzhon nu ma la bde ba'i ro myong ba ltar/ yas bab mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ste/ dbyer med kyi dus su rlung dbu mar tshud pas brjod bral lkug pas rmi lam mthong ba ltar brjod bya kha las 'das te tshig gis mtshon du med par ro gcig pa'i dus su/

bde stong du 'dzin pa gzhi la thim pas khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung dang bral ba blo 'das zang thal la spyod par gyis shig / gnyis med du sbyor zhing ye shes lnga'i ngo bo skyong : hoḥ gsang ba mi phyed mkha' 'gro ma: khyed rnams 'di nyid rtag tu bsten: thig le 'bebs ldog dgram par gyis: ye shes chen po'i ngo bo skyongs: de nas ngo bo ka dag gi ngang du lhan ne bzhag: hoḥ chos sku'i ye shes mngon sum lam lhong phyir: gang zhig chags spangs lta bu'i khams gsum na: sdig gzhan med pas khyod kyi nam du yang : chags med chags bral chags pa'i mchod par brtson: zhes brtul zhugs bsgrag / hoḥ mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med smad par mi bya zhing : mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: rtag tu bha ga mchod par byed: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: gsang sngags lam mchog smad mi bya: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol tu: dam med rnams la smra mi bya:

zhes pas dam tshig gi rim pa song*/ spro bar mos na gsang dbang bde stong drug 'dren yang sbyar/ de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la shin tu spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog tshogs sbyangs te yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su pho nya bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i gseng lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde sdug byung tshor thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su dag nas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bgrod pa bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nge zhog cig /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am zhal nas skye med rdo rje'i tshig gis rang byung don gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad de dbugs dbyung bar mos la/ man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: chos nyid gsal stong g.ya' dang bral: ka dag rang shar ye nas stong : khregs chod gshis lugs blo las 'das: rang byung ngo bo'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ dharma swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rab bskyed de: rdo rje lam bstan phyag rgyas brda sbyar la: e ma sems nyid mthong ba'i bu khyod kyi: rig pa gang la thogs pa med pa'i phyir: 'di nas shar gyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge'i 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchong stangs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du song : shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi mgon: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi klong du gshegs: sras su bskyed de dam pa'i chos zungs shig:

de yang sems yin 'gro 'ong 'dug gam ltos: de'ang rtsal yin thogs reg 'dug gam ltos: chos rnams ma lus me long ye shes klong : rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog: a la la hoḥ a a āḥ sa twa ḍi ḍho me bha wa: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis lho phyogs su: rdo rje'i lam bstan phyag rgyas brda sbyar te: e ma sems nyid mthong ba'i bu khyod kyi: rig pa gang la thogs pa med pa'i phyir: 'di nas lho yi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge'i 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchong stangs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du songs: lho phyogs dpal ldan brtsegs pa'i zhing gi mgon: rin 'byung rgyal po'i thugs kyi klong du gshegs: sras su bskyed de dam pa'i chos zungs shig: de yang sems yin 'gro 'ong 'dug gam ltos: de yang rtsal yin thogs reg 'dug gam ltos: chos rnams ma lus mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog: a la la hoḥ a a āḥ sa twa ḍi ḍho me bha wa: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis nub phyogs su: rdo rje'i lam bstan phyag rgyas brda sbyar te: e ma sems nyid mthong ba'i bu khyod kyi: rig pa gang la thogs pa med pa'i phyir: 'di nas nub kyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchong stangs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du song : nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing gi mgon: snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi klong du gshegs: sras su bskyed de dam pa'i chos zungs shig: de yang sems yin 'gro 'ong 'dug gam ltos: de yang rtsal yin thogs reg 'dug gam ltos: chos rnams ma lus sor rtogs ye shes ngang : rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog: a la la hoḥ a a āḥ sa twa ḍi ḍho me bha wa: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis byang phyogs su:

rdo rje'i lam bstan phyag rgyas brda sbyar te: e ma sems nyid mthong ba'i bu khyod kyi: rig pa gang la thogs pa med pa'i phyir: 'di nas byang gi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge'i 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchong stangs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du song : byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing gi mgon: don yod grub pa'i thugs kyi klong du gshegs: sras su bskyed de dam pa'i chos zungs shig: de yang sems yin 'gro 'ong 'dug gam ltos: de yang rtsal yin thogs reg 'dug gam ltos: chos rnams ma lus bya grub ye shes klong : rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog: a la la hoḥ a a āḥ sa twa ḍi ḍho me bha wa: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis dbus phyogs su: rdo rje'i lam bstan phyag rgyas brda sbyar te: e ma sems nyid mthong ba'i bu khyod kyi: rig pa gang la thogs pa med pa'i phyir: 'di nas dbus kyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge'i 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchong stangs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du song : dbus phyogs me ri 'bar ba'i zhing gi mgon: dpa' bo stobs ldan thugs kyi klong du gshegs: sras su bskyed de dam pa'i chos zungs shig: de yang sems yin 'gro 'ong 'dug gam ltos: de yang rtsal yin thogs reg 'dug gam ltos: chos rnams ma lus chos dbyings ye shesaklong : rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog: a la la hoḥ a a āḥ sa twa ḍi ḍho me bha wa: zhes skye med ka dag chos sku gnyug ma don gyi gnas lugs/ rang byung rig pa'i ye shes zhes sangs rgyas mkhas pas ma bcos/ sems can sgrin po'i ma bsgyur ba de kho na nyid kyi ngo sprod thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad a ti bla na med pa rang bzhin gyi gshis lugs ma bcos par skyong bar mdzad 'tshal/

'di dag ni ka dag rig pa'i rtsal dbang ngo*/ de nas lhun grub thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur ba ni/ sgro mdongs sam rtsa 'khor lo lnga'i dpe'u ris thogs nas: hūm̐: rang byung rlung gi snying po can: ye shes ngo bo 'gyu ba yi: rta la bsten nas 'char sgo ru: lhun grub rtsal gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ a wa dhū ti kunda yam̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ye gdang sgron drug la brten nas sku dang ye shes kyi 'phel kha rdzogs zhing snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol/ 'pho ba chen po'i rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i mos pa brtan mdzod/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ / de nas mtha' rten la 'chi med tshe'i dbang dang dge legs spel ba bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi dbang dang gnyis las/ dang po tshe'i rten dgod cing tshe bcud bsdus nas slob ma rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mda' dar thogs te: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: sgo skyong mgyogs ma pho nya 'bum: snang srid tshe yi bcud bsdus la: mda' dar g.yab cing deng 'dir stsol: oṃ badzra ā yurdzñā na siddhi hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams la tshe ril dang tshe chang phul ba la brten nas/ 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe bcud thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / de nas tshe ril thogs te: hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla med rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngos grub nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: rtag tu dngos grub mchog thob shog:

oṃ gha na la ā yurdzñā na siddhi hoḥ de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas: nyams rtogs 'phel zhing bde drod skye: bcud dang rtsa rlung yar ldan pa: byin rlabs chu rgyun gter 'byung shog: oṃ a mṛ ta khā hi: de nas rdo rje thogs te: hoḥ brtan par gyur cig dkyil 'khor tshogs: rgyas par gyur cig snyan grags chos: 'phel bar gyur cig dge ba'i stobs: 'grub par gyur cig bden tshig shog: oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwam̐: badzra bi shwa hoḥ de ltar bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi smin byed dbang bskur rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gis brgyan pa legs par grub ste/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i don du/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun rnams rim bzhin gtad pa ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo rin chen rnam bcu ldan: 'khor ba'i 'khor tshogs rgyun bcad nas: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed dbang : skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog: om̐ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: btsun mo rin chen bsod nams gter: pha rol phyin bcu'i gzugs dang ldan: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i dbang : yid bzhin dpal 'byor thob par shog: oṃ wa tī ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: nor bu rin chen phun sum gnas: bsod nams tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: lhan cig nor bdun phyug par shog: om̐ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: blon po rin chen blo gros ldan: gang la ji 'dod dpag bsam 'dra: gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : shes bya thogs med dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā ma ti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: dmag dpon rin chen stobs rtsal ldan: brtson 'grus go gyon 'khor ba 'joms: thabs ldan skyabs kyi dbang mchog 'dis:

'jig mchog lta ba 'joms par shog: oṃ khaḍga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rta mchog rin chen sa lam bgrod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar brgal: bde chen thar lam zhing du 'dren: rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: glang po rin chen theg chen stobs: bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpung dang ldan: stobs chen gzhan gyi don byed cing : yang dag snying po'i don rtogs shog: oṃ hasti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ rigs kyi bu rnams la rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas/ bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i don bdun dang ldan nas/ gzhan don dpag med du 'grub pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig / bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang ni/ gdugs/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gdugs bzang gser gyi yu ba can: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod pa ltar: dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ tsha traṃ ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gser nya/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod pa ltar: spyan la nya yi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ ma tsha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dung*/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na chos kyi dung sgra sgrogs mdzad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i gsung la mchod pa ltar/ gsung la dung gi bkra shis thob par shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ shaṃ ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: padma/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na padma dmar mo 'dab brgyad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod pa ltar: ljags la padma'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bum pa/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na rin chen bum pa rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i mgul la mchod pa ltar: mgul la bum pa'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ kumbha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

dpal be'u/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na dpal gyi be'u 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod pa ltar: thugs la dpal be'u bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ bi warpa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na rin chen rgyal mtshan rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i sku la mchod pa ltar: sku la rgyal mtshan bkra shis thob par shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ dhwa dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'khor lo/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i zhabs la mchod pa ltar: zhabs la 'khor lo'i bkra shis thob par shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bkra shis rdzas brgyad thogs la/ rtog med yungs dkar rtog 'khrul gdon bgegs 'joms/ /ye shes me long bkra shis gzugs brnyan 'char/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'gags med chos sgra sgrogs/ /zho ni don dam snying po'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /bde chen li khris snang sems dbang du byed/ /bilba 'bras bur smin pas don kun 'grub/ /sman mchog gi waṃ nyon mongs nad rnams sel/ /rtsa mchog dūrbas 'chi med tshe dbang ster/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad pos/ /mnga' gsol bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ aṣṭā maṅga laṃ dra bya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes so sor gtad cing mnga' gsol/ de ltar nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs bzhin par me tog gi char dbab pas dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs dus kun tu yongs su khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis brjod/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po'i sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzogs thob pa yin pas/ de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin te/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags srog ni dam tshig ste/

khyad par smin byed dbang dang ni/ /grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa la/ /bla ma mchog bsten 'grub gyur zhing*/ /de yi rtsa ba dam tshig srungs/ /zhes dang*/ gzhung las/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dbang dang bka' gtad lung 'bog thob pa yin pas: dkyil 'khor sgom pa dang sgrub pa spel ba 'dzin pa sogs bya zhing : sku'i dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon la mi smad cing tha na kha tsam dang ku re bzhad gad tsam la spang : slob dpon gyi lcam dang gzungs ma sogs la'ang skyon du lta ba spang zhing : dbang gi gral du 'god pa rnams dam tshig rdo rje'i spun grogs yin pas: 'chi ba srog la bab kyang : ngan skur gyi skyon spangs shing legs pa'i yon tan du blta: bla mar rgyu'i zhen 'dzin srid pa dang bral yang bsod nams kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i phyir yon dang maṇḍal rgyas par bya: zhabs spyi bor len cing smon lam gdab: ci phyir dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas: bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig mchod pa dga': lus dang longs spyod chung ma dang : rgyud dang zhing khang nor rdzas rnams: bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i phyir: bla ma mnyes pa'i yon du 'bul: dam tshig mig gi 'bras ltar bsrung : dkyil 'khor snying gi khrag ltar 'chang : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: rgyud dang dbang bzhi'i las mtha' rnams: dbang lung med la bstan mi bya: zhes pa ltar 'dzin cing gsang bar bgyi'o/ /dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyis:

lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung nas su/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ sems can thams cad kyis byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ padma'i thugs bcud bkaṃ' brgyadaṃ gsang ba'i phul/ /srid zhi zil gnon sgrub sde kun gyi bcud/ /gsam̐ng sngam̐gs dbaṃng gi klung cheṃn 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstanam̐ dang de 'dzim̐n yongs kyi gces nor rmad/ de dag ni so gcig pa bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong zhes bya ba'i smin byed kyi dbang chog nar 'gros su bkod pa ste bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ yi dam bye brag gi skor la/ 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi dbang chen gyi dpe rgyun ma rnyed cing slad rnyed par gyur na skabs 'dir gzhug par gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ ༈ 'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir 'jigs rung gshim̐n rjem̐'i gshed chen po/

/dugam̐ rim̐ nag po khrom̐ 'dusam̐ skur bzhengs gang de yi/ /dbam̐ng chom̐g rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon cha bklag chog spel/ so gnyis pa 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las/ dbang bskur bsdus pa rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon cha rlung gi 'khor lo bklag chog tu dgod pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po sbyor ba bca' bsham la/ stegs bu khebs ldan mthing nag gi steng du bum pa bhandha me long shel rdo rnams brtsegs thabs su dgod/ mdun rgyab gang bder gtor ma gdan bang rim gru bzhi'i steng*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng du chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de'i steng gtor ma bra gzugs khram ris can/ pad 'dab bzhi mtheb skyu gsum re bcas bya/ de nas dbang tsaka la/ bum tsaka /tshe dpag med/ 'jam dpal/ gshin rje/ tshe bdag khro chu dug sdong*/ dgra nag /ki kang*/ sgo ma rigs bzhi/ me tog gi phreng ba/ gnam lcags mchod rten/ dgang blugs/ glegs bam/ rig tsaka me long shel rdo/ gzhan yang sman raka gtor gsum/ bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ sngon gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs tshang bar 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gzhung las/ las rim gzhung bsrang tshogs las grub pa'i rjes: dngos gzhi'i dbang la 'jug par byed pa ni: slob mar khrus bstsal mdun du gral la 'god: bgegs bskrad bgyis nas sngon 'gro'i chab kyang gtong : zhes pas thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sogs nas bdag bskyed las byang khro bo kun 'dus sam bsdus pa ngan sngags zhag sgrub bklag chog ma gang rung skyabs sems nas bstod pa'i bar dkyus ltar btang la/ dzap khang dbye zhing dzap bskul nas bsnyen sgrub ci nus rjes su bum pa gnyis spyi chings ltar bsgrubs la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ rig me dor ba gnang zhus chos skyong gtor 'bul dang skong bshags tshogs drang ba'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o/

/de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma mdun du bos la/ thog mar khrus bstsal ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas hya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du 'jam dpal dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ bdag ni 'jigs byed 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: bgegs tshogs 'joms byed dug ri me 'bar sku: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bka' las ma 'da' bar: dug skyu'i gtor ma changs bu 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma gnas phyogs med gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro sdang sems 'tshe gyur na: rab 'jigs khro bo rnams kyis mtshon char 'bebs: 'joms byed khro mo rnams kyis me thun brdeg: sras mchog rnams kyis dug rlangs smyo 'bog 'gyed: ma rungs gdug pa'i bgegs tshogs 'joms shing skem:

phye ma rdul phran ming med brlag par mchis: de bas 'byung po gzhan du phyir dengs shig: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka he ru ka kro ta kā la ha la badzra raṃ dzwa la gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ ya: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i 'od zer tshogs: mtshams gcod khro bo'i phyag mtshan sprin ltar gtibs: nam yang bgegs tshogs mi gnas gur khang ni: dang po 'jam dpal shel bum thogs pa'i gur: gnyis pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: gsum pa ye shes 'bar mched 'od kyi gur: bzhi pa dbyangs gsal sngags dang me dpung gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: bdun pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: brgyad pa gnam lcags ur mo mchu sder gur: dgu pa e mthing nam mkha' stong pa'i gur: bskal pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod dgu rim de: bgegs dang 'byung po mtshams gcod srung 'khor gyur: om̐ mañdzu shrī badzra tsakra bhrūm̐ rakṣa: om̐ kro ta sid ta tsakra rakṣa: om̐ dzñā na dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: oṃ raṃ ā li kā li tsakra rakṣa: om̐ bi shwa ā yu dha tsakra rakṣa: om̐ khaḍga tshindha tsakra rakṣa: om̐ kro ta kā la tsakra rakṣa: om̐ bha ga le hā garbha tsakra rakṣa: om̐ e khaṃ swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: om̐ badzra mañdzu shrī hūm̐ kro ta e badzra la ma bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/

oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ ༈ lo rgyus 'chad pa la slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhus te de'i don rim gnyis kyi nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de la'ang 'di ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku'i bdag nyid 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' drag po'i skur bzhengs pa dang*/ sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khyab bdag chen po bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la/ rtsa ba bshad rgyud dang man ngag gi rgyud sogs grub brnyes slob dpon so sos bkral zhing bka' bab pa'i man ngag gi bka' srol mtha' yas pa bzhugs shing*/ gangs can 'dir yang snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba'i gshed skor rigs lnga/ rnam pa'i tshul las ye shes las dang 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung*/ phrin las kyi bye brag rna cha brgyad ces yongs su grags pa dang*/ phyi 'gyur gsar ma'i phyogs la dmar nag 'jigs gsum nang gses dang bcas pa mang du byon pa las/ 'dir ye shes kyi gshin rje'i gshed po kun khyab de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ 'khor 'das spyi dpal 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa gshed skor rgya mtsho'i bcud dang snying por gyur pa ste/ ston pas 'jam dpal rnon po la gsungs pa: spyi rgyud lag na rdo rjes bsdus pa: sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo sogs dang*/ sku'i rig 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs kyis 'jam dpal khri drug stong du grags pa sogs rgyud bsam mi khyab pa'i rtsa rgyud zla gsang nag po dang*/ sdig pa snying 'dzin sogs kyi rgyud don man ngag tu bsdebs te grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la rim par brgyud/

slob dpon chen po padma kā ra/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ phung byed shāntiṃ garbha sogs rgya bal gru sha'i slob dpon rnams las gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches gsan pa dang*/ gzhan yang gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas gdan drangs pa thams cad bsdus pas/ dgongs brda zung 'brel dang khyad par du gnubs chen nyid bal yul du lan bdun du phebs nas bal po ba su dha ra las gshed skor ma lus pa gsan pas rgya gzhung sogs kun 'dus kyi snying por gyur pa yin te/ rang gzhung las/ 'di ni shin tu bka' gnyan la byin rlabs che: rgyu mtshan ci zhe na: kho bo gnubs ston pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sprul pa dngos yin zhing gshin rje'i bdag po mchog dang : khyad par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing dmod pas 'phung 'tshengs nus pa'i gshin rje'i chos ka tshan gnyis sbas pa ste: thog mar bdag dum rgya zhang khrom gyi dus: gshin rje'i ya gab gsang khrid gong ma rgyud bzhi la: 'jigs byed khro chu dgra nag gdong drug me'i spu gri tshe bdag sman gdong la sogs rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis brgyan pa gdan drangs: da lta bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i dus 'dir gshin rje'i ma gab gsang khrid 'og ma: rgyud bzhi la: dug ri nag po me 'obs khrag mtsho 'khor lo: zangs mtsho 'khor lo: gsal shing 'khor lo'am ya ma snying gzer: had pa kha tham sogs rgyud bzhi dang cha lag bco brgyad kyis spras pa gdan 'dren pa'i gshin rje'i bdag nyid kho bo yin pas brgyud pa nye khyad kyis byin rlabs shin tu che'o: zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar yang mtha' la: rigs ldan khyod nyid zhe sdang lo 'dzin tshe: sa rtags dus kyi 'phel 'grib rtags mthun dus: brtul zhugs smyo spyod lta bur spyod kyis la: dga' bas rab brtson rin chen snying lta bu: gza' rgod nag po dug rlung rgyas 'dra ba'i:

ki kang shar bu gsum gyi tshur rol na: dug gi bye ba nag po sbyor mtshams su: dug ri 'di sbas khyod kyi spyod ldan 'byung : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa lcags byi lor/ rga rgyal gza' bdud nag po'i lto ba nas gshin rje dug ri khro 'dus kyi skor dang*/ lo phyi ma lcags glang lor spo bo khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gshin rje rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i gnas mchog me 'bar mtsho nas/ gza' bdud ki kang chen pos lcags sgrom bcu gsum gyi rgya 'dzin shog dril dngos su phul ba dug ri me 'bar sogs gshed skor mtha' yas pa dang*/ ngan sngags las mtha' khyad 'phags du ma zab gter du bzhes shing rim bzhin shog ser du phab/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje dang*/ zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am hū?m̐ chen 'gro 'dul rtsal la bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du gnang zhing*/ des kyang rtsa nang gter chen dang*/ gter chen dri med gling pa/ des lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ des o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs nas/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dam pa 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyi bar du rim par byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams shing*/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/

thog mar/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ /de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma gshin rje'i gshed pa dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la: lus ngag yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: sgo gsum mi dge mthol lo bshags: rdzu 'phrul mnga' la rjes yi rangs: drag po mthu yi dbang bskur stsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyi ngag las gnang ba thob par mos shig /mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa rje btsun 'jam dpal zhi khro'i lha tshogs snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dgongs klong zab gsal nyag gcig tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bla ma bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: rang bzhin sku mchog rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor la: mthu rtsal gzi byin bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'i: kun 'dus rol pa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gdod nas 'khor 'das rang byung dkyil 'khor lha: sgra grags chos rnams bdag med stong pa'i ngang : ma rtogs sems can nges don la 'jug phyir: dran shes bag yod lta bas sems bskyed do:

de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum?chen por bsngo/ slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung : de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro /nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod pa bzhin srung dgos te/ dpal mchog las/ sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi gnas/ de bsrungs dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces pas sdom gsum gyi spang blang mtshan ma thams cad/ rang grol ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bar chig chod du srung ba thabs kyi sgo zab pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i dbang gi slad du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ yang dag rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: dkyil 'khor gnyan la bdag 'jug phyir: dpa' bo chen pos rjes bzung stsol: de nas slob ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du blang bar nus sam zhes 'dri ba 'di la gsan 'tshal/ hoḥ 'di ni 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: yang gsang ye shes pho brang ste:

dam med rnams kyis mi rig par: de ltar khas blangs dbang mchog sbyin: slar yang dam tshig khas len pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged cag las 'phro skal bar ldan: yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di la mos: dam tshig mchog bsrung gnang ba stsol: de nas gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams dam ldan snod 'chang na: yang gsang thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: smin grol don stsol bya phyir 'jug:

dam tshig 'bog phyir rdo rje mna' chu ni: dung zhal gzar bu phyag tu thogs byas nas: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig gsang ba'i chu: rdo rje'i khas blangs ldan rnams 'thung : dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung dmyal ba'i rgyu yin phyir: las kyi gshin rjes brdeg par 'gyur: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ om̐ hriṣṭi waṣṭi ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis khyed rang rnams gang du 'khod pa'i go sar e nam mkha' mthing nag gi rang bzhin pho brang khro chu khol ma tshwa tshwa lam lam du khol ba'i dbus su/ ya ma bam̐ las gshin rje ma rungs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du bam ro smug nag gi gdan dang bcas pa gsal ba'i snying khar khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs dang gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer mthu stobs gzi byin thams cad tshur 'dus hūm̐ dang rdo rje la thim: de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po rtsa zhal ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can: g.yas g.yon dang brtsegs ma'i zhal du shin tu khros pa'i spyi gtsug tu 'jam dpal nag po'i dbang rtags rdzogs pa:

phyag so bzhi dang ldan zhing g.yas pa bcu drug gis mtshon cha ni: gri khug ral gri chu gri me dpung kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo mdung thung lcags kyu spu gri dbyug tho ḍā ma ru dgra satwa zhags pa tho ba gsal shing rgyal mtshan bcas bsnams pa'o: g.yon pa bcu drug gis mtshon cha ni: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma gtun khung lcags sgrog rnga chung mgo phreng ru mtshon dug rlangs dril bu me long rkong zor khram shing shwa rdel rtsis rdo g.yang gzhi rnams 'dzin pa'o: rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gnam lcags las kyi phur bu bsgril ba: sku la dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan zhing rdo rje'i sgro gshog bar snang mkha' la gzengs pa: lte bar chu srin rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing sku smad gnam lcags ngar ldan gyi phur gsham 'dril bas bam chen gyi snying khar brjid pa: de'i pang du yum chen dur khrod kyi bdag mo dug ti ma dmar mo: zhal gsum phyag drug ma: rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud pa: lhag ma bzhis rdo rje phur bu 'khor lo dang ral gri 'dzin cing : zhabs bzhis sked la 'khril nas yab yum me ri drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa: spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa: de'i spyi bor tshe bdag dmar ser mnyam bzhag can lham mer gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i shar du tshe bdag nag po: lhor khro chu dug gdong : nub tu dgra nag dregs pa: byang du ki kang spu gri: de thams cad kyang shin tu khros shing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa: sku smad gnam lcags dbal zur dang ldan pa'o: gzhan yang sprul 'khor gshin rje'i sgo skyong dang bcas par gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang ya dmar nag las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te slob ma la thim par sgoms shig:

om̐ ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje nag po mthu bo che: sku mchog khro bos snang srid dbang bsgyur phyir: skad cig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mthu rtsal bskyed la dbang chen deng 'dir bskur: om̐ sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar byin phebs pas ye shes pa brtan par bya ba'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes pas rdo rjes rgya gram bya/ de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi dbang ni/ seṅge rtsal rdzogs las/ dbang la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*/ /de bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi sprul sku bum pa'i dbang*/ nang longs sku rlung gi dbang*/ gsang ba chos sku thig le'i dbang*/ de kho na nyid rig rtsal brda'i dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa sgrol dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ ya:

'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: sku yi gzi brjid lus la bstim pa'i phyir: bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim mthar phyin mchog: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mānta ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces me tog 'thor zhing maṇḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bar/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe dpag med kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: shes rab 'bar ba'i rtsal chen gzhon nu'i sku: 'chi med mgon po dmar ser li khri'i mdangs: sgrub la 'ja' lus rig 'dzin stsol ba'i phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ.āḥyurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'jam dpal gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: rmongs tshogs rab gzhom dpa' bo 'jam dpal dbyangs: sa lam rab rdzogs sgeg pa'i cha byad can: sku yi rigs bdag phrin las rdzogs pa'i phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ wa gī shwa ri tshandha sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas gshin rje'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: sku mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas tshe bdag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsung mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khro chu dug sdong gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: thugs mchog gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal khro chu dug sdong yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dgra nag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal dgra nag dregs 'dul yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ki kang gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las gshin rje rab 'jigs he ru kaḥ pha rol gdug pa'i rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal ki kang spu gri yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sgo ma rigs bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ dzaḥ gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan pa: myur mgyogs las bzhi phrin las sgrub: dam tshig bstan ba'i bya ra mkhan: rigs bzhi sgo skyong dbang bskur ro: om̐ ya mān dā dra bā la tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul 'jigs byed khro bo 'jam dpal nag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal gyi che rtags kyis mnga' gsol ba la khams gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir dur khrod chas brgyad de/

gnas rnams su byugs pa'i rdzas gsum gyi mtshan ma/ sku'i stod smad la bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi na bza'/ mgul dang phyag zhabs la gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis kyis spras shing dbang bskur bas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur zhing dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud de zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur dang khro bo kun 'dus dur khrod kyi chas la sogs pa dbang chen ltar bskur na zur rgyan lhan thabs su gsal/ dur khrod kyi chas thogs la/ hūm̐: prog zhu glang ko zhing lpags sbrul: khrag zhag thal tshom seṅge'i pags: thod phreng rus rgyan stag sham brjid: dpal chas lus rgyan dbang thob shog: om̐ shrī aṣṭha dā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po'i mthar/ dbyangs gsal dang sngags phreng g.yas skor du rang sgra dang bcas 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng bar ma chad par 'phros te 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod: ces ru raksha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis dbyangs gsal dang bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka a kro te ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma raksha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

om̐ hriṣṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badzra dzwa la raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ a kro te ka ya mānta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ: om̐ du tri ya ma rā dza ya mānta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ya ma rā dza kā la rū pa ya mānta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ki kang ya ma rakṣa a kro te ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ya mānta ka ni ma tri kro ti hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ ma tri ya ma raksha ni ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkhas gar khyab tu theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos sgra bsgrags shing 'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs te/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas stong gsal brjod med rang byung ye shes kyi ngang la gnas pa ni/ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don ston pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub pa'i 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i gsung gi mdzod klong rdol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog gi phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'byin 'jug skye med sgra: grags stong bde chen gsang ba'i lam: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phyag rgya drug gi don thob shog: om̐ wākka swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' dang bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin/ dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du/ gnam lcags kyi mchod rten thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po yi: thugs kyi gzi byin sems la bstim pa'i phyir: mchod rten dbang bskur gnas lugs don ston rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mānta ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ gtor ma lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che'i: yon tan gzi byin khyab par bstim pa'i phyir: gtor ma'i dbang bskur bka' sdod dam tshig che: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mānta ka gu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan rin chen bcud kyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la mngon spyod rtsom pa po lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs shing*/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/ spyod pa snying rje'i srog dang ldan pas mngon spyod kyi las rtsom par bya/
zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgral dbang dngos kyi ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /

nya bo mdun du bkod cing*/ bdag nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas mdun du srid pa las kyi brub khung*/ dug gsum 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i klong du bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i log 'dren byad ma 'byung po gang yin pa thams cad/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'tshub pa bzhin du rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga la bstim cing las byed pho nya rnams kyis bsgral ba'i las la sbyor ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐ ya: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: mdun du brub khung gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs ru tra mngon sum lta bur gsal: phaṭḥ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: khyad par za byed las kyi gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: dmag sna ston dang jag rkun chom po'i tshogs: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : 'chi bdag pho nya rnams kyis khug la shog: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la stims: dus la bab po las mkhan mthu ma chung : om̐ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dza ru tra nṛ tri a karṣa ya khug: slob dpon gtso bo 'jam dpal rdo rje nag po'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sras mchog kī la ya srid gsum dus gcig tu sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa de nyid khyed rang tsho'i lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis/ thabs kyis mi thul ba'i log 'dren bdud dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod pa'i dbang thob par mos shig / phur bu gdab pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po'i sprul pa ni: 'chi bdag gshin rje dgra 'dul kī la ya: phyag gnyis 'joms byed las kyi phur bu 'dril: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: bcad gtub rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: zhes bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje/

phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal bar/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/ nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus kyi dwangs ma'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtser ling gis btegs nas rnam shes chos dbyings su spar/ phur bu'i dbal nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par gyur/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān ru tra trig nan gzer thum rbad myog: ces stangs stabs dang bcas gdab tu 'jug /gtub cing mchod pa ni/ de ltar bsgral ba'i phung khams rnam pa sha khrag gi longs spyod la ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'di dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du phul bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsis bran zhing*/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig ste: bhandhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ bha lingta kha hi: slar de dag gi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir rdo rje phur pa lag tu gtad par mos mdzod/ rdo rje phur pa thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che'i: phrin las gzi byin rtsal bcu'i don ston phyir: phyag mtshan dbang bskur las mtha' kun kyang 'grub: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mānta ka gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de dag gis drag po mngon spyod kyi dbang gi rim pa legs par grub bo/

/ dgang blugs sprad la/ de nas phrin las bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i thabs shes zung 'jug gi phyag rgya dgang blugs/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo phrin las bzhi'i rang bzhin can 'di gtad pa tsam gyis/ phrin las rab 'byams kyi las mtha' yongs su sdud pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi yi: phrin las ston par byed pa'i snod: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: mtha' sdud ci rigs 'dzin par gyis: om̐ gu hya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bka' rab 'byams kyi glegs bam gtad cing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ glegs bam thogs la: hūm̐: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus kun: gcig tu bsdus pa 'di gtad pas: tshig dbang sna tshogs thob par shog: om̐ gu ya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i bka' yi sde lhug par brjod pa dang tshigs su bcad pa dum bur phyung ba ched du brjod pa so sor dbye ba: ngo bo tha dad mi phyed pa dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa lung du bstan pa bka' yi gdams pa: skyes rabs bsdu ba rmad du byung ba drang por ston pa: nges par sprad pa: zung du gnas pa la tant+ra kṛ ya chen por 'dus pa'i tshig gis dbang ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la sogs pa chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rnal 'byor la dbang bar byas so: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bdag nyid du bskyed pa tsam gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang srid dag pa lha'i gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/

phyi nang du 'jug pa'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje'i rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa dang*/ de dag shin tu brtan par bya ba'i phyir slar yang rnam rgyal bum pa rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang bskur bar mos la/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa 'ja' lus rdo rje'i mkha': snang stong sku yi dkyil 'khor ches: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal btab lha khrid don thob shog: om̐ kā ya swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyi phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /phyi snod bcud thams cad snang stong dag pa rab 'byams su spyod pa la dbang*/ 'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub/ sa brgyad pa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du bya'o/ /de nas gnyis pa gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba la/ bhandha 'di nyid tha mal pa ma yin par zla gam bde chen dbang gi pho brang du mos pa'i/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa sbyor ba mdzad pas bde chen gyi sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs khro bo rab 'byams spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa'i mdangs can dang*/
