yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu gnyis lhan cig tu babs pa/ bhandha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhandha thogs la: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje nag po che: gsung gi gzi brjid ngag la bstim pa'i phyir: bhandha'i dbang bskur drag sngags nus rtsal mngon: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ya mānta ka wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rang byin rlabs kyis rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ las rlung dbang du sdud pas las thams cada'agrub/ sa bcu pa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i lha mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mthing bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ gcer bu bde nyams dang ldan pa'i gnas lngar 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs lngar gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams dpal chen dbang gi rgyal po dmar la/ gcer bu rus rgyan can bde stong gi nyams dang ldan pa'i gnas lngar/ dug lnga dag pa'i ye shes kyi dpa' bo sde lnga gsal ba dang*/ zung 'jug dgyes rgur rol pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod:

ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren bzung : dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar khyed rang yab yum gnyis ka lhar 'du shes pa dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padmar 'du shes pa dang*/ yid chos su 'du shes pa ste 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su mngon sum gyi dus gzhon nu ma la bde ba'i ro myong ba ltar/ yas bab mas brtan gyis dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ste/ dbyer med kyi dus su rlung dbu mar tshud pas brjod bral lkug pas rmi lam mthong ba ltar/ brjod bya kha las 'das te tshig gis mtshon du med pa ro gcig gi dus su bde stong du 'dzin pa gzhi la thim pas/ khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung dang bral ba blo 'das zang thal gcig tu spyod pa'o/ /zhes ngo sprad/ de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la shin tu spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ thig le bde chen bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbyings mi shigs pa mchog gi las thams cad 'grub/ sa bcu gnyis pa non/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med par chos sku bde ba chen po 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyis phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig /de ltar bzhag pas sems zhes bya ba gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po mtshan ma can du ma grub par rtag pa'i mtha' las grol ba chos sku blo 'das ye nas stong pa/

de'i mdangs ma 'gags pa 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad shar ba'i gzhir gyur pa na/ chad pa'i mtha' las grol ba/ rang bzhin gsal la mi dmigs pa rgya ma chad cing phyogs su ma lhung ba ka dag tu rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsal bzhag dang bral ba la/ deng phyin chad 'dzin med ngo bo rang gsal gyi ye shes chen po la spyod pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzod/ me long shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nyid: gsal stong ka dag lhun gyis grub: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: don gsal shes rab mchog thob shog: om̐ tsitta swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa ham̐'u: de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ chos nyid khyab brdal chen po bsgom pa'i skal ba dang*/ nyams rtogs yon tan sogs rgyas pa'i las grub/ sa bcu gsum pa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / slob ma snod ldan yin na gtor ma spyi bor bkod la brgyud pa'i bka' gtad kyang bya ba ni/ hoḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro: longs sku tshe bdag dbang phyug: sprul sku 'jam dpal gzhon nu: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: bdud 'joms khrag 'thung rdo rje: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa/ rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje/ chos bdag 'jam dpal mtshan can/ rig 'dzin mkhas mchog rdo rje/ sngags 'chang kun dga' snying po/ mkhas grub don yod rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang mtshan can/ dpal ldan grags pa rnam rgyal/ dge legs nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ grub thob rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ yongs grags nam mkha' dbang phyug

/mtshungs med padma mchog grub/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la sogs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje khro rgyal dug ri me 'bar gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: sku mnyam par gshin rje'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur cig: gsung mnyam par gshin rje'i bden stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: thugs mnyam par gshin rje'i mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: yon tan mnyam par gshin rje'i nus stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: phrin las mnyam par gshin rje'i dmod pa dang ldan par gyur cig: las kun la thogs pa med pa gshin rje'i mngon spyod dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ ya mānta ka sarba tsitta dzñā na hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa a āḥ de nas dam tshig gi rim pa brjod pa las/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang*/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar bya ba dang*/ /zhes dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dug gsum lam khyer gnad 'di'ang gsan 'tshal/ hoḥ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po yi: zhe sdang ma spangs dam tshig gcig: rtag tu srog gcod mthu yang sgrub: dug lnga'i khrag la dgyes par gyis: nga rgyal ma spangs dam tshig tu: rtag tu nga rgyal khro gtum bskyed: phung po lnga yi khrag la dgyes: 'dod chags ma spangs dam tshig tu: khro mo yum la rtag tu rol: nyon mongs lnga yi khrag la dgyes: phrag dog ma spangs dam tshig tu: dmod pa'i ngan sngags rtag tu 'dren: 'du khams lnga yi khrag la dgyes: gti mug ma spangs dam tshig tu: dmod pa nag po'i cha lugs 'chang : ye shes lnga nyid rtag tu 'dren: las kun ma spangs 'grub pa'i phyir: dgra sha khrag gi mchod tshogs kyi: skong bshags dus gtor brtson par gyis: de'ang dag pa'i dam tshig rtag tu mi g.yel zhing rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'chang bar bya'o:

zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gong gsal spyi'i dam tshig de dag las 'das na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba stor ba klong gsal las/ bla ma dang ni dbang mchog gi /gsung dang rgyud las 'gal ba na/ /na raka sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ ji bzhin ma 'gal bar bsgrubs pa'i yon tan ni/ de nyid las/ bka' dang ma 'gal yon tan ni/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ches: dam pa'i bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung :

lan gsum/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i slaub bus slob dpon gyi dgyes pa skong dgos te/ rig pa rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /bu dang chung ma nor dang mchog /sgo gsum zol zog med pa yis/ /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar mnyes pa'i yon tan yang*/ de nyid las/ brten pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/

de dag gis 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus las/ dbang bskur bsdus pa rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon cha rlung gi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa dge/ slar smras pa/ dugam̐ gsum bdud kyi rim̐ bo thal ba ru/ /bsnyil mdzad 'jam dpal rdo rje nagam̐ pom̐ yi/ /sminam̐ byem̐d las 'grigs gsaṃng sngagaṃs spyi mthun ltar/ /bsgrigs 'dis bstanaṃ pa 'dziṃn pa'i go char smon/ zhes de dag ni so gnyis pa 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag po'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// //
